name: Miconit 2% Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About MICONIT 2% GEL

MICONIT 2% GEL contains Miconazole which belongs to the group of medicine called Antifungals agents. It is used to manage fungal and associated bacterial infections of the skin and nails.

Skin infections may appear on the trunk, hands or feet, scalp or outer ear, groin and include athlete’s foot, dhobie itch and intertrigo. It is also effective against infected nappy rash. It also has moisturising properties to help soothe cracked, red skin.

Skin infections will usually get better after 2 to 6 weeks. If your condition does not improve after 2 to 6 weeks of management, consult your doctor for advice.

This medicine can be used for adults and children. Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

Before using MICONIT 2% GEL tell your doctor if you have ever had kidney disease, heart disease or liver problem. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using MICONIT 2% GEL include burning sensation, irritation, itching, and redness at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage fungal and associated bacterial infections of the skin and nails

mechanismOfAction:
How MICONIT 2% GEL Works

MICONIT 2% GEL works by destroying the fungus that causes the infection and some of the associated bacteria which may also be present.
usageDetails:
How to use MICONIT 2% GEL

Use MICONIT 2% GEL exactly as your doctor has told you. It is for external use only. Check the label for directions before use. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

name: KETOCIP Soap 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETOCIP SOAP

Ketocip Soap is an Antifungal agent used to manage, control, prevent, and manage fungal and yeast infections of skin. It is also used to manage seborrheic dermatitis and dandruff. It contains ketoconazole as an active ingredient which kills the infection causing fungi.

Ketoconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane and also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the fungi.

Always use Ketocip Soap as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. While bathing, rub the soap gently on the wet skin to produce enough lather. Allow the lather to stay on skin for 2-3 minutes and then rinse off with water. Do not use it on open wounds, chapped, irritated, dry, or sun-burned skin. Avoid using it around your eyes, nose, or mouth.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of KETOCIP SOAP

Ketocip Soap may cause thinning of hair, changes in hair colour or texture of your hair, dry skin, and mild itching. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while using this soap.

name: Quadriderm RF Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About QUADRIDERM RF CREAM

QUADRIDERM RF CREAM is used to provide relief from skin infection, inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling. It contains a combination of Beclomethasone, Clotrimazole and Neomycin.

Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine. It works by making your body not release certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling. Clotrimazole and neomycin stops the activity of microbes (fungi and bacteria) which when applied at the infected site.

QUADRIDERM RF CREAM is strictly for external use only. Apply a thin layer of QUADRIDERM RF CREAM on the affected skin areas. Avoid its contact with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, or any open wounds. Do not use QUADRIDERM RF CREAM for more than 4 weeks without consulting your doctor.

Before using QUADRIDERM RF CREAM inform your doctor if you have any viral skin infections, skin ulcers, spotty red rash around the mouth, acne, rosacea (redness of skin) or itching of your anus (back passage) or genital areas as a precaution. Consult your doctor before using QUADRIDERM RF CREAM if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of applying QUADRIDERM RF CREAM are skin thinning and application site irritation and burning sensation. Consult your doctor if this side effect trouble you.
uses: Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
usesDetails:
Uses Of QUADRIDERM RF CREAM
Skin infections (Fungal and Bacterial origin)
Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
mechanismOfAction:
How QUADRIDERM RF CREAM Works

QUADRIDERM RF CREAM contains three medicines, namely beclomethasone, clotrimazole and neomycin. Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine which stops your body from producing certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling, while parallelly making your body release chemicals that heals inflammation.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medication which works by inhibiting the synthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Without ergosterol, the cell membranes become weakened and leaky, leading to fungal cell damage.

Neomycin is an antibiotic which stops protein synthesis in bacteria which is necessary for it to survive. As a result, it disrupts bacterial growth and replication and controls the spread of bacterial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use QUADRIDERM RF CREAM

Apply a small amount of QUADRIDERM RF CREAM into the affected skin areas or directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop using or overuse QUADRIDERM RF CREAM without consulting your doctor.

Avoid contact of QUADRIDERM RF CREAM with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. In case of accidental contact, rinse with plenty of water.

warnings.details: There is inadequate information regarding the safety of QUADRIDERM RF CREAM during pregnancy. Hence, QUADRIDERM RF CREAM should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the doctor. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
QUADRIDERM RF CREAM can be used in breastfeeding women if required. However, consult your doctor before using it.
QUADRIDERM RF CREAM is unlikely to affect your ability to drive or use machines.
Do not use QUADRIDERM RF CREAM if you are allergic to beclomethasone, clotrimazole or neomycin.

QUADRIDERM RF CREAM should be used in children and adolescents (aged 12 year or older) only if prescribed by the physician. There is no proper study information regarding the use of QUADRIDERM RF CREAM in children aged below 12 years. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
QUADRIDERM RF CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Others

QUADRIDERM RF CREAM is not recommended for use if you:

Have acne
Have severe redness and warmth of skin (rosacea)
Have perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around the mouth)
Have itching of your anus (back passage) or genital areas
Have viral infections (such as cold sores, chicken pox or herpes)
Have skin blisters or sores caused due to any infections
Have varicose ulcers (inflammation of veins)
Have stasis ulcers (ulcers caused due to reduced blood flow)

name: KZ Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About KZ CREAM

KZ CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KZ CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KZ CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KZ CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KZ CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KZ CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KZ CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KZ CREAM Works

KZ CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KZ CREAM

Apply KZ CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KZ CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KZ CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

name: SERTAFORD Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About SERTAFORD CREAM

SERTAFORD CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use SERTAFORD CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. SERTAFORD CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SERTAFORD CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of SERTAFORD CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SERTAFORD CREAM
Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:
How SERTAFORD CREAM Works

SERTAFORD CREAM works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.

Always use SERTAFORD CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using SERTAFORD CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

name: Lulitec Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULITEC CREAM

LULITEC CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULITEC CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULITEC CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULITEC CREAM

LULITEC CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULITEC CREAM Works

LULITEC CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULITEC CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: Candid B Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About CANDID B LOTION

CANDID B LOTION is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. CANDID B LOTION is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

CANDID B LOTION is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying CANDID B LOTION, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

CANDID B LOTION should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CANDID B LOTION
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CANDID B LOTION Works

CANDID B LOTION is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use CANDID B LOTION

Use CANDID B LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying CANDID B LOTION around your eyes, including eyelids.

Stop applying CANDID B LOTION and contact your doctor if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions

CANDID B LOTION is unlikely to affect your ability to drive or operate machines. Consult your doctor before applying CANDID B LOTION.

name: Livafin 0.25% Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM

LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM Works

LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM

Apply LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using LIVAFIN 0.25% CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.
sideEffects: Allergic reactions such as swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, which results in difficulty breathing, and severe skin rashes

name: Lamifin Body Lotion 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About LAMIFIN BODY LOTION

LAMIFIN BODY LOTION is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

LAMIFIN BODY LOTION is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use LAMIFIN BODY LOTION if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using LAMIFIN BODY LOTION are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LAMIFIN BODY LOTION
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LAMIFIN BODY LOTION Works

LAMIFIN BODY LOTION is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About LULILOK 1/ CREAM

LULILOK 1/ CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULILOK 1/ CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULILOK 1/ CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULILOK 1/ CREAM

LULILOK 1/ CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULILOK 1/ CREAM Works

LULILOK 1/ CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULILOK 1/ CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Lutiderm Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About LUTIDERM CREAM

LUTIDERM CREAM contains Fluticasone Furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids (glucocorticoids). It is used to manage inflamed skin, redness and itching in several skin problems not caused by germs and responsive to corticosteroids such as eczema, dermatitis, or insect bites.

LUTIDERM CREAM is not recommended for use in patients having other skin problems such as acne, severe flushing of skin on and around your nose (rosacea), spotty red rash around your mouth (perioral dermatitis), itching around your back passage or private parts, infected skin, which is not being managed, and itchy skin which is not inflamed.

Before using LUTIDERM CREAM inform your doctor if you have broken or damaged skin, chronic leg ulcer, psoriasis, or you need to use LUTIDERM CREAM on face. LUTIDERM CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women.

LUTIDERM CREAM is not recommended for use in infants below 3 months of age and should be used with caution in children below 12 years of age. Ask for the advice of your child’s doctor before using LUTIDERM CREAM for your child.

Avoid smoking or going near a naked flame while using LUTIDERM CREAM as this poses a risk of severe burns. The most common side effects of using LUTIDERM CREAM include irritation or itching. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen or doesn’t improve.

LUTIDERM CREAM causes vasoconstriction (constriction of blood vessels) and has an anti-inflammatory activity. It directly decreases the cells that cause inflammation such as eosinophils, monocytes, mast cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. Therefore, helping in reducing the inflammation and redness.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of the medicine for you depending on your existing conditions, weight and age.

introduction:
Introduction About LOBATE GM NEO CREAM

LOBATE GM NEO CREAM is a combination of Clobetasol, Miconazole and Neomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids, Antifungals and Antibiotics. It is used to manage resistant dermatoses (skin infections) with secondary bacterial or fungal infection.

LOBATE GM NEO CREAM is not recommended for use in patients with rosacea, acne vulgaris, perioral dermatitis, perianal and genital pruritus, viral infections (ex. herpes simplex, chickenpox) and perforated eardrum. Contact your doctor before applying. LOBATE GM NEO CREAM should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney disease. Contact your doctor before applying.

LOBATE GM NEO CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnancy unless considered clearly necessary. LOBATE GM NEO CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before applying. LOBATE GM NEO CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age. Contact your doctor before applying.

Dosage adjustment is not required for LOBATE GM NEO CREAM in the geriatric population. However, greater sensitivity of some older individuals cannot be ruled out. Contact your doctor before applying. The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, itching, redness, burning sensation and contact dermatitis. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Keto Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETO CREAM

KETO CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KETO CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KETO CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KETO CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KETO CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KETO CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETO CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KETO CREAM Works

KETO CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KETO CREAM

Apply KETO CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KETO CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KETO CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About MICOGEL 2% CREAM

MICOGEL 2% CREAM contains Miconazole which belongs to the group of medicine called Antifungals agents. It is used to manage fungal and associated bacterial infections of the skin and nails.

Skin infections may appear on the trunk, hands or feet, scalp or outer ear, groin and include athlete’s foot, dhobie itch and intertrigo. It is also effective against infected nappy rash. It also has moisturising properties to help soothe cracked, red skin.

Skin infections will usually get better after 2 to 6 weeks. If your condition does not improve after 2 to 6 weeks of management, consult your doctor for advice.

This medicine can be used for adults and children. Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

Before using MICOGEL 2% CREAM tell your doctor if you have ever had kidney disease, heart disease or liver problem. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using MICOGEL 2% CREAM include burning sensation, irritation, itching, and redness at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

name: LULIFORD Lotion 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About LULIFORD LOTION

LULIFORD LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIFORD LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIFORD LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIFORD LOTION

LULIFORD LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIFORD LOTION Works

LULIFORD LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIFORD LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: Keraglo AD Shampoo 75ml
introduction:
Introduction About KERAGLO AD SHAMPOO

Keraglo AD Shampoo is an Antifungal agent used to control dandruff and hair fall. It also relieves dry and greasy scaling of the scalp (seborrheic dermatitis). It contains ketoconazole as an active ingredient which is used to manage a wide range of fungal infections.

Ketoconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane and also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the fungal cell bodies.

Use Keraglo AD Shampoo as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply enough shampoo on wet hair and scalp then gently massage it to work up a good lather. Leave it for 5 minutes and then rinse using lukewarm water and dry normally. Use every three days for up to 4 weeks and then once a week for maintenance. Avoid contact with eyes. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions while using it.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of KERAGLO AD SHAMPOO

Keraglo AD Shampoo may cause thinning of hair, changes in hair colour or texture of your hair, dry skin, and mild itching. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects such as diarrhoea while using Keraglo AD Shampoo.

name: Keto Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETO CREAM

KETO CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KETO CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KETO CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KETO CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KETO CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KETO CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETO CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KETO CREAM Works

KETO CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KETO CREAM

Apply KETO CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KETO CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KETO CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About LULIFORD CREAM

LULIFORD CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIFORD CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIFORD CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIFORD CREAM

LULIFORD CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIFORD CREAM Works

LULIFORD CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIFORD CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Candid B Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About CANDID B CREAM

CANDID B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. CANDID B CREAM is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

CANDID B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying CANDID B CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

CANDID B CREAM should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CANDID B CREAM
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CANDID B CREAM Works

CANDID B CREAM is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use CANDID B CREAM

Use CANDID B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying CANDID B CREAM around your eyes, including eyelids.

introduction:
Introduction About 8X KT SHAMPOO

8X KT SHAMPOO contains Ketoconazole and Zinc pyrithione which belong to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used to manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection causing dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body).

Before using 8X KT SHAMPOO, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, or if you are using any steroids. 8X KT SHAMPOO can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice.

8X KT SHAMPOO is not recommended for use in infants and children. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, wash eyes thoroughly with water. Call your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.

If 8X KT SHAMPOO accidentally gets in your eye, wash your eyes with water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Lulilok Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULILOK 1%W/W CREAM

LULILOK 1%W/W CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULILOK 1%W/W CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULILOK 1%W/W CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULILOK 1%W/W CREAM

LULILOK 1%W/W CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULILOK 1%W/W CREAM Works

LULILOK 1%W/W CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULILOK 1%W/W CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Zydip C Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About ZYDIP C LOTION

ZYDIP C LOTION is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. ZYDIP C LOTION is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

ZYDIP C LOTION is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying ZYDIP C LOTION, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

ZYDIP C LOTION should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYDIP C LOTION
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYDIP C LOTION Works

ZYDIP C LOTION is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use ZYDIP C LOTION

Use ZYDIP C LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying ZYDIP C LOTION around your eyes, including eyelids.

Severe allergic reactions

name: Rexizole 1% Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About REXIZOLE

REXIZOLE contains Clotrimazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals.  It is used in the management of skin infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, fungal intertrigo and fungal infections of the outer and middle ear. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin and causing redness and itching.

An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes. Fungal intertrigo is inflammation caused by skin-to-skin friction in warm, moist areas of the body (groin, between folds of skin on the abdomen, under the breasts, arms or between toes).Clotrimazole works by managing fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of the fungal cell.

REXIZOLE is not recommended for use in patients allergic to this medicine. REXIZOLE should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The common side effects of REXIZOLE are itching, rash, blisters, burning, discomfort, swelling, irritation, redness and peeling of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the outer and middle ear
usesDetails:
Uses Of REXIZOLE
Manage ringworm
Manage athlete’s foot
Manage fungal intertrigo
Manage fungal infections of the outer and middle ear
mechanismOfAction:
How REXIZOLE Works

REXIZOLE acts by specifically inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol and other sterols (enzymes) required for cell membrane production, therefore inhibiting the division and growth of fungi eventually leading to cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use REXIZOLE

Always apply REXIZOLE as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. After washing and drying the infected area thoroughly apply a thin and even layer on it. In case of ear infection use 2-3 drops in the ears. Do not scratch the infected area even though it is itchy, keep the area clean and always wash your hands before and after the use of the medicine. Do not share towels, bathmats, etc. with other people, wash your socks, stockings and tights thoroughly in hot water to remove any shed skin or fungal spores. Change your footwear daily if possible. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration for you depending on your age and disease condition.
sideEffects: Severe allergic reaction symptoms include skin rash, swelling of the lips, throat or tongue, face, weakness, nausea, feeling faint difficulty in swallowing or breathing

Severe allergic reaction symptoms include skin rash, swelling of the lips, throat or tongue, face, weakness, nausea, feeling faint difficulty in swallowing or breathing

REXIZOLE should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only under the supervision of a doctor or midwife as it is not known if it is excreted in the breastmilk. If used topically on the nipple area, wash breasts before feeding the child. Consult your doctor before applying it.
REXIZOLE has no or negligible influence on the ability to drive or use machines.
Do not apply REXIZOLE if you are allergic to clotrimazole, other anti-fungal medicines or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Introduction About ZYKT SOAP

ZyKT Soap is an antifungal and antibacterial soap used for the management of fungal skin infections. It contains ketoconazole and cetrimide as active ingredients which are effective against fungal infections.

Ketoconazole manages fungal infections by inhibiting the formation of ergosterol which is required to maintain integrity of fungal cell wall and cetrimide acts as an antibacterial agent, hence managing fungal and bacterial infections.

Always use ZyKT Soap as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Use this soap as directed by your doctor or rub the soap gently on your body to form lather and leave it for few minutes and then wash thoroughly. Apply with caution near eyes, eyelids, mucous membrane as it may cause irritation and burning sensation. Inform your doctor if you are suffering from any other skin condition before applying this medicated soap.
sideEffectsDetails:

ZyKT Soap may cause mild irritation in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such effects while using ZyKT Soap.

name: Lichensa Ointment 40gm
introduction:
Introduction About LICHENSA OINTMENT

Lichensa Ointment has antifungal properties which is used for the management of cracked heels, jock itch (dhobi’s rash), diaper rash, napkin rash, boils, bedsores, and fungal infections between fingers and toes. It contains Boric Acid, Clotrimazole, Menthol, and Zinc oxide as active ingredients which destroy the infection-causing microorganism and helps in the healing of the skin.

Cotrimazole and Boric acid act by inhibiting and arresting the growth of the fungus by altering its cell membrane permeability. Menthol acts as a counterirritant by imparting a cooling effect and by stimulating the nociceptors initially and then desensitizing them. Zinc oxide provides a physical barrier to manage skin irritation and help heal damaged skin.

Always use Lichensa Ointment as exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Clean the affected part and spread it evenly. Use it at night and at least twice a day. Do not use the ointment if you are allergic to any of its ingredients.

introduction:
Introduction About ONABET CREAM

ONABET CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use ONABET CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. ONABET CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. ONABET CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of ONABET CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TERBINAFORCE CREAM

TERBINAFORCE CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERBINAFORCE CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERBINAFORCE CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERBINAFORCE CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBINAFORCE CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBINAFORCE CREAM Works

TERBINAFORCE CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

KETOSTAR ANTIDANDRUFF LOTION contains Ketoconazole and Zinc pyrithione which belong to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used to manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection causing dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body).

Before using KETOSTAR ANTIDANDRUFF LOTION, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, or if you are using any steroids. KETOSTAR ANTIDANDRUFF LOTION can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice.

KETOSTAR ANTIDANDRUFF LOTION is not recommended for use in infants and children. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, wash eyes thoroughly with water. Call your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.

name: Surfaz Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About SURFAZ CREAM

Surfaz Cream is an Anti-fungal cream used for fungal infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot (fungal foot infection), fungal nappy rash and fungal sweat rash. It provides relief from inflammation and itching caused by fungal infections. It contains Clotrimazole as an active ingredient which is effective in inhibiting infection-causing fungus.

Clotrimazole acts as an anti-fungal agent by stopping the synthesis of ergosterol which is a key component of the fungal cell membrane and further inhibits growth of fungal cells.

Surfaz Cream is for external use only. Apply this cream as directed by your doctor or 2-3 times a day. Apply a thin and uniform layer of this cream to the affected area gently. Avoid applying Surfaz Cream near the eyes or mouth and in case of accidental contact with the eyes or mouth rinse with water thoroughly. Do not use if you are allergic to Clotrimazole.

name: Ketonext Soap 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETONEXT SOAP

Ketonext Soap is a medicated soap used to control, manage fungal infections and yeast infections of skin such as tinea corporis, tinea cruris, and tinea versicolor. It is also used to manage dandruff (dry whitish scales of scalp) and seborrhoeic dermatitis.

Ketoconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane, resulting into increased cellular permeability that causes leaking of cellular contents. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby works against fungal cell bodies.

Use Ketonext Soap as advised by your physician. Wet the body thoroughly, apply Ketonext Soap liberally to develop rich lather, rinse for 5 minutes and rinse off. Avoid using it around your eyes, nose, or mouth. If contact occurs with eyes, rinse thoroughly with water. Discontinue use if irritation or inflammation develops. Do not stop using Ketonext Soap suddenly without informing your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About LOCERYL NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION

LOCERYL NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION contains Amorolfine which belongs to a group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the nail (onychomycosis).

A fungal infection also called mycosis caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

Before applying LOCERYL NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low immunity, poor circulation in hands and feet, severely damaged or infected nail, history of nail injury, psoriasis, other chronic skin conditions, swelling, yellow nails, breathing problems, painful nails, deformed or distorted nails.

LOCERYL NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before applying it.

LOCERYL NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents due to lack of experience. Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying LOCERYL NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION are skin irritation, rash or redness on the site of application. Consult your doctor if these side effects persist for a longer duration.

name: TEBINA Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About TEBINA CREAM

TEBINA CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TEBINA CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TEBINA CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TEBINA CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEBINA CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TEBINA CREAM Works

TEBINA CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: TEBINA CREAM is for external use only.
Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.
Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.
Wash your hands before and after application.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
Do not stop using TEBINA CREAM without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUCOS DUSTING POWDER

FLUCOS DUSTING POWDER contains Fluconazole that belong to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage, control, prevent, & manage fungal infections of skin such as tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea corporis (ring worm), tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) and tinea versicolor.

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot) is a fungal infection that begins between toes generally in people whose feet remain sweaty. It is characterized by symptoms such as scaly rashes, itching, stinging and burning between toes. Tinea corporis (ring worm) is a fungal infection causing circular itchy rashes with clearer skin in the middle, resembling a ring.

Tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) or jock itch is a fungal infection characterized by red and itchy rashes in the moist areas of the body such as groin. Tinea versicolor is a fungal infection that is characterized by abnormal skin pigmentation such as light and dark patches at the affected area.

Before using FLUCOS DUSTING POWDER inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart or lung diseases. There is no information on the use of FLUCOS DUSTING POWDER in pregnant or breastfeeding women and children. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using.

The most common side effects associated with the use of FLUCOS DUSTING POWDER are itching, irritation and rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLUCOS DUSTING POWDER

It is used to manage fungal skin infections caused including:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea corporis (ring worm)
Tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash)
Tinea versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How FLUCOS DUSTING POWDER Works

FLUCOS DUSTING POWDER helps in manage fungal infection where Fluconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the killing the fungal cell bodies.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.

name: LULIFORD Soap 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIFORD SOAP

LULIFORD SOAP is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (occurs as a red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection). Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another.

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal Agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIFORD SOAP is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant, and it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. This medicine is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age unless necessary. LULIFORD SOAP should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

Avoid applying LULIFORD SOAP to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIFORD SOAP

LULIFORD SOAP is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Thrush
Dry, flaky skin
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIFORD SOAP Works

LULIFORD SOAP works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and killing fungi. As a result, LULIFORD SOAP relieves discomfort, itching, and irritation on the skin.

Wet the affected area, apply the soap, lather, and then rinse thoroughly.
Your doctor will decide the dosage and frequency based on the intensity of the fungal infection and other relevant conditions.
Adhere to the schedule recommended by your doctor.

name: CANESTEN Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About CANESTEN CREAM

Canesten Cream is an anti-fungal cream used for the management of various fungal skin infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot (fungal foot infection), fungal nappy rash and fungal sweat rash. It is also used for relieving irritation due to fungal infection of genitals (end of penis or vulva). It contains clotrimazole as an active ingredient to manage fungal skin infections.

Clotrimazole exerts its antifungal activity by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential constituent of fungal cell membrane which helps to keep the fungal cell intact and directly promotes its growth. Inhibition of ergosterol biosynthesis damages the fungal cell integrity and leads to the inhibition of fungal growth.

Always use Canesten Cream as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Before application, clean and dry the affected area. Then, apply Canesten Cream as a thin layer evenly over the affected area for the duration as advised by the doctor. Avoid contact with eyes or mouth while using it.

introduction:
Introduction About AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM

AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About ONABET CREAM

ONABET CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use ONABET CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. ONABET CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. ONABET CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of ONABET CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ONABET CREAM
Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:
How ONABET CREAM Works

ONABET CREAM works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:

Always use ONABET CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using ONABET CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. introduction:
Introduction About FUNGICROS CREAM

FUNGICROS CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

FUNGICROS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

FUNGICROS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

FUNGICROS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying FUNGICROS CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of FUNGICROS CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How FUNGICROS CREAM Works

FUNGICROS CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use FUNGICROS CREAM

Apply FUNGICROS CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using FUNGICROS CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

name: FUNZI L Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About FUNZI L CREAM

FUNZI L CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

FUNZI L CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying FUNZI L CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FUNZI L CREAM

FUNZI L CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How FUNZI L CREAM Works

FUNZI L CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, FUNZI L CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About SERTAFORD CREAM

SERTAFORD CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use SERTAFORD CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. SERTAFORD CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SERTAFORD CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of SERTAFORD CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SERTAFORD CREAM
Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:
How SERTAFORD CREAM Works

SERTAFORD CREAM works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use SERTAFORD CREAM

Always use SERTAFORD CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using SERTAFORD CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.
sideEffects: Dryness and burning sensation of the skin

SERTAFORD CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding mothers only if recommended by your doctor. Consult your doctor before using SERTAFORD CREAM.
Do not use SERTAFORD CREAM if you are allergic to Sertaconazole.
SERTAFORD CREAM is recommended for use in children at and above 12 years of age only. Consult your doctor for advice.

SERTAFORD CREAM should be taken with caution in the elderly above 65 years of age, only if recommended by your doctor. Your doctor will decide the dose, duration of the management, and frequency for you depending on the severity of your existing condition and other comorbid diseases.

name: Keto Medicated Soap 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETO SOAP

KETO SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

KETO SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using KETO SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. KETO SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of KETO SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with KETO SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETO SOAP

Manages various fungal infections of the skin such as:

Ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections
Candida paronychia
Cutaneous candidiasis
Pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How KETO SOAP Works

KETO SOAP clears the infection by causing holes in the fungal cell membranes, thus killing the fungi.
usageDetails:
How to use KETO SOAP

Always apply KETO SOAP as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply KETO SOAP on the affected area. It can be applied on the body and scalp. Wash and rinse thoroughly with water after applying KETO SOAP. Avoid contact of KETO SOAP with the nose, mouth or eyes.

If KETO SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation

name: ITROMED Soap 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About ITROMED SOAP

ITROMED SOAP contains Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used in the management of fungal infections (such as candidiasis, mycosis, onychomycosis, tinea corporis/cruris/pedis). It is also used to manage fungal infection of the entire body skin in affected individuals.

A fungal infection of the skin is caused by fungus which leads to infection associated with  symptoms such as irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching or swelling in affected individuals.

ITROMED SOAP is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to itraconazole. ITROMED SOAP is also not recommended for use during pregnancy and it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. 

If you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with this medicine, consult your doctor immediately.
uses: Manage fungal infections (such as candidiasis, mycosis, onychomycosis, tinea corporis/cruris/pedis)
Prevents fungal infection of the entire body skin
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITROMED SOAP
Manage fungal infections (such as candidiasis, mycosis, onychomycosis, tinea corporis/cruris/pedis)
Prevents fungal infection of the entire body skin
mechanismOfAction:
How ITROMED SOAP Works

ITROMED SOAP works by inhibiting ergosterol synthesis (an organic compound responsible for maintaining cell membrane integrity of fungi cell) that leads to fungal cell membrane abnormalities (marked with increased permeability and disruption of fungi cell) thus causing destruction to the fungi cell and managing the occurrence of fungal infections in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use ITROMED SOAP

Use ITROMED SOAP as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands thoroughly before use, then clean and dry the affected area. Avoid getting into the eyes, mouth, nose or the surrounding areas. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age and type or severity of the infection.

warnings.details: ITROMED SOAP is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.
ITROMED SOAP should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.
Do not use ITROMED SOAP if you are allergic to itraconazole or any other ingredients of this medicine.

name: LULIFORD Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIFORD CREAM

LULIFORD CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIFORD CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIFORD CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIFORD CREAM

LULIFORD CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIFORD CREAM Works

LULIFORD CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIFORD CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

LULIFORD CREAM is generally not recommended to use in children under 12 years of age unless clearly necessary.
LULIFORD CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).
