name: Nizral 2% Solution 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION

NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage fungal infections on scalp and body such as dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis (a dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body) and tinea versicolor.

These conditions can by itchy, caused by a fungus called ‘Malassezia’. Tinea versicolor is characterized by white to brown patches on the body that sometimes appear after exposure to the sun.

Before using NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or if you are using any steroids. NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice. NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION is not recommended for use in infants and children.

The most common side effects of using NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION are itching, stinging and dryness on the site of application. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION

Manages fungal infections like:

Dandruff
Seborrheic dermatitis
Tinea versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION Works

NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION works by arresting growth in fungal cells thus, managing growth and spread of the fungus throughout your body.
usageDetails:
How to use NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION

Use NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for use on hair and skin only. Wet your hair and scalp thoroughly with water and apply sufficient amount of NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION to produce enough lather. Smoothly massage the lather over the entire scalp. Leave for 3-5 minutes, before washing off thoroughly.

If NIZRAL 0.02 SOLUTION accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Itching, stinging and dryness on the site of application
Allergic reaction (swelling of the face, lips, mouth, tongue or throat which may cause trouble in swallowing or breathing)

Peeling or blistering of the skin

introduction:
Introduction About KETAFUNG LOTION

KETAFUNG LOTION contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage fungal and yeast infections which may appear on the skin of the hands, feet, genital area, trunk, groin, scalp, face, chest or back.

KETAFUNG LOTION is not recommended for eye infections. Before applying KETAFUNG LOTION, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KETAFUNG LOTION can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KETAFUNG LOTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KETAFUNG LOTION are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:

Trunk, chest, back

mechanismOfAction:
How KETAFUNG LOTION Works

KETAFUNG LOTION reduces fungal infection by inhibiting the growth of the fungus by weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use KETAFUNG LOTION

Apply KETAFUNG LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KETAFUNG LOTION in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KETAFUNG LOTION until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

name: Lulican 1%W/W Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULICAN 1%W/W CREAM

Lulican Cream is a topical antifungal agent used to manage fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm of the feet between the toes (tinea pedis), ringworm of the genitals, inner thighs and buttocks (tinea cruris), or ringworm of any part of the body (tinea corporis). It contains Luliconazole as an active ingredient which kills the disease-causing fungi.

Luliconazole manages the growth of various types of fungi by managing the ergosterol synthesis which disrupts the production of the fungal cell membranes. As a result, it fights against the fungal infection of the skin and stops its growth, thereby relieving the symptoms of fungal infection.

Apply Lulican Cream as advised by your doctor. It is for external use on the surface of the skin only. Along with management, follow proper hygiene methods. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions after applying the creams.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of LULICAN 1%W/W CREAM

Lulican Cream may cause skin irritation, redness, itchy rashes, and swelling on the applied area. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while using this Cream.

name: Keraglo AD Lotion 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About KERAGLO AD LOTION

Keraglo AD Lotion is an antifungal agent used to manage athlete’s foot (fungal infection of feet), jock itch (fungal infection in groin area), ringworm (fungal infection of skin), and seborrhoea (dry, flaking skin or dandruff). It contains ketoconazole as active ingredients.

Ketoconazole works by killing the fungus responsible for the skin infections. Use Keraglo AD Lotion as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Shake well before use. Take enough lotion on hand. Apply lotion, ideally at night, to the scalp or the affected parts of the skin. Leave it overnight. In the morning, wash off, and then dry as usual.

The lotion should be used twice weekly with at least 3 days between each application. It can then be used intermittently depending on the response of the condition. Avoid contact with eyes.

name: Keto B Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETO B CREAM

KETO B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole, which belong to the groups of medicines called Anti-inflammatory and Antifungal respectively. It is used to manage different kinds of fungal infections like Tinea corporis (Ringworm), Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp).

These fungal infections can spread easily from one person to another and cause redness and itching in the affected area. They are usually seen in moist and sweaty areas of the body as tinea pedis is usually seen in between the toes due to fitting shoes whereas tinea cruris and groin are seen in the inner thigh region.

Avoid applying KETO B CREAM on the skin surface that is cut, scraped, sunburned, or eczema affected. KETO B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients suffering from skin-related viral infections, tuberculosis, acne rosacea, and perioral dermatitis.

KETO B CREAM should be used with caution in pregnancy and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. KETO B CREAM is not recommended for use in children 9 years of age and below. KETO B CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETO B CREAM

Manages fungal infections such as:

Ringworm (Tinea corporis)
Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp)
mechanismOfAction:
How KETO B CREAM Works

KETO B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole. Beclomethasone is a corticosteroid that works by reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms like itching, redness, irritation, and swelling by blocking the enzymes responsible for causing it (prostaglandins and leukotrienes). Ketoconazole is an imidazole that blocks the synthesis of ergosterol, a key component of the fungal cell membrane, thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use KETO B CREAM

Apply KETO B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean the skin and dry the skin area to be managed. Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, or inside the vagina. Do not cover or wrap or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Danfree 2% Shampoo 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About DANFREE 2% SHAMPOO

Danfree Shampoo is used to manage dandruff and dry or greasy scalping of the scalp (seborrhoeic dermatitis). It contains ketoconazole as an active ingredient to provide freedom from dandruff.          

Ketoconazole targets an increased number of yeasts called Malassezia. It acts by destroying the fungal cell membranes, which are necessary for survival because they manage undesired chemicals from entering the cells and manage cell contents from leaking. As a result, it kills fungus and yeast.

Always use Danfree Shampoo as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Wet the hair and apply the shampoo on the scalp evenly. Keep the shampoo on scalp for 5 minutes before rinsing. When using avoid contact with eyes, in case of accidental contact rinse thoroughly with water. Do not use Danfree Shampoo if your scalp is broken or injured.

introduction:
Introduction About PANDERM ++ CREAM

PANDERM ++ CREAM is a combination of Clobetasol, Miconazole, and Neomycin, which belong to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids, Antifungals, and Antibiotics. It is used to manage resistant dermatoses (skin infections) with secondary bacterial or fungal infections.

PANDERM ++ CREAM is not recommended for use in patients with rosacea, acne vulgaris, perioral dermatitis, perianal and genital pruritus, viral infections (ex. herpes simplex, chickenpox), or perforated eardrums. Contact your doctor before applying. PANDERM ++ CREAM should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney disease. Contact your doctor before applying.

PANDERM ++ CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnancy unless considered clearly necessary. PANDERM ++ CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before applying. PANDERM ++ CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age. Contact your doctor before applying.

Dosage adjustment is not required for PANDERM ++ CREAM in the geriatric population. However, the greater sensitivity of some older individuals cannot be ruled out. Contact your doctor before applying. The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rashes, itching, redness, burning sensations, and contact dermatitis. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

Candid TV Suspension is an anti-dandruff suspension used to effectively manage dandruff and tinea versicolor. It contains clotrimazole and selenium as active ingredients which shows antifungal activity.

name: EBERFORD Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERFORD CREAM

EBERFORD CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERFORD CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERFORD CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERFORD CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERFORD CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERFORD CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERFORD CREAM Works

EBERFORD CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERFORD CREAM

Always use EBERFORD CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERFORD CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERFORD CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

name: LULIFORD Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIFORD CREAM

LULIFORD CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIFORD CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIFORD CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIFORD CREAM

LULIFORD CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIFORD CREAM Works

LULIFORD CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIFORD CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Nupermy Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About NUPERMY

NUPERMY contains Permethrin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parasitic agents. It is indicated for the management of scabies, pediculosis (lice) and crab louse infections.

Scabies is a condition that cause itchy skin caused by a tiny burrowing mite called Sarcoptes scabiei. It can cause intense itching in the area where the mite burrows.

NUPERMY is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chrysanthemums (a flower). NUPERMY should be used with caution in patients having lung diseases and eczema (skin disease).

It is not recommended for use in infants below 2 months of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

NUPERMY is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult with your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using NUPERMY are itching, redness of skin, tingling, prickling, skin burning sensation and dry skin. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NUPERMY

Used to manage:

Scabies
Pediculosis
Crab louse infections
mechanismOfAction:
How NUPERMY Works

NUPERMY helps in managing scabies and head lice by acting on the nerve cells of the disease-causing organism and alters the movements of certain ions (sodium ions) which leads to loss of their function. This causes respiratory failure of the disease-causing organism and hence, their destruction.
usageDetails:
How to use NUPERMY

Always apply NUPERMY as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. The medicine should be applied on all the affected areas. Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Wash hands before and after the application of NUPERMY. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth.

Introduction About MFSUDIF CREAM

MFSUDIF CREAM is a combination of Fusidic acid and Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents and Corticosteroids, respectively. MFSUDIF CREAM is used to manage inflammatory dermatoses (lesions/eruptions of skin) with/without bacterial infection in affected individuals.

MFSUDIF CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Fusidic acid, Mometasone, and/or other topical/oral corticosteroids. Before applying MFSUDIF CREAM, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, glaucoma, infection at/near management site, active viral illnesses (such as chicken pox / measles), and/or suffer from liver failure.

[GBNKEYWORD is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of applying MFSUDIF CREAM are mild to moderate pruritus (itchy skin), burning/stinging sensation of skin, folliculitis (inflamed hair follicles), dry skin, mild skin atrophy, and/or telangiectasia (dilated small blood vessels on skin). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsens.

MFSUDIF CREAM manages inflammatory dermatoses, where mometasone furoate manages inflammation by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy, and fusidic acid manages the growth of bacteria and causes its destruction by inhibiting the synthesis of essential proteins that are essential for the bacteria to grow thus managing inflammatory dermatoses in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About TRUCONA F DUSTING POWDER

TRUCONA F DUSTING POWDER contains Fluconazole that belong to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage, control, prevent, & manage fungal infections of skin such as tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea corporis (ring worm), tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) and tinea versicolor.

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot) is a fungal infection that begins between toes generally in people whose feet remain sweaty. It is characterized by symptoms such as scaly rashes, itching, stinging and burning between toes. Tinea corporis (ring worm) is a fungal infection causing circular itchy rashes with clearer skin in the middle, resembling a ring.

Tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) or jock itch is a fungal infection characterized by red and itchy rashes in the moist areas of the body such as groin. Tinea versicolor is a fungal infection that is characterized by abnormal skin pigmentation such as light and dark patches at the affected area.

Before using TRUCONA F DUSTING POWDER inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart or lung diseases. There is no information on the use of TRUCONA F DUSTING POWDER in pregnant or breastfeeding women and children. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using.

The most common side effects associated with the use of TRUCONA F DUSTING POWDER are itching, irritation and rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRUCONA F DUSTING POWDER

It is used to manage fungal skin infections caused including:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea corporis (ring worm)
Tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash)
Tinea versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How TRUCONA F DUSTING POWDER Works

TRUCONA F DUSTING POWDER helps in manage fungal infection where Fluconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the killing the fungal cell bodies.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LULITEC CREAM

LULITEC CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULITEC CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULITEC CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULITEC CREAM

LULITEC CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULITEC CREAM Works

LULITEC CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULITEC CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About KETONOL SHAMPOO

KETONOL SHAMPOO contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage fungal infections on scalp and body such as dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis (a dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body) and tinea versicolor.

These conditions can be itchy and are caused by a fungus called Malassezia. Tinea versicolor is characterised by white to brown patches on the body that sometimes appear after exposure to the sun.

Before using KETONOL SHAMPOO, inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or if you are using any steroids. KETONOL SHAMPOO can be used by pregnant and breastfeeding women, but consult your doctor for advice. KETONOL SHAMPOO should not be used in infants or children.

The most common side effects of using KETONOL SHAMPOO are itching, stinging, and dryness at the site of application. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

If KETONOL SHAMPOO accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will determine the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Candid Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About CANDID CREAM

CANDID CREAM is an Anti-fungal cream used for fungal infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot (fungal foot infection), fungal nappy rash, and fungal sweat rash. It provides relief from inflammation and itching caused by fungal infections. It contains Clotrimazole as an active ingredient, which is effective in inhibiting infection-causing fungi.

Clotrimazole acts as an anti-fungal agent by stopping the synthesis of ergosterol, which is a key component of the fungal cell membrane, and further inhibiting the growth of fungal cells.

CANDID CREAM is for external use only. Apply this cream as directed by your doctor or 2-3 times a day. Apply a thin and uniform layer of this cream to the affected area gently. Avoid applying CANDID CREAM near the eyes or mouth, and in case of accidental contact with the eyes or mouth, rinse with water thoroughly. Do not use it if you are allergic to Clotrimazole.

Introduction About FUNGICROS NAIL LACQUER

FUNGICROS NAIL LACQUER contains Amorolfine which belongs to a group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the nail (onychomycosis).

A fungal infection also called mycosis caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

Before applying FUNGICROS NAIL LACQUER, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low immunity, poor circulation in hands and feet, severely damaged or infected nail, history of nail injury, psoriasis, other chronic skin conditions, swelling, yellow nails, breathing problems, painful nails, deformed or distorted nails.

FUNGICROS NAIL LACQUER is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before applying it.

FUNGICROS NAIL LACQUER is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents due to lack of experience. Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying FUNGICROS NAIL LACQUER are skin irritation, rash or redness on the site of application. Consult your doctor if these side effects persist for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About AMROLSTAR NAIL LACQUER

AMROLSTAR NAIL LACQUER contains Amorolfine which belongs to a group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the nail (onychomycosis).

A fungal infection also called mycosis caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

Before applying AMROLSTAR NAIL LACQUER, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low immunity, poor circulation in hands and feet, severely damaged or infected nail, history of nail injury, psoriasis, other chronic skin conditions, swelling, yellow nails, breathing problems, painful nails, deformed or distorted nails.

AMROLSTAR NAIL LACQUER is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLSTAR NAIL LACQUER is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents due to lack of experience. Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROLSTAR NAIL LACQUER are skin irritation, rash or redness on the site of application. Consult your doctor if these side effects persist for a longer duration.

name: LULIPORUS Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIPORUS CREAM

LULIPORUS CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIPORUS CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIPORUS CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIPORUS CREAM

LULIPORUS CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIPORUS CREAM Works

LULIPORUS CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIPORUS CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: KETOCIP CT Soap 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETOCIP CT SOAP

Ketocip CT Soap is a medicated formula used to manage mild superficial fungal and bacterial skin infections and seborrheic dermatitis of the body. It contains Ketoconazole and Cetrimide as the active ingredients that help reduce itching, redness, and discomfort associated with the infection.

Ketoconazole is an anti-fungal agent that acts by managing the synthesis of ergosterol which is important for the fungi to survive. Cetrimide is a topical antiseptic that destroys the bacterial cell wall leading to its death.

Always use Ketocip CT Soap exactly as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Wet the body and rub Ketocip CT Soap gently to make a rich lather. Leave the lather for a few minutes, then rinse off with water or as advised by the physician. Avoid contact with eyes or mucus membranes. In case of contact, wash thoroughly with water.

introduction:
Introduction About ONABET MAX 2%W/W CREAM

ONABET MAX 2%W/W CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use ONABET MAX 2%W/W CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. ONABET MAX 2%W/W CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. ONABET MAX 2%W/W CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of ONABET MAX 2%W/W CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:

Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:

ONABET MAX 2%W/W CREAM works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.

Always use ONABET MAX 2%W/W CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using ONABET MAX 2%W/W CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIBEN DUSTING POWDER

Triben Dusting Powder is an antifungal powder with super absorbent formula which helps to absorbs moisture. It is used as adjunct to manage fungal infection and manage its recurrence particularly in skin folds and where perspiration is a problem. As a maintenance therapy for tinea pedis, tinea cruris, diaper rash and other fungal infections of skin. It contains Clotrimazole as an active ingredient.

Clotrimazole acts primarily by damaging the permeability barrier in the cell membrane of the fungi by disrupting the production of the membranes that surrounds the fungal cells. It works by altering the fungal cell membrane by inhibiting certain enzymes, thereby clearing the infection and relieving the symptoms.

Always use Triben Dusting Powder as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. It should be used in the morning or night as directed by the physician. Do not use if you are allergic to Clotrimazole.
author: Dr. Janet.C

name: Ketomed+ Soap 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETOMED+ SOAP

Ketomed+ Soap is used to control, manage fungal infections and yeast infections of skin such as tinea corporis, tinea cruris, and tinea versicolor. It is also used for dandruff (dry whitish scales of scalp) and seborrhoeic dermatitis. It contains Ketoconazole as the main ingredient.

Ketoconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane, resulting into increased cellular permeability that causes leaking of cellular contents. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby works against fungal cell bodies. Vitamin E is a fat-soluble antioxidant most commonly for skin products to promote skin health and appearance.

Use Ketomed+ Soap as advised by your physician. It is recommended to be used during bathing. Do not wash the managed area after immediately using it. Avoid using it around your eyes, nose, or mouth. Do not stop using Ketomed+ Soap without informing your doctor.

name: Eberfine Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERFINE CREAM

EBERFINE CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERFINE CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERFINE CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERFINE CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERFINE CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERFINE CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERFINE CREAM

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERFINE CREAM Works

EBERFINE CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERFINE CREAM

Always use EBERFINE CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERFINE CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERFINE CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

introduction:
Introduction About IZ LULI CREAM

IZ LULI CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

IZ LULI CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying IZ LULI CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of IZ LULI CREAM

IZ LULI CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How IZ LULI CREAM Works

IZ LULI CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, IZ LULI CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

introduction:
Introduction About TRUCONA C DUSTING POWDER

TRUCONA C DUSTING POWDER contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It also relives symptoms such as burning, itching, skin cracking, and discomfort caused by the skin infections. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin, causing redness and itching. An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes.

Clotrimazole works by blocking the fungal growth and managing the further occurrence of fungal infections. TRUCONA C DUSTING POWDER is intended to manage fungal skin infections; hence, it should not be used for other infections of internal organs. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with TRUCONA C DUSTING POWDER.

TRUCONA C DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for patients allergic to clotrimazole. TRUCONA C DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in deep wounds and severe burns. TRUCONA C DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Before taking TRUCONA C DUSTING POWDER, inform your doctor if you’re under any medications.

It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About LAMIFIN BODY LOTION

LAMIFIN BODY LOTION is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

LAMIFIN BODY LOTION is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use LAMIFIN BODY LOTION if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using LAMIFIN BODY LOTION are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.

Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LAMIFIN BODY LOTION Works

LAMIFIN BODY LOTION is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About CANROLFIN CREAM

CANROLFIN CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

CANROLFIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

CANROLFIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

CANROLFIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying CANROLFIN CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.

CANROLFIN CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.

Introduction About MONOGUARD 2% CREAM

MONOGUARD 2% CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use MONOGUARD 2% CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. MONOGUARD 2% CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MONOGUARD 2% CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

name: Candid B Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About CANDID B CREAM

CANDID B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. CANDID B CREAM is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

CANDID B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying CANDID B CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

CANDID B CREAM should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CANDID B CREAM
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CANDID B CREAM Works

CANDID B CREAM is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use CANDID B CREAM

Use CANDID B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying CANDID B CREAM around your eyes, including eyelids.

name: Amonext Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMONEXT CREAM

AMONEXT CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMONEXT CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMONEXT CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMONEXT CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMONEXT CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum

How AMONEXT CREAM Works

AMONEXT CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.

LULICLINZ CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULICLINZ CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULICLINZ CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

LULICLINZ CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULICLINZ CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: LULITEC Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULITEC CREAM

LULITEC CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULITEC CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULITEC CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULITEC CREAM

LULITEC CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULITEC CREAM Works

LULITEC CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULITEC CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: NAFTIFAST Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About NAFTIFAST CREAM

NAFTIFAST CREAM contains Naftifine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used for the topical management of tinea pedis, tinea cruris, and tinea corporis.

NAFTIFAST CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if clearly necessary. Consult your doctor for advice. NAFTIFAST CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether this drug is excreted in human milk.

The safety and effectiveness of NAFTIFAST CREAM are not established in pediatric patients. There is no information on the use of NAFTIFAST CREAM in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using NAFTIFAST CREAM are burning/stinging, dryness, erythema, itching, and local irritation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: To manage tinea pedis, tinea cruris, and tinea corporis.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NAFTIFAST CREAM
To manage tinea pedis, tinea cruris, and tinea corporis.
mechanismOfAction:
How NAFTIFAST CREAM Works

NAFTIFAST CREAM is an antifungal agent that works by interfering with the formation of cell walls of fungi. Thus, inhibiting their growth and managing infections effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use NAFTIFAST CREAM

Apply NAFTIFAST CREAM as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. It should be gently massaged into the affected and surrounding skin areas once a day. The hands should be washed after application. Avoid the use of occlusive dressings or wrappings unless otherwise directed by the physician. Keep NAFTIFAST CREAM away from the eyes, nose, mouth, and other mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SCARAB LOTION

Scarab Lotion is a Antiparasitic and Antibacterial Lotion used to manage scabies (skin infection caused by mites) and pediculosis (infestation of lice in the scalp). It contains lindane and cetrimide as active ingredients.

Lindane is an insecticide works by killing the lice, mites, and their eggs by penetrating the skin. Cetrimide is an antibacterial agent that helps to kill bacteria.

Always use Scarab Lotion exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Shake well before use. Wash your hands before and after applying the lotion. Take a sufficient amount of lotion and gently massage it over the affected area. Wash it off the skin completely after 8-10 hours with warm water or as directed by the doctor. Do not apply this lotion on highly broken skin, crusted, or open sores of the skin.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of SCARAB LOTION

Scarab Lotion may cause burning, tingling, skin rash, dizziness, itching or skin irritation and redness of skin in some individuals. Consult your doctor if any experience any unusual symptoms while using Scarab Lotion.

name: LEEZOLE Mouth Paint 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT

LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT contains Clotrimazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in the management of oral candidiasis or thrush. These infections are caused by yeast-like fungi called Candida. oral candidiasis or thrush is a fungal infection which is caused by the accumulation of the fungus in the mouth region affecting the mouth, tongue and regions around it.

LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to clotrimazole. LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women and children above three years of age. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Before taking LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT inform your doctor if you’re under any medications. The common side effects of LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT are abnormal liver functioning, nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, itching and abnormal taste. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.
uses: Manage mouth and throat fungal infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT
Manage mouth and throat fungal infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT Works

LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT works by managing the fungus' growth. Clotrimazole works by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in the breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in the membrane-based activity of fungus. It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and the management of further fungal growth.
usageDetails:
How to use LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT

Always use LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT as directed by your physician. If you are using any dentures remove them before applying LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT. LEEZOLE MOUTH PAINT is meant to manage oral fungal infections only and so should not be used for infections of other organs.

introduction:
Introduction About CANDID B LOTION

CANDID B LOTION is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. CANDID B LOTION is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

CANDID B LOTION is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying CANDID B LOTION, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

CANDID B LOTION should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CANDID B LOTION
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CANDID B LOTION Works

CANDID B LOTION is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use CANDID B LOTION

Use CANDID B LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying CANDID B LOTION around your eyes, including eyelids.

Introduction About FUSIWAL M CREAM

FUSIWAL M CREAM is a combination of Fusidic acid and Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents and Corticosteroids, respectively. FUSIWAL M CREAM is used to manage inflammatory dermatoses (lesions/eruptions of skin) with/without bacterial infection in affected individuals.

FUSIWAL M CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Fusidic acid, Mometasone, and/or other topical/oral corticosteroids. Before applying FUSIWAL M CREAM, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, glaucoma, infection at/near management site, active viral illnesses (such as chicken pox / measles), and/or suffer from liver failure.

[GBNKEYWORD is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of applying FUSIWAL M CREAM are mild to moderate pruritus (itchy skin), burning/stinging sensation of skin, folliculitis (inflamed hair follicles), dry skin, mild skin atrophy, and/or telangiectasia (dilated small blood vessels on skin). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsens.

FUSIWAL M CREAM manages inflammatory dermatoses, where mometasone furoate manages inflammation by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy, and fusidic acid manages the growth of bacteria and causes its destruction by inhibiting the synthesis of essential proteins that are essential for the bacteria to grow thus managing inflammatory dermatoses in affected individuals.

name: MASKOFUNG Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About MASKOFUNG CREAM

MASKOFUNG CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

MASKOFUNG CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

MASKOFUNG CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

MASKOFUNG CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying MASKOFUNG CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How MASKOFUNG CREAM Works

MASKOFUNG CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use MASKOFUNG CREAM

Apply MASKOFUNG CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using MASKOFUNG CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLE F OINTMENT

ZOLE F OINTMENT is a combination of Fluocinolone and Miconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antifungals respectively. It is used to manage various skin infections athlete’s foot (Tinea pedis), ringworm (Tinea corporis), vaginal thrush, and sweat rash.

A fungal infection (also called mycosis) is a skin disease that is caused by a fungus when it enters the tissue. Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another person.

Avoid ZOLE F OINTMENT contact with eyes. ZOLE F OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients having rosacea (a skin condition that causes blushing or flushing and visible blood vessels in the face), acne, perioral dermatitis, anogenital pruritus, and napkin eruptions.

ZOLE F OINTMENT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary.

ZOLE F OINTMENT is not recommended in children and adolescents (below 12 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of ZOLE F OINTMENT are application site reactions (like burning, irritation, itching, and redness). If any of these symptoms worsen, consult your physician.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOLE F OINTMENT

It is used to manage skin infections such as:

Athlete’s foot (Tinea pedis)
Ringworm (Tinea corporis)
Vaginal thrush
Sweat rash
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLE F OINTMENT Works

ZOLE F OINTMENT is a combination of Fluocinolone and Miconazole. Fluocinolone works by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen, and itchy. Miconazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering. Thus, both together Fluocinolone and Miconazole help to manage various skin infections.

introduction:
Introduction About ONABET LOTION

ONABET LOTION contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use ONABET LOTION if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. ONABET LOTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. ONABET LOTION is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of ONABET LOTION include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)

name: KETOCIP Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETOCIP CREAM

KETOCIP CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KETOCIP CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KETOCIP CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KETOCIP CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KETOCIP CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KETOCIP CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETOCIP CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KETOCIP CREAM Works

KETOCIP CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KETOCIP CREAM

Apply KETOCIP CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KETOCIP CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KETOCIP CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIBEN CN CREAM

TRIBEN CN CREAM is a combination of Clobetasol, Clotrimazole and Neomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids, Antifungals and Antibiotics respectively. It is used to manage bacterial, fungal skin infections with associated inflammation.

This medicine should be used as directed by the physician. It is for external use only. Avoid contact eyes. It should not be used for any disorder other than that for which it was prescribed. The managed skin area should not be bandaged, otherwise covered, or wrapped so as to be occlusive unless directed by the physician.

TRIBEN CN CREAM can be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus. Contact your doctor before applying. TRIBEN CN CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before applying.

Safety and effectiveness of TRIBEN CN CREAM in pediatric patients have not been established. Contact your doctor before applying. The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, urticaria, itching, redness, swelling, burning, stinging sensation and skin irritation. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NADIBACT PLUS CREAM

NADIBACT PLUS CREAM is a combination of Miconazole, Mometasone and Nadifloxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals, Corticosteroids and Antibiotic respectively. It is used to manage bacterial and fungal skin infections like atopic and contact dermatitis, erythema multiforme, infective eczema, psoriasis and skin lesions.

Bacterial infection occurs when bacteria enters the body, increase the number of bacteria and cause a reaction in the body. A fungal infection (mycosis) is a skin disease that is caused by a fungus when it enters the tissue. Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another person. Before using NADIBACT PLUS CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis. NADIBACT PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use during pregnancy.

NADIBACT PLUS CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. NADIBACT PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions (such as burning, irritation, itching, flaking and redness). Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NADIBACT PLUS CREAM

It is used to manage bacterial and fungal skin infections such as:

Atopic and contact dermatitis
Erythema multiforme
Infective eczema
Psoriasis
Skin lesions
mechanismOfAction:
How NADIBACT PLUS CREAM Works

NADIBACT PLUS CREAM is a combination of Miconazole, Mometasone and Nadifloxacin. Miconazole works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungi and works against fungi. Mometasone is a corticosteroid that works by blocking the various chemical messengers (like histamine) involved in allergic and non-allergic mediated inflammation. It reduces inflammation, itchiness and redness by managing the traveling of infection-fighting white blood cells (WBCs) to the affected area of the body. Nadifloxacin belongs to antibiotic works by against the bacteria that cause skin infections and also inhibits the repairing of bacterial cells, thereby managing the further spread of the infections.

Apply NADIBACT PLUS CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

name: ZYKT Soap 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About ZYKT SOAP

ZYKT Soap is an antifungal and antibacterial soap which is used to protect the skin against various fungal and bacterial skin infections. It contains Ketoconazole and Cetrimide as active ingredients.

Ketoconazole functions by managing the synthesis of ergosterol (the fungal equivalent of cholesterol) thereby increasing membrane fluidity and managing growth of the fungus. Cetrimide destroys or damages the cell membrane of bacteria by lowering surface tension.  

Apply ZYKT Soap as recommended by your doctor. Wet the body and rub this soap gently all over the body to form a rich lather. Leave for few minutes and wash thoroughly. Avoid contact with eyes, eyelids or mucous membranes.

name: Eberclin Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERCLIN CREAM

EBERCLIN CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERCLIN CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERCLIN CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERCLIN CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERCLIN CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERCLIN CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERCLIN CREAM Works

EBERCLIN CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.

Always use EBERCLIN CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERCLIN CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERCLIN CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

Introduction About KEZRIN SOAP

KEZRIN SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

KEZRIN SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using KEZRIN SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. KEZRIN SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of KEZRIN SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with KEZRIN SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About KZ LOTION

KZ LOTION contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage fungal and yeast infections which may appear on the skin of the hands, feet, genital area, trunk, groin, scalp, face, chest or back.

KZ LOTION is not recommended for eye infections. Before applying KZ LOTION, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KZ LOTION can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KZ LOTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KZ LOTION are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KZ LOTION

Manages the fungal or yeast infections of skin appearing on:

Trunk, chest, back
Hands, feet
Scalp, face
Groin, genitals
mechanismOfAction:
How KZ LOTION Works

KZ LOTION reduces fungal infection by inhibiting the growth of the fungus by weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use KZ LOTION

Apply KZ LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KZ LOTION in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KZ LOTION until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.
