introduction:
Introduction About BELZOLE SOAP

BELZOLE SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

BELZOLE SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using BELZOLE SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. BELZOLE SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of BELZOLE SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with BELZOLE SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Lulifin Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIFIN CREAM

LULIFIN CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIFIN CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIFIN CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIFIN CREAM

LULIFIN CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIFIN CREAM Works

LULIFIN CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIFIN CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About LULILYN CREAM

LULILYN CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULILYN CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULILYN CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULILYN CREAM

LULILYN CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULILYN CREAM Works

LULILYN CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULILYN CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

LULILYN CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).

FLUCOS 2/+1/ LOTION contains a combination of Fluconazole and Zinc Pyrithione which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. name: Luliz Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About LULIZ LOTION

Luliz Lotion is a broad-spectrum anti-fungal lotion that is used to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Luliconazole which is used to manage fungal skin infections like athlete’s foot (fungal infection between the toes) (interdigital tinea pedis), jock itch (tinea cruris), and ringworm (tinea corporis).

Luliconazole is an antifungal agent that belongs to the azole class. It works by damaging the cell membrane of the fungus or yeast thereby destroying the fungus or yeast which has caused the infection.

Always use Luliz Lotion as advised by your physician. It is for External use only. Apply the Cream thinly and evenly over the affected areas and massage gently. Avoid contact with the eyes. Do not use Luliz Lotion if you are allergic to any of its components. It is not recommended to use in children below 18 years of age. Before using Luliz Lotion, inform your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding.

introduction:
Introduction About CANDID TOTAL PLUS CREAM

CANDID TOTAL PLUS CREAM is a combination of Clobetasol, Miconazole and Neomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids, Antifungals and Antibiotics. It is used to manage resistant dermatoses (skin infections) with secondary bacterial or fungal infection.

CANDID TOTAL PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use in patients with rosacea, acne vulgaris, perioral dermatitis, perianal and genital pruritus, viral infections (ex. herpes simplex, chickenpox) and perforated eardrum. Contact your doctor before applying. CANDID TOTAL PLUS CREAM should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney disease. Contact your doctor before applying.

CANDID TOTAL PLUS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnancy unless considered clearly necessary. CANDID TOTAL PLUS CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before applying. CANDID TOTAL PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age. Contact your doctor before applying.

Dosage adjustment is not required for CANDID TOTAL PLUS CREAM in the geriatric population. However, greater sensitivity of some older individuals cannot be ruled out. Contact your doctor before applying. The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, itching, redness, burning sensation and contact dermatitis. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

Miconazole belongs to antifungal which stops the growth of fungi while Neomycin belongs to antibiotic which stops the growth of bacteria in the skin.

name: FLUCOZOX 0.5% Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL

FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage dermal fungal infections (dermatomycosis) caused by dermatophytes, yeasts, and moulds such as tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea corporis (ring worm), tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash), and tinea versicolor.

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot) is a fungal infection that begins between toes generally in people whose feet remain sweaty. It is characterized by symptoms such as scaly rashes, itching, stinging, and burning between toes. Tinea corporis (ring worm) is a fungal infection causing circular itchy rashes with clearer skin in the middle, resembling a ring.

Tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) or jock itch is a fungal infection characterized by red and itchy rashes in the moist areas of the body such as groin. Tinea versicolor is a fungal infection that is characterized by abnormal skin pigmentation such as light and dark patches at the affected area.

Before using FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver, heart, and lung problems. FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL is not recommended to use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL can be used in children and adolescents. Consult with your child’s doctor before using it for your child.

There is no information on the use of FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL in elderly patients. Consult with your doctor before using. The most common side effects of using FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL are skin rash, irritation, dryness or cracking of the surrounding area, itchiness and burning sensation at the site of application. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen or persists.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL

Manages dermal fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis
Tines corporis
Tinea cruris
Tinea versicolor

mechanismOfAction:
How FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL Works

FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL helps in manage fungal infection where Fluconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the killing the fungal cell bodies.
usageDetails:
How to use FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL

Always apply FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL to the affected area. Wash your hands before and after application. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of FLUCOZOX 0.5% GEL for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Zocon Soap 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About ZOCON SOAP

Zocon Soap is a medicated antifungal soap used to manage fungal skin infections such as Athletes foot, jock itch, ringworm, and fungal skin infections of the penis, vagina, groin, vulva as well as to manage diaper rashes. It contains clotrimazole as an active ingredient that helps for managing burning, cracking, and itching of skin associated with fungal infections.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medicine that kills fungi by destroying their cell membrane.

Always use Zocon Soap as exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Wash the affected areas with warm water and soap.  Rinse well and pat dry. Repeat using the Soap 2-3 times daily or as directed by your physician. After usage, wash your hands properly to avoid contamination. Avoid contact with your eyes.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ZOCON SOAP

Zocon Soap may cause redness of the skin, stinging, irritation, burning sensation as well as allergic reactions like contact dermatitis in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while applying it

name: Metrogyl M Ointment 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About METROGYL M OINTMENT

METROGYL M OINTMENT is a combination of Mupirocin and Metronidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as impetigo (usually appears as reddish sores on the face, around nose, mouth, hands and feet), rosacea (blushing or flushing and visible blood vessels in face which may also produce small, pus-filled bumps).

Bacterial skin infections develop when bacteria enter through hair follicles, small breaks in the skin that result from scrapes, punctures, surgery, burns, sunburn, animal or insect bites, wounds and pre-existing skin disorders.

Before using METROGYL M OINTMENT inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver, nervous system problems, bleeding disorder, open wounds or damaged skin.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before applying METROGYL M OINTMENT. METROGYL M OINTMENT should be used with caution in children and elderly patients.

The most common side effects of applying METROGYL M OINTMENT are burning sensation, itching, redness, irritation at the application site. Consult your doctor if the above side effects does not improve.
uses: Used to manage bacterial skin infections like impetigo, rosacea
usesDetails:
Uses Of METROGYL M OINTMENT
Used to manage bacterial skin infections like impetigo, rosacea
mechanismOfAction:
How METROGYL M OINTMENT Works

METROGYL M OINTMENT works against the bacteria and promoting faster healing of the infection in which mupirocin exerts its action by reversibly binding to an enzyme (isoleucyl transfer RNA synthetase) and inhibits its activity of synthesis of proteins in the bacteria and produce microbicidal action. Metronidazole destroys the bacteria and other microorganisms that cause infections by damaging the DNA.

Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Ezimet Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About EZIMET CREAM

EZIMET CREAM contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. EZIMET CREAM is used in the management of inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses such as psoriasis and atopic dermatitis. It is also used to manage scalp psoriasis and seborrheic dermatitis.

Psoriasis is a type of skin disease that causes skin rash with itchy, scaly patches which most commonly occurs on the knees, elbows, trunk and scalp. Atopic dermatitis is a skin condition which makes your skin red and itchy. Scalp psoriasis is a common skin disorder that makes skin raised, reddish, often scaly on the scalp which can either occur as a single patch or several patches on the scalp. Seborrheic dermatitis is a common skin condition that affects your scalp which is characterized by red, and scaly patches of skin and dandruff.

Avoid applying EZIMET CREAM, if you have rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne (pimples), skin atrophy (thinning of the skin), dermatitis (skin inflammation) around the mouth, genital itching, viral infections such as shingles, chickenpox (viral infection), ulcerated skin, and wounds.

Before applying EZIMET CREAM, inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease. EZIMET CREAM should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before applying EZIMET CREAM.

The medicine is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor before applying EZIMET CREAM.

The most common side effects of using EZIMET CREAM are mild to moderate pruritus (itchy skin), burning and stinging sensation of skin, folliculitis (a type of skin infection marked by inflamed hair follicles), dryness of skin, mild skin atrophy (thin-shiny appearing skin). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worse.
uses: Inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses, such as psoriasis and atopic dermatitis
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How EZIMET CREAM Works

EZIMET CREAM works by reducing the inflammation of skin by blocking the production of a chemical messenger which is responsible for causing red, swollen and itchy skin that occurs due to an allergic reaction or irritation in the skin thereby providing relief from the symptoms of psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, scalp psoriasis and seborrhoeic dermatitis.
usageDetails:

Always apply EZIMET CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine and gently rub into the affected area of skin. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying the medicine around your eyes, including eyelids.

name: ITROSTRED Soap 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About ITROSTRED SOAP

ITROSTRED SOAP contains Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used in the management of fungal infections (such as candidiasis, mycosis, onychomycosis, tinea corporis/cruris/pedis). It is also used to manage fungal infection of the entire body skin in affected individuals.

A fungal infection of the skin is caused by fungus which leads to infection associated with  symptoms such as irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching or swelling in affected individuals.

ITROSTRED SOAP is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to itraconazole. ITROSTRED SOAP is also not recommended for use during pregnancy and it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. 

If you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with this medicine, consult your doctor immediately.
uses: Manage fungal infections (such as candidiasis, mycosis, onychomycosis, tinea corporis/cruris/pedis)
Prevents fungal infection of the entire body skin
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITROSTRED SOAP
Manage fungal infections (such as candidiasis, mycosis, onychomycosis, tinea corporis/cruris/pedis)
Prevents fungal infection of the entire body skin
mechanismOfAction:
How ITROSTRED SOAP Works

ITROSTRED SOAP works by inhibiting ergosterol synthesis (an organic compound responsible for maintaining cell membrane integrity of fungi cell) that leads to fungal cell membrane abnormalities (marked with increased permeability and disruption of fungi cell) thus causing destruction to the fungi cell and managing the occurrence of fungal infections in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use ITROSTRED SOAP

Use ITROSTRED SOAP as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands thoroughly before use, then clean and dry the affected area. Avoid getting into the eyes, mouth, nose or the surrounding areas. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age and type or severity of the infection.

name: Nailon Nail Lacquer Solution 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION

NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is used to manage mild to moderate fungal infections of fingernails and toenails without involvement of the nail lunula (the white half-moon of the nail) in patients with a normal immune response.

Fungal nail infections may cause nails to become thick, discoloured, fragile, cracked, and also separate from the nail bed.

Before using NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have diabetic neuropathy or insulin-dependent diabetes, a history of immunosuppression, fits, a history of organ transplantation, an HIV infection, tinea pedis (fungal infections of the foot), painful or seriously damaged nails, psoriasis, oedema, or breathing disorders (yellow nail syndrome). Consult your doctor before using it.

NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered necessary, and it should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION is safe for use in children aged twelve years and older, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before using NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION.

The most common side effects of using NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION are periungual erythema (redness of the skin surrounding the nail) and erythema, or redness, of the proximal nail fold. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage mild to moderate fungal infections of fingernails and toenails without involvement of nail lunula
usesDetails:
Uses Of NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION
To manage mild to moderate fungal infections of fingernails and toenails without involvement of nail lunula
mechanismOfAction:
How NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION Works

NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION is a broad-spectrum antifungal medication that works by inhibiting or killing a wide range of fungi that cause nail infections. Thus, it helps to manage fungal infections of the nail effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION

Always use NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Before starting management, remove any loose nail or nail material using nail clippers or nail files. 

Carefully wash and dry the nails. Apply NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION, once daily (preferably at bedtime) to all affected nails with the applicator brush provided. Apply the medicine evenly over the entire affected nail and immediate adjacent skin.

Allow the medicine to dry (for 30 seconds) before putting on socks or stockings. Wait for 8 hours before taking a bath or shower after applying medication.

Apply NAILON NAIL LACQUER SOLUTION, daily over the previous coat and once a week, remove the medicine, with alcohol and remove as much as possible of the damaged nail using scissors, nail clippers, or nail files.

Avoid contact with skin other than skin immediately surrounding the managed nails, mucous membrane and eyes.
sideEffects: Periungual erythema (redness of the skin surrounding the nail) and erythema or redness of the proximal nail fold

Periungual erythema (redness of the skin surrounding the nail) and erythema or redness of the proximal nail fold

introduction:
Introduction About EBERWIN CREAM

EBERWIN CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERWIN CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERWIN CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERWIN CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERWIN CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERWIN CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Amrolstar 0.25% Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM

AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM Works

AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM

Apply AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AMROLSTAR 0.25% CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

name: NOSKURF Lotion 150ml
introduction:
Introduction About NOSKURF LOTION

Noskurf lotion is a specially designed lotion that helps to manage dandruff on scalp. Noskurf lotion contains Climbazole, Piroctone Olamine, and Zinc Pyrethione as active ingredients which are effective against fungus-causing dandruff.

Climbazole is an antifungal medication that kills and stops the growth of fungi by destroying their cell membrane. Piroctone Olamine works by penetrating the cell membrane of the fungi to interfere with their energy metabolism and oxygen uptake. In this way, it kills the fungi and clears up the infection. Zinc pyrithione makes fungal cells absorb copper which in turn inactivates the protein mechanism in cells and stops the fungal growth.

Apply Noskurf Lotion as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Shake well before use. Apply Noskurf lotion with the help of the applicator and give a gentle massage. Leave the lotion for 30 minutes and then rinse it.

name: Terbest Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About TERBEST CREAM

TERBEST CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERBEST CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERBEST CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERBEST CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBEST CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBEST CREAM Works

TERBEST CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About LILITUF LOTION

LILITUF LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LILITUF LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LILITUF LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LILITUF LOTION

LILITUF LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LILITUF LOTION Works

LILITUF LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LILITUF LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

It is for external use only.

Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Kansel DS Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About KANSEL DS GEL

KANSEL DS GEL contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in the management of fungal skin infections such as ringworm (fungal infection of the skin or scalp), athlete’s foot (fungal infection between the toes), fungal nappy rash (skin rash affecting the nappy area), and fungal sweat rash. It also relieves irritation of the vulva (external thrush) or at the end of the penis, which may be associated with thrush.

Before applying KANSEL DS GEL, inform your doctor about your previous existing disease conditions. KANSEL DS GEL is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to clotrimazole. Avoid smoking or going near flames and wearing fabrics that catch fire easily due to the increased risk of severe burns.

KANSEL DS GEL can be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Avoid using latex contraceptives (condoms or diaphragms), as this medicine may reduce the effectiveness of such contraceptives. Use alternative precautions for at least five days after using the medicine. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual effects.
uses: Manage fungal skin infections (such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, fungal nappy rash, and sweat rash)
Relieves irritation of the vulva or at the end of the penis (which may be associated with thrush)
usesDetails:

Manage fungal skin infections (such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, fungal nappy rash, and sweat rash)
Relieves irritation of the vulva or at the end of the penis (which may be associated with thrush)
mechanismOfAction:
How KANSEL DS GEL Works

KANSEL DS GEL acts by specifically inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol and other sterols (enzymes) required for cell membrane production; therefore, it inhibits the division and growth of fungi, eventually leading to cell death, which further manages fungal growth.
usageDetails:
How to use KANSEL DS GEL

Always apply KANSEL DS GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected surface before applying the medicine. Apply and rub gently a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Do not use KANSEL DS GEL on your face, eyes, or large area. Do not use under bandages or for a long time without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the duration and time interval for application depending on the type of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About KZ DUSTING POWDER

KZ DUSTING POWDER contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to topically manage fungal infections like tinea corporis (a skin infection of the trunk and extremities) and tinea cruris (infection of the proximal thighs and buttocks, also known as “jock itch”).

It can also be used to manage tinea pedis (also known as “athlete’s foot” and occurs in hot weather, with exposure to surface reservoirs and use of occlusive footwear) and cutaneous candidiasis (yeast infection of the skin).

Before applying KZ DUSTING POWDER inform your doctor if you have any skin problems or allergies. There is no adequate data available for use of KZ DUSTING POWDER in pregnancy. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

The safety and effectiveness of KZ DUSTING POWDER in children have not been established. Contact your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.

Introduction About SCABPER SOAP

SCABPER SOAP contains Permethrin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parasitic agents. It is used for the management of scabies and head lice.

Scabies is a condition that is caused by tiny insects called mites that infest and irritate the skin. Symptoms include severe itching, especially at nighttime along with raised rash or spots.

Before applying SCABPER SOAP inform your doctor if you are diagnosed with conditions such as asthma, skin diseases, allergies to certain food, medicines or other substances.

This medicine is safe for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. However, it is recommended to consult your doctor before applying it.

It is not recommended for use in children under 2 months of age. Contact your doctor before using.

Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs wash thoroughly with water. It is for external use only. Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

The most common side effects of using this medicine are mild sensation of burning, stinging or tingling, along with skin burns. It is recommended to consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

Used to manage scabies and head lice

Always apply SCABPER SOAP as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Gently rub to produce lather leave it for 5 minutes and then wash thoroughly with water or use as directed by your doctor. Check the label for directions before use.

name: Triben B Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About TRIBEN B LOTION

TRIBEN B LOTION is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. TRIBEN B LOTION is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

TRIBEN B LOTION is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying TRIBEN B LOTION, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

TRIBEN B LOTION should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRIBEN B LOTION
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIBEN B LOTION Works

TRIBEN B LOTION is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use TRIBEN B LOTION

Use TRIBEN B LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying TRIBEN B LOTION around your eyes, including eyelids.

name: Zoderm E Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About ZODERM E CREAM

ZODERM E CREAM contains Oxiconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used in the topical management of fungal skin infections (such as athlete’s foot, Jock itch, ringworm infection, pityriasis versicolor (small, discoloured patches on the skin)).

ZODERM E CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply to the affected skin areas. Do not cover the affected areas after applying this medicine.

Use ZODERM E CREAM for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2-4 weeks of therapy.

Before using ZODERM E CREAM inform your doctor if you are allergic to oxiconazole. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side-effects of using ZODERM E CREAM are irritation, burning sensation and/or redness at the site of application. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZODERM E CREAM
Manage fungal infections of the skin
mechanismOfAction:
How ZODERM E CREAM Works

ZODERM E CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections of the skin. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:
How to use ZODERM E CREAM

ZODERM E CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply to the affected skin areas.

Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes. Do not cover the affected area after applying this medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection. Do not stop using ZODERM E CREAM without consulting your doctor.

name: 8X Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About 8X CREAM

8X CREAM contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing an itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas and the inner thigh and characterized by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes), and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms, and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (a fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut, and vagina), tinea (pityriasis), and versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms, or legs).

8X CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

8X CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using 8X CREAM are itchiness, a mild burning sensation, or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea corporis, and tinea cruris
usesDetails:
Uses Of 8X CREAM

It is used for the topical management of the following fungal skin infections:

introduction:
Introduction About KZ XL CREAM

KZ XL CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KZ XL CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KZ XL CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KZ XL CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KZ XL CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KZ XL CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KZ XL CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KZ XL CREAM Works

KZ XL CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KZ XL CREAM

Apply KZ XL CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KZ XL CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KZ XL CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About GAMABION LOTION

GAMABION LOTION contains Cetrimide and Gamma benzene hexachloride, which belong to the group of medicines called Antiseptics and Antiparasitic drugs, respectively. It is used for the management of scabies (skin infection with itchy skin rashes caused by mites), pediculosis (infestation of scalp caused by eggs, larvae, or adults of lice), and lice.

It is advised to avoid person-to-person contact and sharing of clothes and utensils with infected persons to avoid the risk of spreading of scabies and lice. It is not recommended to use GAMABION LOTION if you have fits, allergies to any of its ingredients, open, broken, or cranky skin. Before using GAMABION LOTION, inform your doctor if you have HIV or AIDS, have a history of fits or conditions like a head injury, tumour in your brain or spinal cord, cirrhosis of the liver, or are heavy alcohol drinkers.

GAMABION LOTION is not recommended to be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless it is clearly necessary. Do not use GAMABION LOTION to manage a premature infant, young baby, or elderly patient. The most common side effects of using GAMABION LOTION include tingling, itching, burning in the skin, and skin rashes. Consult a doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

name: EBERNET + Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERNET + CREAM

EBERNET + CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERNET + CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERNET + CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERNET + CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERNET + CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERNET + CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERNET + CREAM

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERNET + CREAM Works

EBERNET + CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERNET + CREAM

Always use EBERNET + CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERNET + CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERNET + CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

introduction:
Introduction About LILITUF 50 CREAM

LILITUF 50 CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LILITUF 50 CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LILITUF 50 CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LILITUF 50 CREAM

LILITUF 50 CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LILITUF 50 CREAM Works

LILITUF 50 CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LILITUF 50 CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Micogel F Ointment 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About MICOGEL F OINTMENT

MICOGEL F OINTMENT is a combination of Fluocinolone and Miconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antifungals respectively. It is used to manage various skin infections athlete’s foot (Tinea pedis), ringworm (Tinea corporis), vaginal thrush, and sweat rash.

A fungal infection (also called mycosis) is a skin disease that is caused by a fungus when it enters the tissue. Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another person.

Avoid MICOGEL F OINTMENT contact with eyes. MICOGEL F OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients having rosacea (a skin condition that causes blushing or flushing and visible blood vessels in the face), acne, perioral dermatitis, anogenital pruritus, and napkin eruptions.

MICOGEL F OINTMENT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary.

MICOGEL F OINTMENT is not recommended in children and adolescents (below 12 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of MICOGEL F OINTMENT are application site reactions (like burning, irritation, itching, and redness). If any of these symptoms worsen, consult your physician.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MICOGEL F OINTMENT

It is used to manage skin infections such as:

Athlete’s foot (Tinea pedis)
Ringworm (Tinea corporis)
Vaginal thrush
Sweat rash
mechanismOfAction:
How MICOGEL F OINTMENT Works

MICOGEL F OINTMENT is a combination of Fluocinolone and Miconazole. Fluocinolone works by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen, and itchy. Miconazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering. Thus, both together Fluocinolone and Miconazole help to manage various skin infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MICOGEL F OINTMENT

Apply MICOGEL F OINTMENT as directed by your physician. Clean and dry the area which is affected before the application. It is for external use only. Wash hands before and after the application MICOGEL F OINTMENT. Your doctor will decide the right dose depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Mycoderm Lavender Antiseptic Powder 150gm
introduction:
Introduction About MYCODERM POWDER

Mycoderm Lavender Antiseptic Powder is an antiseptic, antifungal and keratolytic powder used in skin irritation and inflammation (like prickly heat), insect bites, fungal infections and eczema. It contains benzoic acid, salicylic acid and menthol as active ingredients that control fungal infection and itching.

Benzoic acid kills the bacteria and fungi that cause skin infections. Salicylic acid acts as a keratolytic agent which helps the body to shed rough and dead skin.

Benzoic acid and salicylic acid together manage skin irritation and inflammation. Menthol provides a cooling and soothing effect to the skin.

Apply Mycoderm Lavender Antiseptic Powder as directed by your doctor. Do not apply this powder on exudative lesions (wounds with fluid discharge). Inform your doctor if you are suffering from any skin problems or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. It is not recommended for use in children less than 18 years of age.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of MYCODERM POWDER

Mycoderm Lavender Antiseptic Powder may cause skin irritation and redness in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you experience any such symptoms while using it.

name: KETODAC Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETODAC CREAM

KETODAC CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KETODAC CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KETODAC CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KETODAC CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KETODAC CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KETODAC CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETODAC CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KETODAC CREAM Works

KETODAC CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KETODAC CREAM

Apply KETODAC CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KETODAC CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KETODAC CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

name: Surfaz Solution 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About SURFAZ SOLUTION

Surfaz Solution is an antifungal solution with super absorbent formula which helps to absorbs moisture. It is used as adjunct to manage fungal infection and manage its recurrence particularly in skin folds and where perspiration is a problem. As a maintenance therapy for tinea pedis, tinea cruris, diaper rash and other fungal infections of skin. It contains Clotrimazole as an active ingredient.

Clotrimazole acts primarily by damaging the permeability barrier in the cell membrane of the fungi by disrupting the production of the membranes that surrounds the fungal cells. It works by altering the fungal cell membrane by inhibiting certain enzymes, thereby clearing the infection and relieving the symptoms.

Always use Surfaz Solution as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. It should be used in the morning or night as directed by the physician. Do not use if you are allergic to Clotrimazole.

introduction:
Introduction About EBERCLIN CREAM

EBERCLIN CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERCLIN CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERCLIN CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERCLIN CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERCLIN CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERCLIN CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About KETONEXT 2% CREAM

KETONEXT 2% CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KETONEXT 2% CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KETONEXT 2% CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KETONEXT 2% CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KETONEXT 2% CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KETONEXT 2% CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETONEXT 2% CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KETONEXT 2% CREAM Works

KETONEXT 2% CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KETONEXT 2% CREAM

Apply KETONEXT 2% CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KETONEXT 2% CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KETONEXT 2% CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About FUNGICROS CREAM

FUNGICROS CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

FUNGICROS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

FUNGICROS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

FUNGICROS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying FUNGICROS CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.

FUNGICROS CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.

introduction:
Introduction About MYCOCLIN 2% CREAM

MYCOCLIN 2% CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use MYCOCLIN 2% CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. MYCOCLIN 2% CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MYCOCLIN 2% CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of MYCOCLIN 2% CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Lamifin Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About LAMIFIN CREAM

LAMIFIN CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

LAMIFIN CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use LAMIFIN CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using LAMIFIN CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LAMIFIN CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LAMIFIN CREAM Works

LAMIFIN CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

name: C Win Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About C WIN CREAM

C WIN CREAM contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing an itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas and the inner thigh and characterized by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes), and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms, and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (a fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut, and vagina), tinea (pityriasis), and versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms, or legs).

C WIN CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

C WIN CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using C WIN CREAM are itchiness, a mild burning sensation, or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

name: MOMETIDE Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About MOMETIDE CREAM

MOMETIDE CREAM contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. MOMETIDE CREAM is used in the management of inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses such as psoriasis and atopic dermatitis. It is also used to manage scalp psoriasis and seborrheic dermatitis.

Psoriasis is a type of skin disease that causes skin rash with itchy, scaly patches which most commonly occurs on the knees, elbows, trunk and scalp. Atopic dermatitis is a skin condition which makes your skin red and itchy. Scalp psoriasis is a common skin disorder that makes skin raised, reddish, often scaly on the scalp which can either occur as a single patch or several patches on the scalp. Seborrheic dermatitis is a common skin condition that affects your scalp which is characterized by red, and scaly patches of skin and dandruff.

Avoid applying MOMETIDE CREAM, if you have rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne (pimples), skin atrophy (thinning of the skin), dermatitis (skin inflammation) around the mouth, genital itching, viral infections such as shingles, chickenpox (viral infection), ulcerated skin, and wounds.

Before applying MOMETIDE CREAM, inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease. MOMETIDE CREAM should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before applying MOMETIDE CREAM.

The medicine is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor before applying MOMETIDE CREAM.

The most common side effects of using MOMETIDE CREAM are mild to moderate pruritus (itchy skin), burning and stinging sensation of skin, folliculitis (a type of skin infection marked by inflamed hair follicles), dryness of skin, mild skin atrophy (thin-shiny appearing skin). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPIZOL 1% CREAM

LUPIZOL 1% CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LUPIZOL 1% CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LUPIZOL 1% CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

LUPIZOL 1% CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LUPIZOL 1% CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: BELZOLE Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About BELZOLE CREAM

BELZOLE CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use BELZOLE CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying BELZOLE CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

BELZOLE CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. BELZOLE CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying BELZOLE CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BELZOLE CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How BELZOLE CREAM Works

BELZOLE CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use BELZOLE CREAM

Apply BELZOLE CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using BELZOLE CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using BELZOLE CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About SERTAMID CREAM

SERTAMID CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use SERTAMID CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. SERTAMID CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SERTAMID CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of SERTAMID CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: SCRABIC Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About SCRABIC CREAM

SCRABIC CREAM contains Permethrin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parasitic agents. It is indicated for the management of scabies, pediculosis (lice) and crab louse infections.

Scabies is a condition that cause itchy skin caused by a tiny burrowing mite called Sarcoptes scabiei. It can cause intense itching in the area where the mite burrows.

SCRABIC CREAM is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chrysanthemums (a flower). SCRABIC CREAM should be used with caution in patients having lung diseases and eczema (skin disease).

It is not recommended for use in infants below 2 months of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

SCRABIC CREAM is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult with your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using SCRABIC CREAM are itching, redness of skin, tingling, prickling, skin burning sensation and dry skin. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SCRABIC CREAM

Used to manage:

Scabies
Pediculosis
Crab louse infections
mechanismOfAction:
How SCRABIC CREAM Works

SCRABIC CREAM helps in managing scabies and head lice by acting on the nerve cells of the disease-causing organism and alters the movements of certain ions (sodium ions) which leads to loss of their function. This causes respiratory failure of the disease-causing organism and hence, their destruction.
usageDetails:
How to use SCRABIC CREAM

Always apply SCRABIC CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. The medicine should be applied on all the affected areas. Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Wash hands before and after the application of SCRABIC CREAM. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth.

introduction:
Introduction About MYCOCLIN B CREAM

MYCOCLIN B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Sertaconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antifungals respectively. It is used to manage fungal infections of the skin and skin folds in individuals with compromised immunity and in general. This medicine relieves itching, redness, irritation and swelling.

Avoid applying MYCOCLIN B CREAM, if you are allergic to beclomethasone, sertaconazole or other topical or oral corticosteroids, and or have skin atrophy, diabetes mellitus, glaucoma (eye disorder) or cataracts, active viral illnesses such as chicken pox, measles, infected skin lesions. tuberculous lesions of the skin, and or liver failure.

MYCOCLIN B CREAM is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years of age). Consult your doctor using this medicine.

The most common side effects of applying MYCOCLIN B CREAM are burning skin and tenderness at the site of application, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), and dry skin. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms gets worse.

Do not use this medicine on your face. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids.

introduction:
Introduction About LULISOL CREAM

LULISOL CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULISOL CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULISOL CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULISOL CREAM

LULISOL CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULISOL CREAM Works

LULISOL CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULISOL CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

introduction:

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

ROLFIN 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

ROLFIN 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

ROLFIN 0.25% CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

name: Kenz Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About KENZ CREAM

KENZ CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KENZ CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KENZ CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KENZ CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KENZ CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KENZ CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KENZ CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KENZ CREAM Works

KENZ CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KENZ CREAM

Apply KENZ CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KENZ CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KENZ CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.
