name: PLITE Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About PLITE CREAM

PLITE CREAM contains Permethrin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parasitic agents. It is indicated for the management of scabies, pediculosis (lice) and crab louse infections.

Scabies is a condition that cause itchy skin caused by a tiny burrowing mite called Sarcoptes scabiei. It can cause intense itching in the area where the mite burrows.

PLITE CREAM is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chrysanthemums (a flower). PLITE CREAM should be used with caution in patients having lung diseases and eczema (skin disease).

It is not recommended for use in infants below 2 months of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

PLITE CREAM is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult with your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using PLITE CREAM are itching, redness of skin, tingling, prickling, skin burning sensation and dry skin. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PLITE CREAM

Used to manage:

Scabies
Pediculosis
Crab louse infections
mechanismOfAction:
How PLITE CREAM Works

PLITE CREAM helps in managing scabies and head lice by acting on the nerve cells of the disease-causing organism and alters the movements of certain ions (sodium ions) which leads to loss of their function. This causes respiratory failure of the disease-causing organism and hence, their destruction.
usageDetails:
How to use PLITE CREAM

Always apply PLITE CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. The medicine should be applied on all the affected areas. Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Wash hands before and after the application of PLITE CREAM. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth.

Introduction About LULIRX CREAM

LULIRX CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIRX CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TRUCONA I DUSTING POWDER

TRUCONA I DUSTING POWDER is used to manage fungal skin infections such as tinea corporis (ring worm of the body), tinea cruris (fungal infection in the skin of the genitals, inner thighs, and buttocks), tinea pedis (fungal infection that usually begins between the toes), tinea versicolor (fungal infection that causes small, discoloured skin patches), and onychomycosis (nail infection) in affected individuals. It is also used to soothe irritated skin and provide relief from fungal itch in affected individuals. 

It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Patients allergic to itraconazole should not use TRUCONA I DUSTING POWDER. It is not recommended for use in pregnant women, and this medicine should be used with caution in breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor. 

The most common side effects associated with the use of TRUCONA I DUSTING POWDER are skin irritation, rashes, burning sensation, redness, or itching at the application site. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRUCONA I DUSTING POWDER
Fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TRUCONA I DUSTING POWDER Works

TRUCONA I DUSTING POWDER works by inhibiting ergosterol synthesis (an organic compound responsible for maintaining cell membrane integrity of fungi cells) that leads to fungal cell membrane abnormalities (marked with increased permeability and disruption of fungi cells), thus causing destruction to the fungi cell and managing the occurrence of fungal infections in affected individuals.

It is for external use only.
Clean and wipe to dry the affected area before applying the medicine.
Sprinkle enough powder over the infected area.
Avoid rubbing it and avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, nose, and ears.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency, and duration of TRUCONA I DUSTING POWDER for you depending upon your age and type or severity of the infection.

name: Selsun Topical Suspension 120ml
introduction:
Introduction About SELSUN SUSPENSION

Selsun Suspension is an antifungal preparation used to manage and control dandruff and tinea versicolor (a common fungal infection causing small, discoloured patches of skin). It contains selenium as an active ingredient which acts by slowing down the cell growth of the scalp layer that cause dandruff.

Selenium Disulfide exerts a cytostatic (inhibits the cell growth) effect on follicular epithelium and epidermis cells, which decreases the production of corneocytes (cells which produce outer layer of the skin). As a result, it relieves itching and flaking of the scalp and removes the dry, scaly particles.

Always use Selsun Suspension as directed by the physician. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. It should not be used when acute inflammation or exudation (oozing out) is present.

Selsun Suspension should not be used for the management of tinea versicolor during pregnancy. Safety and effectiveness in infants have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

name: Lulibet 1% Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIBET 1% CREAM

LULIBET 1% CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIBET 1% CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIBET 1% CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIBET 1% CREAM

LULIBET 1% CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIBET 1% CREAM Works

LULIBET 1% CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIBET 1% CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: OXICOJEN Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About OXICOJEN CREAM

OXICOJEN CREAM contains Oxiconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used in the topical management of fungal skin infections (such as athlete’s foot, Jock itch, ringworm infection, pityriasis versicolor (small, discoloured patches on the skin)).

OXICOJEN CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply to the affected skin areas. Do not cover the affected areas after applying this medicine.

Use OXICOJEN CREAM for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2-4 weeks of therapy.

Before using OXICOJEN CREAM inform your doctor if you are allergic to oxiconazole. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side-effects of using OXICOJEN CREAM are irritation, burning sensation and/or redness at the site of application. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin
usesDetails:
Uses Of OXICOJEN CREAM
Manage fungal infections of the skin
mechanismOfAction:
How OXICOJEN CREAM Works

OXICOJEN CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections of the skin. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:
How to use OXICOJEN CREAM

OXICOJEN CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply to the affected skin areas.

Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes. Do not cover the affected area after applying this medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection. Do not stop using OXICOJEN CREAM without consulting your doctor.
sideEffects: Application site reactions (such as burning, itching or irritation)
Severe skin irritation with papules, inflammation, blistering of skin, swelling or oozing

Severe skin irritation with papules, inflammation, blistering of skin, swelling or oozing

introduction:
Introduction About MOMEREX F CREAM

MOMEREX F CREAM is a combination of Fusidic acid and Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents and Corticosteroids, respectively. MOMEREX F CREAM is used to manage inflammatory dermatoses (lesions/eruptions of skin) with/without bacterial infection in affected individuals.

MOMEREX F CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Fusidic acid, Mometasone, and/or other topical/oral corticosteroids. Before applying MOMEREX F CREAM, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, glaucoma, infection at/near management site, active viral illnesses (such as chicken pox / measles), and/or suffer from liver failure.

[GBNKEYWORD is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of applying MOMEREX F CREAM are mild to moderate pruritus (itchy skin), burning/stinging sensation of skin, folliculitis (inflamed hair follicles), dry skin, mild skin atrophy, and/or telangiectasia (dilated small blood vessels on skin). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage inflammatory dermatoses (lesions/eruptions of skin) with/without bacterial infection in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of MOMEREX F CREAM
Manage inflammatory dermatoses (lesions/eruptions of skin) with/without bacterial infection in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How MOMEREX F CREAM Works

MOMEREX F CREAM manages inflammatory dermatoses, where mometasone furoate manages inflammation by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy, and fusidic acid manages the growth of bacteria and causes its destruction by inhibiting the synthesis of essential proteins that are essential for the bacteria to grow thus managing inflammatory dermatoses in affected individuals.

Always apply MOMEREX F CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Do not use this medicine on your face. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids.

name: LULIFORD Dusting Powder 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIFORD DUSTING POWDER

LULIFORD DUSTING POWDER is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection). Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another.

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal Agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIFORD DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant and should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary.

LULIFORD DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age unless clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIFORD DUSTING POWDER to the eyes, mouth, or nose. The most common side effects of this medicine are dry skin, blisters on the skin, application site reactions (burning, irritation, itching, and redness), and skin peeling. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIFORD DUSTING POWDER

LULIFORD DUSTING POWDER is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIFORD DUSTING POWDER Works

LULIFORD DUSTING POWDER works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and killing fungi. As a result, LULIFORD DUSTING POWDER relieves discomfort, itching, and irritation on the skin.

introduction:
Introduction About KEVON ZIP LOTION

KEVON ZIP LOTION contains Ketoconazole and Zinc pyrithione which belong to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used to manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection causing dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body).

Before using KEVON ZIP LOTION, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, or if you are using any steroids. KEVON ZIP LOTION can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice.

KEVON ZIP LOTION is not recommended for use in infants and children. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, wash eyes thoroughly with water. Call your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.
uses: To manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis

Use KEVON ZIP LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wet your hair and scalp and apply sufficient KEVON ZIP LOTION to produce enough lather. Massage for one minute to produce enough lather and keep it for 5 minutes.

If KEVON ZIP LOTION accidentally gets in your eye, wash your eyes with water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Ebernet Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERNET CREAM

EBERNET CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERNET CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERNET CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERNET CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERNET CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERNET CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERNET CREAM

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERNET CREAM Works

EBERNET CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:

Always use EBERNET CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERNET CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERNET CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

name: AMOCOP Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMOCOP CREAM

AMOCOP CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMOCOP CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMOCOP CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMOCOP CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMOCOP CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMOCOP CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How AMOCOP CREAM Works

AMOCOP CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AMOCOP CREAM

Apply AMOCOP CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AMOCOP CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About CIVADERM CREAM

CIVADERM CREAM contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing an itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas and the inner thigh and characterized by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes), and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms, and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (a fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut, and vagina), tinea (pityriasis), and versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms, or legs).

CIVADERM CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

CIVADERM CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using CIVADERM CREAM are itchiness, a mild burning sensation, or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

name: IVERNOL Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About IVERNOL CREAM

IVERNOL CREAM contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used in adults (18 years or older) to manage pimples and spots on the skin found with rosacea. Rosacea is defined as a skin condition that causes blushing or flushing and visible blood vessels in your face. It may also induce small and pus-filled bumps.        

IVERNOL CREAM should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. It is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before applying this medicine.             

The safety and efficacy of IVERNOL CREAM in children and adolescents (18 years or less) have not been established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.       

The most common side effect of applying IVERNOL CREAM is a burning feeling of the skin. Consult your doctor if the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:

IVERNOL CREAM has anti-inflammatory effect against rosacea and helps to kill the causative agent (demodex mites) improving clinical signs and symptoms in the skin.

Always apply IVERNOL CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a pea-size amount of the medicine to each of the five areas of the face: forehead, chin, nose and each cheek. Then spread as a thin layer across the entire face. Wash your hands after applying this medicine. Avoid applying it around your eyes, lips and inside the nose and mouth. Your doctor will decide the dose, duration and frequency of management for you depending upon severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About LULIMAC XL CREAM

LULIMAC XL CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIMAC XL CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIMAC XL CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIMAC XL CREAM

LULIMAC XL CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIMAC XL CREAM Works

LULIMAC XL CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIMAC XL CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Introduction About NOVALE BAR

NOVALE BAR contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

NOVALE BAR can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using NOVALE BAR, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. NOVALE BAR should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of NOVALE BAR in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with NOVALE BAR are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TEXIFEN SPRAY

TEXIFEN SPRAY is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TEXIFEN SPRAY is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TEXIFEN SPRAY if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TEXIFEN SPRAY are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:

Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TEXIFEN SPRAY Works

TEXIFEN SPRAY is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

name: Phytoral Bar 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About PHYTORAL BAR

Phytoral Bar is an anti-fungal and anti-microbial soap that is used to manage various fungal skin infections caused such as those occurring at feet (tinea pedis), intimate regions of groin, perineal and perineum areas (tinea cruris), and at any part of the body (tinea corporis) caused by Trichophyton rubrum, Trichophyton mentagrophytes and Epidermophyton floccosum.

It can also be used for the topical management of cutaneous candidiasis. It contains ketoconazole and triclosan as active ingredients that helps control fungal infections.

Ketoconazole helps with the interruption in making of ergosterol (an essential component of fungal cell membranes), that disrupts the fungal cell membrane. Triclosan acts as an anti-bacterial agent that kills the microbes and other germs on skin, thus keeping the skin surface free of germs.

Always use Phytoral Bar as directed by your doctor. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes. Ask your doctor before using Phytoral Bar during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Safety and effectiveness in children have not been established so consult your child’s doctor before using it.

introduction:
Introduction About NUFORCE POWDER

NUFORCE POWDER contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It also relives symptoms such as burning, itching, skin cracking, and discomfort caused by the skin infections. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin, causing redness and itching. An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes.

Clotrimazole works by blocking the fungal growth and managing the further occurrence of fungal infections. NUFORCE POWDER is intended to manage fungal skin infections; hence, it should not be used for other infections of internal organs. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with NUFORCE POWDER.

NUFORCE POWDER is not recommended for patients allergic to clotrimazole. NUFORCE POWDER is not recommended for use in deep wounds and severe burns. NUFORCE POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Before taking NUFORCE POWDER, inform your doctor if you’re under any medications.

NUFORCE POWDER works by managing the fungal growth. Clotrimazole works by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: Gbhc Lotion 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About GBHC LOTION

GBHC Lotion is a Skin Care Solution used to manage pediculosis (a disease caused due to infestation head and body of a human louse) and scabies. It contains Lindane as active ingredients that help in optimizing the skin health.

Lindane (gamma benzene hexachloride) tends to exhibit scabicidal activities by getting directly absorbed into the parasite's body and their eggs. There it binds to certain receptors and result in death of the parasite.

Always use GBHC Lotion as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Do not exceed its recommended daily usage. Shake well before use. Do not swallow GBHC Lotion as it can be fatal. It is not recommended for use in neonates and should be used with caution in children and adults weighing less than 50kg.

For scabies, take a warm water bath using soap. Allow the skin to dry and cool, apply GBHC Lotion on the whole body in thin layers from neck and down. Allow GBHC Lotion to stay for at least 12 hours and then rinse it off by bathing.

Introduction About LENIN 1% CREAM

LENIN 1% CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LENIN 1% CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LENIN 1% CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

LENIN 1% CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LENIN 1% CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: Keto Medicated Soap 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETO SOAP

KETO SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

KETO SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using KETO SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. KETO SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of KETO SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with KETO SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections

mechanismOfAction:
How KETO SOAP Works

KETO SOAP clears the infection by causing holes in the fungal cell membranes, thus killing the fungi.
usageDetails:
How to use KETO SOAP

Always apply KETO SOAP as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply KETO SOAP on the affected area. It can be applied on the body and scalp. Wash and rinse thoroughly with water after applying KETO SOAP. Avoid contact of KETO SOAP with the nose, mouth or eyes.

If KETO SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LULY 1%W/W CREAM

LULY 1%W/W CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULY 1%W/W CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULY 1%W/W CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULY 1%W/W CREAM

LULY 1%W/W CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULY 1%W/W CREAM Works

LULY 1%W/W CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULY 1%W/W CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: AMROFAST Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMROFAST CREAM

AMROFAST CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROFAST CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROFAST CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROFAST CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROFAST CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMROFAST CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How AMROFAST CREAM Works

AMROFAST CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AMROFAST CREAM

Apply AMROFAST CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AMROFAST CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About LULIPEX CREAM

LULIPEX CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIPEX CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIPEX CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIPEX CREAM

LULIPEX CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIPEX CREAM Works

LULIPEX CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIPEX CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

introduction:
Introduction About DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER

DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It also relives symptoms such as burning, itching, skin cracking, and discomfort caused by the skin infections. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin, causing redness and itching. An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes.

Clotrimazole works by blocking the fungal growth and managing the further occurrence of fungal infections. DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER is intended to manage fungal skin infections; hence, it should not be used for other infections of internal organs. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER.

DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for patients allergic to clotrimazole. DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in deep wounds and severe burns. DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Before taking DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER, inform your doctor if you’re under any medications.

mechanismOfAction:
How DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER Works

DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER works by managing the fungal growth. Clotrimazole works by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Always apply DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Do not take DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER orally. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER. Before using the DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER on the affected area, wash it thoroughly and make sure it is dry before using DERMIGO DUSTING POWDER.

name: Candid Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About CANDID LOTION

Candid Lotion is an Anti-fungal Lotion used for fungal infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot (fungal foot infection), fungal nappy rash and fungal sweat rash. It provides relief from inflammation and itching caused by fungal infections. It contains Clotrimazole as an active ingredient which is effective in inhibiting infection-causing fungus.

Clotrimazole acts as an anti-fungal agent by stopping the synthesis of ergosterol which is a key component of the fungal cell membrane and further inhibits growth of fungal cells.

Candid Lotion is for external use only. Apply this Lotion as directed by your doctor or 2-3 times a day. Apply a thin and uniform layer of this lotion to the affected area gently. Avoid applying Candid Lotion near the eyes or mouth and in case of accidental contact with the eyes or mouth rinse with water thoroughly. Do not use if you are allergic to Clotrimazole.

introduction:
Introduction About SERTAMID CREAM

SERTAMID CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use SERTAMID CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. SERTAMID CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SERTAMID CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of SERTAMID CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

TERZIDE 1.0% CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERZIDE 1.0% CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERZIDE 1.0% CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.

name: LUBACT Soap 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About LUBACT SOAP

LUBACT SOAP is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (occurs as a red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection). Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another.

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal Agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LUBACT SOAP is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant, and it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. This medicine is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age unless necessary. LUBACT SOAP should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

Avoid applying LUBACT SOAP to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUBACT SOAP

LUBACT SOAP is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Thrush
Dry, flaky skin
mechanismOfAction:
How LUBACT SOAP Works

LUBACT SOAP works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and killing fungi. As a result, LUBACT SOAP relieves discomfort, itching, and irritation on the skin.

Your doctor will decide the dosage and frequency based on the intensity of the fungal infection and other relevant conditions.

name: OLTEF VG Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About OLTEF VG GEL

OLTEF VG GEL contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in the management of fungal skin infections such as ringworm (fungal infection of the skin or scalp), athlete’s foot (fungal infection between the toes), fungal nappy rash (skin rash affecting the nappy area), and fungal sweat rash. It also relieves irritation of the vulva (external thrush) or at the end of the penis, which may be associated with thrush.

Before applying OLTEF VG GEL, inform your doctor about your previous existing disease conditions. OLTEF VG GEL is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to clotrimazole. Avoid smoking or going near flames and wearing fabrics that catch fire easily due to the increased risk of severe burns.

OLTEF VG GEL can be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Avoid using latex contraceptives (condoms or diaphragms), as this medicine may reduce the effectiveness of such contraceptives. Use alternative precautions for at least five days after using the medicine. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual effects.
uses: Manage fungal skin infections (such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, fungal nappy rash, and sweat rash)
Relieves irritation of the vulva or at the end of the penis (which may be associated with thrush)
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How OLTEF VG GEL Works

OLTEF VG GEL acts by specifically inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol and other sterols (enzymes) required for cell membrane production; therefore, it inhibits the division and growth of fungi, eventually leading to cell death, which further manages fungal growth.
usageDetails:
How to use OLTEF VG GEL

Always apply OLTEF VG GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected surface before applying the medicine. Apply and rub gently a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Do not use OLTEF VG GEL on your face, eyes, or large area. Do not use under bandages or for a long time without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the duration and time interval for application depending on the type of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About ELMOVEL TF GEL

ELMOVEL TF GEL is a combination of Mometasone and Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical corticosteroids and Antifungals, respectively. ELMOVEL TF GEL is used to manage fungal skin infections associated with inflammation and itching.

A fungal infection is a type of skin disease caused by a fungus which is a microorganism that invades the tissue and cause disease that's confined to the skin and spreads into tissue, bones, organs and other parts of the body with symptoms generally including skin rash or vaginal infection resulting in abnormal discharge.

Avoid using ELMOVEL TF GEL, if you have rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne (pimples), skin atrophy (thinning of the skin), genital itching, nappy rash, shingles (viral infection), warts (type of skin infection) and ulcerated skin.

Before using ELMOVEL TF GEL, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin rash) or any other skin problems. This medicine is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

ELMOVEL TF GEL is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). The most common side effects of using ELMOVEL TF GEL are skin peeling and itching. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.
uses: Manage fungal infection associated with inflammation and itching
usesDetails:

Manage fungal infection associated with inflammation and itching
mechanismOfAction:
How ELMOVEL TF GEL Works

ELMOVEL TF GEL is used to manage fungal skin infections, where mometasone reduces the redness and itchiness of skin by blocking the production of chemical messenger, prostaglandin which is responsible for causing redness and itchiness of skin and terbinafine causes destruction of fungi by forming holes in the cell membrane of fungi which results in the degradation of fungi cell thereby causing its destruction and providing relief from the infection.
usageDetails:

Always apply ELMOVEL TF GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Managed areas need not be covered with plaster or bandage. Your doctor will decide the duration and frequency of using this medicine depending upon severity of the infection.

name: FLUMET Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About FLUMET GEL

FLUMET GEL contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage dermal fungal infections (dermatomycosis) caused by dermatophytes, yeasts, and moulds such as tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea corporis (ring worm), tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash), and tinea versicolor.

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot) is a fungal infection that begins between toes generally in people whose feet remain sweaty. It is characterized by symptoms such as scaly rashes, itching, stinging, and burning between toes. Tinea corporis (ring worm) is a fungal infection causing circular itchy rashes with clearer skin in the middle, resembling a ring.

Tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) or jock itch is a fungal infection characterized by red and itchy rashes in the moist areas of the body such as groin. Tinea versicolor is a fungal infection that is characterized by abnormal skin pigmentation such as light and dark patches at the affected area.

Before using FLUMET GEL inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver, heart, and lung problems. FLUMET GEL is not recommended to use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. FLUMET GEL can be used in children and adolescents. Consult with your child’s doctor before using it for your child.

There is no information on the use of FLUMET GEL in elderly patients. Consult with your doctor before using. The most common side effects of using FLUMET GEL are skin rash, irritation, dryness or cracking of the surrounding area, itchiness and burning sensation at the site of application. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen or persists.

FLUMET GEL helps in manage fungal infection where Fluconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the killing the fungal cell bodies.

name: Luliact Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIACT CREAM

LULIACT CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIACT CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIACT CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIACT CREAM

LULIACT CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIACT CREAM Works

LULIACT CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIACT CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Sebifin Plus Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM

SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM is a combination of Mometasone and Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical corticosteroids and Antifungals, respectively. SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections associated with inflammation and itching.

A fungal infection is a type of skin disease caused by a fungus which is a microorganism that invades the tissue and cause disease that's confined to the skin and spreads into tissue, bones, organs and other parts of the body with symptoms generally including skin rash or vaginal infection resulting in abnormal discharge.

Avoid using SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM, if you have rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne (pimples), skin atrophy (thinning of the skin), genital itching, nappy rash, shingles (viral infection), warts (type of skin infection) and ulcerated skin.

Before using SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin rash) or any other skin problems. This medicine is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). The most common side effects of using SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM are skin peeling and itching. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.
uses: Manage fungal infection associated with inflammation and itching
usesDetails:
Uses Of SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM
Manage fungal infection associated with inflammation and itching
mechanismOfAction:
How SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM Works

SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections, where mometasone reduces the redness and itchiness of skin by blocking the production of chemical messenger, prostaglandin which is responsible for causing redness and itchiness of skin and terbinafine causes destruction of fungi by forming holes in the cell membrane of fungi which results in the degradation of fungi cell thereby causing its destruction and providing relief from the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM

Always apply SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Managed areas need not be covered with plaster or bandage. Your doctor will decide the duration and frequency of using this medicine depending upon severity of the infection.
sideEffects: Pain and irritation at the applied site

SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. Consult your doctor before using SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM.
SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Mometasone or Terbinafine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Have rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face)
Have acne (pimples), skin atrophy (thinning of the skin)
Have dermatitis (skin inflammation) around the mouth
Have genital itching, nappy rash
Have cold sores
Have chickenpox, shingles (viral infection)
Have warts (type of skin infection caused by human papillomavirus (HPV)
Have ulcerated skin

 

Before using SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM, inform your doctor if you:

Have psoriasis (type of skin disease marked by rash, scaly, itchy skin)

SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before using SEBIFIN PLUS CREAM.

name: ASCABIOL Emulsion 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About ASCABIOL EMULSION

ASCABIOL EMULSION contains Cetrimide and Gamma benzene hexachloride, which belong to the group of medicines called Antiseptics and Antiparasitic drugs, respectively. It is used for the management of scabies (skin infection with itchy skin rashes caused by mites), pediculosis (infestation of scalp caused by eggs, larvae, or adults of lice), and lice.

It is advised to avoid person-to-person contact and sharing of clothes and utensils with infected persons to avoid the risk of spreading of scabies and lice. It is not recommended to use ASCABIOL EMULSION if you have fits, allergies to any of its ingredients, open, broken, or cranky skin. Before using ASCABIOL EMULSION, inform your doctor if you have HIV or AIDS, have a history of fits or conditions like a head injury, tumour in your brain or spinal cord, cirrhosis of the liver, or are heavy alcohol drinkers.

ASCABIOL EMULSION is not recommended to be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless it is clearly necessary. Do not use ASCABIOL EMULSION to manage a premature infant, young baby, or elderly patient. The most common side effects of using ASCABIOL EMULSION include tingling, itching, burning in the skin, and skin rashes. Consult a doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Scabies (skin infection with itchy skin rashes caused by mites)
Pediculosis (infestation of the scalp caused by eggs, larvae, or adults of lice)

mechanismOfAction:
How ASCABIOL EMULSION Works

ASCABIOL EMULSION contains cetrimide and Gamma benzene hexachloride. Cetrimide is an antiseptic agent that kills disease-causing bacteria. Gamma benzene hexachloride is an insecticide that kills insects by damaging the brains of mites.
usageDetails:
How to use ASCABIOL EMULSION

Apply ASCABIOL EMULSION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Shake well before use. Wash your hands before applying ASCABIOL EMULSION. Take adequate amounts of medicine and apply on affected areas (apply on the entire body in cases of scabies). Wash off completely with warm water after 8–12 hours.

Read the instructions within the label before using the medicine. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, and mouth. Avoid making your skin too oily by applying creams while using ASCABIOL EMULSION. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Lulimac Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIMAC CREAM

LULIMAC CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIMAC CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIMAC CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIMAC CREAM

LULIMAC CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIMAC CREAM Works

LULIMAC CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIMAC CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Amrosys Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMROSYS CREAM

AMROSYS CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROSYS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROSYS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROSYS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROSYS CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMROSYS CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How AMROSYS CREAM Works

AMROSYS CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:

Apply AMROSYS CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AMROSYS CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About EBERNET M CREAM

EBERNET M CREAM is a combination of Eberconazole and Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used to manage fungal infections of the skin folds and skin in those individuals who have compromised immunity and in general.

EBERNET M CREAM is not recommended for use in conditions like rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne, dermatitis around the mouth, thinning of the skin, genital itching, nappy rash, cold sores, warts, ulcerated skin, shingles, chickenpox, wounds and other skin infections. Before using EBERNET M CREAM inform your doctor if you are taking or using any other medicines including prescription or non-prescription medicines to manage the risk of any unusual effects.  

EBERNET M CREAM should not be used in pregnant and breast-feeding women and in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine. The most common side effects of using EBERNET M CREAM are itching and skin redness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How EBERNET M CREAM Works

EBERNET M CREAM helps in managing fungal infections of the skin where Eberconazole is an Antifungal medicine which works by stopping the growth of fungi by binding to certain receptors that stop the formation of fungal hormone (ergosterol). Due to the lack of the hormone ergosterol, the fungi are not able to survive. Mometasone inhibits the substances that cause inflammation such as prostaglandins and leukotrienes and helps relieving the inflammation.
usageDetails:

Always apply EBERNET M CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. A thin layer of the medicine has to be applied on the affected area. Use this medicine for time it has been prescribed by your doctor even if your symptoms start getting better. Managed areas need not be covered with plaster or bandage. Wash hands before and after the application of EBERNET M CREAM. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency and duration of EBERNET M CREAM for you depending upon your age and severity of the condition.

name: LULIRX Cream 60gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIRX CREAM

LULIRX CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIRX CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIRX CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIRX CREAM

LULIRX CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIRX CREAM Works

LULIRX CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIRX CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLE F LOTION

ZOLE F LOTION is a combination of Fluocinolone and Miconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antifungals respectively. It is used to manage various skin infections athlete’s foot (Tinea pedis), ringworm (Tinea corporis), vaginal thrush, and sweat rash.

A fungal infection (also called mycosis) is a skin disease that is caused by a fungus when it enters the tissue. Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another person.

Avoid ZOLE F LOTION contact with eyes. ZOLE F LOTION is not recommended for use in patients having rosacea (a skin condition that causes blushing or flushing and visible blood vessels in the face), acne, perioral dermatitis, anogenital pruritus, and napkin eruptions.

ZOLE F LOTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary.

ZOLE F LOTION is not recommended in children and adolescents (below 12 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of ZOLE F LOTION are application site reactions (like burning, irritation, itching, and redness). If any of these symptoms worsen, consult your physician.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOLE F LOTION

It is used to manage skin infections such as:

Athlete’s foot (Tinea pedis)
Ringworm (Tinea corporis)
Vaginal thrush
Sweat rash
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLE F LOTION Works

ZOLE F LOTION is a combination of Fluocinolone and Miconazole. Fluocinolone works by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen, and itchy. Miconazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering. Thus, both together Fluocinolone and Miconazole help to manage various skin infections.

Wash hands before and after the application ZOLE F LOTION. Your doctor will decide the right dose depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: KEZRIN B Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About KEZRIN B CREAM

KEZRIN B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole, which belong to the groups of medicines called Anti-inflammatory and Antifungal respectively. It is used to manage different kinds of fungal infections like Tinea corporis (Ringworm), Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp).

These fungal infections can spread easily from one person to another and cause redness and itching in the affected area. They are usually seen in moist and sweaty areas of the body as tinea pedis is usually seen in between the toes due to fitting shoes whereas tinea cruris and groin are seen in the inner thigh region.

Avoid applying KEZRIN B CREAM on the skin surface that is cut, scraped, sunburned, or eczema affected. KEZRIN B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients suffering from skin-related viral infections, tuberculosis, acne rosacea, and perioral dermatitis.

KEZRIN B CREAM should be used with caution in pregnancy and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. KEZRIN B CREAM is not recommended for use in children 9 years of age and below. KEZRIN B CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KEZRIN B CREAM

Manages fungal infections such as:

Ringworm (Tinea corporis)
Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp)
mechanismOfAction:
How KEZRIN B CREAM Works

KEZRIN B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole. Beclomethasone is a corticosteroid that works by reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms like itching, redness, irritation, and swelling by blocking the enzymes responsible for causing it (prostaglandins and leukotrienes). Ketoconazole is an imidazole that blocks the synthesis of ergosterol, a key component of the fungal cell membrane, thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use KEZRIN B CREAM

Apply KEZRIN B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean the skin and dry the skin area to be managed. Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, or inside the vagina. Do not cover or wrap or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About SOLTRIMA 1% DUSTING POWDER

SOLTRIMA 1% DUSTING POWDER contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It also relives symptoms such as burning, itching, skin cracking, and discomfort caused by the skin infections. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin, causing redness and itching. An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes.

Clotrimazole works by blocking the fungal growth and managing the further occurrence of fungal infections. SOLTRIMA 1% DUSTING POWDER is intended to manage fungal skin infections; hence, it should not be used for other infections of internal organs. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with SOLTRIMA 1% DUSTING POWDER.

SOLTRIMA 1% DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for patients allergic to clotrimazole. SOLTRIMA 1% DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in deep wounds and severe burns. SOLTRIMA 1% DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Before taking SOLTRIMA 1% DUSTING POWDER, inform your doctor if you’re under any medications.

introduction:
Introduction About KETOVATE CREAM

Ketovate Cream is an antifungal cream used to manage fungal and yeast infections of the skin in adults. It contains ketoconazole as an active ingredient which helps manage a wide range of fungal infections of the skin.

Ketoconazole manages the growth of various types of fungi by managing the ergosterol synthesis which damages the cell membranes of the fungus. As a result, it kills the fungus or yeast that caused the infection when applied to the infected area of the skin.

Apply Ketovate Cream as advised by your doctor. It is only for external usage. Do not swallow it. Avoid contact with eyes, eyelids, and mucous membranes of the body. Stop using it if any skin irritation occurs.

Ketovate Cream may cause burning sensation, bleeding, discomfort, dryness, inflammation and tingling in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while using it.

name: SURFAZ Dusting Powder 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About SURFAZ DUSTING POWDER

Surfaz Dusting Powder is an Anti-fungal powder used for the management of various fungal skin infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot (fungal foot infection), Jock’s itch and fungal sweat rash (prickly heat). Surfaz Dusting Powder is particularly indicated to manage reinfection in patients who sweat excessively, diabetic patients, or those patients who live in hot and humid conditions.

Surfaz Dusting Powder is indicated as an adjunct to other anti-fungal managements such as creams and sprays to manage reinfection. It contains Clotrimazole as an active ingredient which is effective in killing and inhibiting infection-causing fungus.

Clotrimazole acts as an anti-fungal agent by stopping the synthesis of ergosterol which is a key component of the fungal cell membrane. By doing so clotrimazole stops the further growth of fungal cells.

Always use Surfaz Dusting Powder as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Apply this Surfaz Dusting Powder over the affected area as directed by your doctor or 2 times a day. Before applying it to your feet wash and dry your feet thoroughly, especially between your toes.
