introduction:
Introduction About AMROLSTAR CREAM

AMROLSTAR CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROLSTAR CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLSTAR CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLSTAR CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROLSTAR CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.

How AMROLSTAR CREAM Works

AMROLSTAR CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.

introduction:
Introduction About LULIZ CREAM

LULIZ CREAM contains Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body) and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection). Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another person.

LULIZ CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. LULIZ CREAM is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. LULIZ CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

Avoid applying LULIZ CREAM to the eyes, mouth or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIZ CREAM Works

LULIZ CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and killing fungi. As a result, LULIZ CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Do not cover or wrap or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use SERTALIN CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. SERTALIN CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SERTALIN CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

introduction:
Introduction About TERADERM CREAM

TERADERM CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERADERM CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERADERM CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERADERM CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.

Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERADERM CREAM Works

TERADERM CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About EVAKLIN MEDICATED WASH

Evaklin Medicated Wash is an Alpha Hydroxy Acid used in females to manage vaginal itching, dryness and irritation, Unpleasant odour and vaginal infection. It also helps in maintaining vaginal flora. It contains Lactic acid as an active ingredient.

Lactic acid helps in managing vaginal infections and maintaining vaginal help by restoring the healthy pH balance of the vagina i.e., 3.8-4.5. This acidic pH promotes the growth of good bacteria known as lactobacilli which as a result creates an acidic environment and manage the growth of harmful bacteria and fungi. It also maintains vaginal moisture and manages dryness and itching.

Evaklin medicated wash is for external use only. Use as advised by your doctor or use daily. Take a few drops of Evaklin medicated wash and apply on the intimate area and wash away. You can use it during your periods as well. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant, planning a pregnancy or breastfeeding before using Evaklin medicated wash. Do use Evaklin medicated wash for children. The most common side effects after using Evaklin medicated wash are a Burning sensation, redness, itching, roughness, irritation, and stinging.

introduction:
Introduction About LAMIFIN M CREAM

LAMIFIN M CREAM is a combination of Mometasone and Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical corticosteroids and Antifungals, respectively. LAMIFIN M CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections associated with inflammation and itching.

A fungal infection is a type of skin disease caused by a fungus which is a microorganism that invades the tissue and cause disease that's confined to the skin and spreads into tissue, bones, organs and other parts of the body with symptoms generally including skin rash or vaginal infection resulting in abnormal discharge.

Avoid using LAMIFIN M CREAM, if you have rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne (pimples), skin atrophy (thinning of the skin), genital itching, nappy rash, shingles (viral infection), warts (type of skin infection) and ulcerated skin.

Before using LAMIFIN M CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin rash) or any other skin problems. This medicine is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

LAMIFIN M CREAM is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). The most common side effects of using LAMIFIN M CREAM are skin peeling and itching. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.
uses: Manage fungal infection associated with inflammation and itching
usesDetails:
Uses Of LAMIFIN M CREAM
Manage fungal infection associated with inflammation and itching
mechanismOfAction:
How LAMIFIN M CREAM Works

LAMIFIN M CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections, where mometasone reduces the redness and itchiness of skin by blocking the production of chemical messenger, prostaglandin which is responsible for causing redness and itchiness of skin and terbinafine causes destruction of fungi by forming holes in the cell membrane of fungi which results in the degradation of fungi cell thereby causing its destruction and providing relief from the infection.

name: LULIBET Lotion 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About LULIBET LOTION

LULIBET LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIBET LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIBET LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIBET LOTION

LULIBET LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIBET LOTION Works

LULIBET LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIBET LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About EBERFINE M CREAM

EBERFINE M CREAM is a combination of Eberconazole and Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used to manage fungal infections of the skin folds and skin in those individuals who have compromised immunity and in general.

EBERFINE M CREAM is not recommended for use in conditions like rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne, dermatitis around the mouth, thinning of the skin, genital itching, nappy rash, cold sores, warts, ulcerated skin, shingles, chickenpox, wounds and other skin infections. Before using EBERFINE M CREAM inform your doctor if you are taking or using any other medicines including prescription or non-prescription medicines to manage the risk of any unusual effects.  

EBERFINE M CREAM should not be used in pregnant and breast-feeding women and in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine. The most common side effects of using EBERFINE M CREAM are itching and skin redness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Used to manage fungal infection of the skin folds and skin in those individuals who have compromised immunity and in general
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERFINE M CREAM
Used to manage fungal infection of the skin folds and skin in those individuals who have compromised immunity and in general
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERFINE M CREAM Works

EBERFINE M CREAM helps in managing fungal infections of the skin where Eberconazole is an Antifungal medicine which works by stopping the growth of fungi by binding to certain receptors that stop the formation of fungal hormone (ergosterol). Due to the lack of the hormone ergosterol, the fungi are not able to survive. Mometasone inhibits the substances that cause inflammation such as prostaglandins and leukotrienes and helps relieving the inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERFINE M CREAM

Always apply EBERFINE M CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. A thin layer of the medicine has to be applied on the affected area. Use this medicine for time it has been prescribed by your doctor even if your symptoms start getting better. Managed areas need not be covered with plaster or bandage. Wash hands before and after the application of EBERFINE M CREAM. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency and duration of EBERFINE M CREAM for you depending upon your age and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION

ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage fungal infections on scalp and body such as dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis (a dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body) and tinea versicolor.

These conditions can by itchy, caused by a fungus called ‘Malassezia’. Tinea versicolor is characterized by white to brown patches on the body that sometimes appear after exposure to the sun.

Before using ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or if you are using any steroids. ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice. ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use in infants and children.

The most common side effects of using ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION are itching, stinging and dryness on the site of application. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.
usesDetails:

Manages fungal infections like:

Dandruff
Seborrheic dermatitis
Tinea versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION Works

ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION works by arresting growth in fungal cells thus, managing growth and spread of the fungus throughout your body.
usageDetails:
How to use ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION

Use ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for use on hair and skin only. Wet your hair and scalp thoroughly with water and apply sufficient amount of ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION to produce enough lather. Smoothly massage the lather over the entire scalp. Leave for 3-5 minutes, before washing off thoroughly.

If ARCOLANE SCALP SOLUTION accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: AMROLFUNG Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMROLFUNG CREAM

AMROLFUNG CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROLFUNG CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLFUNG CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLFUNG CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROLFUNG CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.

How AMROLFUNG CREAM Works

AMROLFUNG CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AMROLFUNG CREAM

Apply AMROLFUNG CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AMROLFUNG CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.
sideEffects: Allergic reactions such as swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, which results in difficulty breathing, and severe skin rashes

name: KEZOP Soap 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About KEZOP SOAP

KEZOP SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

KEZOP SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using KEZOP SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. KEZOP SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of KEZOP SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with KEZOP SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of KEZOP SOAP

Manages various fungal infections of the skin such as:

Ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections
Candida paronychia
Cutaneous candidiasis
Pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How KEZOP SOAP Works

KEZOP SOAP clears the infection by causing holes in the fungal cell membranes, thus killing the fungi.
usageDetails:
How to use KEZOP SOAP

Always apply KEZOP SOAP as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply KEZOP SOAP on the affected area. It can be applied on the body and scalp. Wash and rinse thoroughly with water after applying KEZOP SOAP. Avoid contact of KEZOP SOAP with the nose, mouth or eyes.

If KEZOP SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation

name: Escrab Cream 60gm
introduction:
Introduction About ESCRAB CREAM

ESCRAB CREAM contains Permethrin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parasitic agents. It is indicated for the management of scabies, pediculosis (lice) and crab louse infections.

Scabies is a condition that cause itchy skin caused by a tiny burrowing mite called Sarcoptes scabiei. It can cause intense itching in the area where the mite burrows.

ESCRAB CREAM is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chrysanthemums (a flower). ESCRAB CREAM should be used with caution in patients having lung diseases and eczema (skin disease).

It is not recommended for use in infants below 2 months of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

ESCRAB CREAM is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult with your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using ESCRAB CREAM are itching, redness of skin, tingling, prickling, skin burning sensation and dry skin. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESCRAB CREAM

Used to manage:

Scabies
Pediculosis
Crab louse infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ESCRAB CREAM Works

ESCRAB CREAM helps in managing scabies and head lice by acting on the nerve cells of the disease-causing organism and alters the movements of certain ions (sodium ions) which leads to loss of their function. This causes respiratory failure of the disease-causing organism and hence, their destruction.
usageDetails:
How to use ESCRAB CREAM

Always apply ESCRAB CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. The medicine should be applied on all the affected areas. Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Wash hands before and after the application of ESCRAB CREAM. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth.
sideEffects: Signs of hypersensitivity reactions (skin rash, fever, difficulty in breathing or swallowing, scaly or flaky skin)

name: CINATOP Cream 60gm
introduction:
Introduction About CINATOP CREAM

CINATOP CREAM contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing an itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas and the inner thigh and characterized by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes), and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms, and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (a fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut, and vagina), tinea (pityriasis), and versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms, or legs).

CINATOP CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

CINATOP CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using CINATOP CREAM are itchiness, a mild burning sensation, or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea corporis, and tinea cruris
usesDetails:
Uses Of CINATOP CREAM

It is used for the topical management of the following fungal skin infections:

Tinea pedis, tinea corporis, and tinea cruris
Candidiasis or moniliasis
Tinea (pityriasis) versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How CINATOP CREAM Works

CINATOP CREAM is a broad-spectrum antifungal medication that works by inhibiting or killing a wide range of fungi that cause infections. Thus, it helps to manage fungal infections effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use CINATOP CREAM

Always use CINATOP CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply CINATOP CREAM into the affected and surrounding skin areas with clean hands and let it dry in air, do not apply a covering on it.
sideEffects: Itchiness, mild burning sensation or redness
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of CINATOP CREAM
Common
Itchiness, mild burning sensation or redness

Stop using CINATOP CREAM and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe itching, redness, burning, dryness
Irritation of managed skin
Change in colour of nails
Sensitivity (allergic reaction) or chemical irritation

Do not use CINATOP CREAM if you are allergic to ciclopirox or any other ingredients of this medicine.
The safety and effectiveness of CINATOP CREAM in children below 10 years of age have not been established. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

name: FLUMET Antifungal Powder 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About FLUMET DUSTING POWDER

FLUMET DUSTING POWDER contains Fluconazole that belong to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage, control, prevent, & manage fungal infections of skin such as tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea corporis (ring worm), tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) and tinea versicolor.

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot) is a fungal infection that begins between toes generally in people whose feet remain sweaty. It is characterized by symptoms such as scaly rashes, itching, stinging and burning between toes. Tinea corporis (ring worm) is a fungal infection causing circular itchy rashes with clearer skin in the middle, resembling a ring.

Tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) or jock itch is a fungal infection characterized by red and itchy rashes in the moist areas of the body such as groin. Tinea versicolor is a fungal infection that is characterized by abnormal skin pigmentation such as light and dark patches at the affected area.

Before using FLUMET DUSTING POWDER inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart or lung diseases. There is no information on the use of FLUMET DUSTING POWDER in pregnant or breastfeeding women and children. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using.

The most common side effects associated with the use of FLUMET DUSTING POWDER are itching, irritation and rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLUMET DUSTING POWDER

It is used to manage fungal skin infections caused including:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea corporis (ring worm)
Tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash)
Tinea versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How FLUMET DUSTING POWDER Works

FLUMET DUSTING POWDER helps in manage fungal infection where Fluconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the killing the fungal cell bodies.
usageDetails:
How to use FLUMET DUSTING POWDER

Apply FLUMET DUSTING POWDER as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry up the affected area before applying FLUMET DUSTING POWDER and do not rub. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.

name: Lamifin Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About LAMIFIN CREAM

LAMIFIN CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

LAMIFIN CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use LAMIFIN CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using LAMIFIN CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LAMIFIN CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LAMIFIN CREAM Works

LAMIFIN CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: LAMIFIN CREAM is for external use only.
Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.
Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
Do not stop using LAMIFIN CREAM without consulting your doctor.

name: ITRADAC Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About ITRADAC CREAM

ITRADAC CREAM is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, nails, vagina, etc. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

ITRADAC CREAM is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to Itraconazole. It is also not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women.

ITRADAC CREAM should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) since the medicine is known to be associated with a range of potential drug interactions. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of applying ITRADAC CREAM are common cold, nausea, blurred vision, tiredness, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
uses: Fungal infections of the skin, nails, etc.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRADAC CREAM
Fungal infections of the skin, nails, etc.
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRADAC CREAM Works

ITRADAC CREAM works by inhibiting ergosterol synthesis (an organic compound responsible for maintaining cell membrane integrity of fungi cells) that leads to fungal cell membrane abnormalities (marked with increased permeability and disruption of fungi cells), thus causing destruction to the fungi cell and managing the occurrence of fungal infections in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About OCONA Z SOAP

OCONA Z SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used to manage fungal infections of the skin like dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection causing dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body).

Before using OCONA Z SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, or if you are using any steroids. OCONA Z SOAP can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice.

OCONA Z SOAP is not recommended for use in infants and children. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, wash your eyes properly with water. Call your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.
uses: To manage fungal infections like dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
usesDetails:
Uses Of OCONA Z SOAP
To manage fungal infections like dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
mechanismOfAction:
How OCONA Z SOAP Works

OCONA Z SOAP reduces fungal infection where ketoconazole arrests growth in fungal cells and zinc pyrithione damages the proteins essential for fungal metabolism and growth.
usageDetails:
How to use OCONA Z SOAP

Use OCONA Z SOAP as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply OCONA Z SOAP to the affected part of the skin and rub gently to develop enough lather. After two minutes, wash off thoroughly.

If OCONA Z SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, wash your eyes with water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the proper dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: EBERCLIN XL Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERCLIN XL CREAM

EBERCLIN XL CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERCLIN XL CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERCLIN XL CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERCLIN XL CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERCLIN XL CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERCLIN XL CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERCLIN XL CREAM

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERCLIN XL CREAM Works

EBERCLIN XL CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERCLIN XL CREAM

Always use EBERCLIN XL CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERCLIN XL CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERCLIN XL CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

Sensitization or irritation

name: NIXICLIN Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About NIXICLIN CREAM

NIXICLIN CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

NIXICLIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

NIXICLIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

NIXICLIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying NIXICLIN CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIXICLIN CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum

mechanismOfAction:
How NIXICLIN CREAM Works

NIXICLIN CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.

Apply NIXICLIN CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using NIXICLIN CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MOMEREX S OINTMENT

MOMEREX S OINTMENT is a combination of Mometasone and Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Dermatological agents. MOMEREX S OINTMENT is used to manage psoriasis, especially in case of intensive scaling, in adults and adolescents (above 12 years of age).

Psoriasis is a type of skin disease that causes a skin rash with itchy, scaly patches, most commonly on the knees, elbows, trunk and scalp which is a common, long-term disease that occurs due to triggering factors such as infections, cuts, burns and/or certain medications which is generally painful and tends to go through cycles, flaring for a few weeks to months.

Avoid applying MOMEREX S OINTMENT if you have bacterial infection such as pyoderma (pus-producing skin disease), syphilis (sexually transmited bacterial disease), tuberculosis, viral infections such as herpes simplex, chicken pox, fungal infections such as dermatophyte, yeast and rosacea (type of skin disease) marked by reddens and or other changes of the skin in the facial area.

Before applying MOMEREX S OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are receiving ultraviolet management and have any other skin problems. MOMEREX S OINTMENT is not recommended for use during pregnancy and breast-feeding women should consult their doctor before use.

MOMEREX S OINTMENT is recommended for use in children and adolescents (above 12 years of age). The most common side effects of using MOMEREX S OINTMENT are weak to moderate burning sensation at the site of application, itching and localized thinning of the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.
uses: Manage psoriasis, especially in case of intensive scaling

Manage psoriasis, especially in case of intensive scaling
mechanismOfAction:
How MOMEREX S OINTMENT Works

MOMEREX S OINTMENT is used to manage psoriasis, where Mometasone reduces the redness and itchiness of skin by blocking the production of prostaglandin (chemical messenger), which is responsible for causing redness and itchiness of skin and Salicylic acid helps in softening and removing the psoriasis scales by acting as a scale filter which causes shedding of outer layer of the skin thereby providing relief from the symptoms of psoriasis.

Always apply MOMEREX S OINTMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. It should not be applied under bandages or similar. Avoid applying the medicine around your eyes or mucous membrane. Your doctor will decide the duration and frequency of using this medicine depending upon severity of the condition.

name: Luliderm Cream 40gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIDERM CREAM

LULIDERM CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIDERM CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIDERM CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIDERM CREAM

LULIDERM CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIDERM CREAM Works

LULIDERM CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIDERM CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: Candiderma + Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About CANDIDERMA + CREAM

CANDIDERMA + CREAM is used to provide relief from skin infection, inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling. It contains a combination of Beclomethasone, Clotrimazole and Neomycin.

Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine. It works by making your body not release certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling. Clotrimazole and neomycin stops the activity of microbes (fungi and bacteria) which when applied at the infected site.

CANDIDERMA + CREAM is strictly for external use only. Apply a thin layer of CANDIDERMA + CREAM on the affected skin areas. Avoid its contact with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, or any open wounds. Do not use CANDIDERMA + CREAM for more than 4 weeks without consulting your doctor.

Before using CANDIDERMA + CREAM inform your doctor if you have any viral skin infections, skin ulcers, spotty red rash around the mouth, acne, rosacea (redness of skin) or itching of your anus (back passage) or genital areas as a precaution. Consult your doctor before using CANDIDERMA + CREAM if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of applying CANDIDERMA + CREAM are skin thinning and application site irritation and burning sensation. Consult your doctor if this side effect trouble you.
uses: Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
usesDetails:
Uses Of CANDIDERMA + CREAM
Skin infections (Fungal and Bacterial origin)
Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
mechanismOfAction:
How CANDIDERMA + CREAM Works

CANDIDERMA + CREAM contains three medicines, namely beclomethasone, clotrimazole and neomycin. Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine which stops your body from producing certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling, while parallelly making your body release chemicals that heals inflammation.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medication which works by inhibiting the synthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Without ergosterol, the cell membranes become weakened and leaky, leading to fungal cell damage.

Neomycin is an antibiotic which stops protein synthesis in bacteria which is necessary for it to survive. As a result, it disrupts bacterial growth and replication and controls the spread of bacterial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use CANDIDERMA + CREAM

Apply a small amount of CANDIDERMA + CREAM into the affected skin areas or directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop using or overuse CANDIDERMA + CREAM without consulting your doctor.

Avoid contact of CANDIDERMA + CREAM with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. In case of accidental contact, rinse with plenty of water.

CANDIDERMA + CREAM is unlikely to affect your ability to drive or use machines.

CANDIDERMA + CREAM should be used in children and adolescents (aged 12 year or older) only if prescribed by the physician. There is no proper study information regarding the use of CANDIDERMA + CREAM in children aged below 12 years. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLE OINTMENT

ZOLE OINTMENT contains Miconazole which belongs to the group of medicine called Antifungals agents. It is used to manage fungal and associated bacterial infections of the skin and nails.

Skin infections may appear on the trunk, hands or feet, scalp or outer ear, groin and include athlete’s foot, dhobie itch and intertrigo. It is also effective against infected nappy rash. It also has moisturising properties to help soothe cracked, red skin.

Skin infections will usually get better after 2 to 6 weeks. If your condition does not improve after 2 to 6 weeks of management, consult your doctor for advice.

This medicine can be used for adults and children. Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

Before using ZOLE OINTMENT tell your doctor if you have ever had kidney disease, heart disease or liver problem. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using ZOLE OINTMENT include burning sensation, irritation, itching, and redness at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About KENZ LOTION

KENZ LOTION contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage fungal and yeast infections which may appear on the skin of the hands, feet, genital area, trunk, groin, scalp, face, chest or back.

KENZ LOTION is not recommended for eye infections. Before applying KENZ LOTION, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KENZ LOTION can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KENZ LOTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KENZ LOTION are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KENZ LOTION

Manages the fungal or yeast infections of skin appearing on:

Trunk, chest, back
Hands, feet
Scalp, face
Groin, genitals
mechanismOfAction:
How KENZ LOTION Works

KENZ LOTION reduces fungal infection by inhibiting the growth of the fungus by weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use KENZ LOTION

Apply KENZ LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KENZ LOTION in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KENZ LOTION until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

name: Momstar Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About MOMSTAR CREAM

MOMSTAR CREAM contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. MOMSTAR CREAM is used in the management of inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses such as psoriasis and atopic dermatitis. It is also used to manage scalp psoriasis and seborrheic dermatitis.

Psoriasis is a type of skin disease that causes skin rash with itchy, scaly patches which most commonly occurs on the knees, elbows, trunk and scalp. Atopic dermatitis is a skin condition which makes your skin red and itchy. Scalp psoriasis is a common skin disorder that makes skin raised, reddish, often scaly on the scalp which can either occur as a single patch or several patches on the scalp. Seborrheic dermatitis is a common skin condition that affects your scalp which is characterized by red, and scaly patches of skin and dandruff.

Avoid applying MOMSTAR CREAM, if you have rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne (pimples), skin atrophy (thinning of the skin), dermatitis (skin inflammation) around the mouth, genital itching, viral infections such as shingles, chickenpox (viral infection), ulcerated skin, and wounds.

Before applying MOMSTAR CREAM, inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease. MOMSTAR CREAM should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before applying MOMSTAR CREAM.

The medicine is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor before applying MOMSTAR CREAM.

The most common side effects of using MOMSTAR CREAM are mild to moderate pruritus (itchy skin), burning and stinging sensation of skin, folliculitis (a type of skin infection marked by inflamed hair follicles), dryness of skin, mild skin atrophy (thin-shiny appearing skin). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About L SYS TOPICAL SOLUTION

L SYS TOPICAL SOLUTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection). Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another.

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal Agents. It works by inhibiting the growth of the fungus that causes these infections.

L SYS TOPICAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. L SYS TOPICAL SOLUTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

Avoid applying L SYS TOPICAL SOLUTION on the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of L SYS TOPICAL SOLUTION

L SYS TOPICAL SOLUTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How L SYS TOPICAL SOLUTION Works

L SYS TOPICAL SOLUTION works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and killing fungi. In this way, Luliconazole relieves discomfort, itching, and irritation on the skin.

introduction:
Introduction About TERBINAFORCE M CREAM

TERBINAFORCE M CREAM is a combination of Mometasone and Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical corticosteroids and Antifungals, respectively. TERBINAFORCE M CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections associated with inflammation and itching.

A fungal infection is a type of skin disease caused by a fungus which is a microorganism that invades the tissue and cause disease that's confined to the skin and spreads into tissue, bones, organs and other parts of the body with symptoms generally including skin rash or vaginal infection resulting in abnormal discharge.

Avoid using TERBINAFORCE M CREAM, if you have rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne (pimples), skin atrophy (thinning of the skin), genital itching, nappy rash, shingles (viral infection), warts (type of skin infection) and ulcerated skin.

Before using TERBINAFORCE M CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin rash) or any other skin problems. This medicine is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

TERBINAFORCE M CREAM is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). The most common side effects of using TERBINAFORCE M CREAM are skin peeling and itching. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.

name: CANDIDAC V Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About CANDIDAC V GEL

CANDIDAC V GEL contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in the management of fungal skin infections such as ringworm (fungal infection of the skin or scalp), athlete’s foot (fungal infection between the toes), fungal nappy rash (skin rash affecting the nappy area), and fungal sweat rash. It also relieves irritation of the vulva (external thrush) or at the end of the penis, which may be associated with thrush.

Before applying CANDIDAC V GEL, inform your doctor about your previous existing disease conditions. CANDIDAC V GEL is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to clotrimazole. Avoid smoking or going near flames and wearing fabrics that catch fire easily due to the increased risk of severe burns.

CANDIDAC V GEL can be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Avoid using latex contraceptives (condoms or diaphragms), as this medicine may reduce the effectiveness of such contraceptives. Use alternative precautions for at least five days after using the medicine. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual effects.

How CANDIDAC V GEL Works

CANDIDAC V GEL acts by specifically inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol and other sterols (enzymes) required for cell membrane production; therefore, it inhibits the division and growth of fungi, eventually leading to cell death, which further manages fungal growth.

Always apply CANDIDAC V GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected surface before applying the medicine. Apply and rub gently a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Do not use CANDIDAC V GEL on your face, eyes, or large area. Do not use under bandages or for a long time without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the duration and time interval for application depending on the type of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About LULIDERM 1% CREAM

LULIDERM 1% CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIDERM 1% CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIDERM 1% CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIDERM 1% CREAM

LULIDERM 1% CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIDERM 1% CREAM Works

LULIDERM 1% CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIDERM 1% CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: TEXIFEN Lotion 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About TEXIFEN LOTION

TEXIFEN LOTION is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TEXIFEN LOTION is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TEXIFEN LOTION if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TEXIFEN LOTION are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEXIFEN LOTION
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TEXIFEN LOTION Works

TEXIFEN LOTION is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.
Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.
Wash your hands before and after application.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
Do not stop using TEXIFEN LOTION without consulting your doctor.

name: Zocon Dusting Powder 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About ZOCON DUSTING POWDER

Zocon Dusting Powder is an antifungal and antibacterial agent which is used to manage the recurrence of fungal infections, diaper rash, heat and friction rashes. It contains Clotrimazole as the active ingredient which soothes the infected skin and protects against rash and chaffing.

Clotrimazole acts primarily by damaging the permeability barrier in the cell membrane of fungi by inhibiting of ergosterol biosynthesis, an essential constituent of fungal cell membranes. This stops fungal growth and infections.

Zocon Dusting Powder should be used as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. It should not be used on deep skin wounds or severe burns. If it accidentally gets in your eyes or mouth, clean it immediately with water.

introduction:
Introduction About SERTOZ CREAM

SERTOZ CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use SERTOZ CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. SERTOZ CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SERTOZ CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of SERTOZ CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:
How SERTOZ CREAM Works

SERTOZ CREAM works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.

Always use SERTOZ CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using SERTOZ CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

name: Livafin Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About LIVAFIN CREAM

LIVAFIN CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

LIVAFIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

LIVAFIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

LIVAFIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying LIVAFIN CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIVAFIN CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How LIVAFIN CREAM Works

LIVAFIN CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use LIVAFIN CREAM

Apply LIVAFIN CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using LIVAFIN CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About KETOVATE 2% SOAP

KETOVATE 2% SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

KETOVATE 2% SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using KETOVATE 2% SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. KETOVATE 2% SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of KETOVATE 2% SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with KETOVATE 2% SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How KETOVATE 2% SOAP Works

KETOVATE 2% SOAP clears the infection by causing holes in the fungal cell membranes, thus killing the fungi.

Always apply KETOVATE 2% SOAP as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply KETOVATE 2% SOAP on the affected area. It can be applied on the body and scalp. Wash and rinse thoroughly with water after applying KETOVATE 2% SOAP. Avoid contact of KETOVATE 2% SOAP with the nose, mouth or eyes.

If KETOVATE 2% SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Nizoclin B Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About NIZOCLIN B CREAM

NIZOCLIN B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole, which belong to the groups of medicines called Anti-inflammatory and Antifungal respectively. It is used to manage different kinds of fungal infections like Tinea corporis (Ringworm), Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp).

These fungal infections can spread easily from one person to another and cause redness and itching in the affected area. They are usually seen in moist and sweaty areas of the body as tinea pedis is usually seen in between the toes due to fitting shoes whereas tinea cruris and groin are seen in the inner thigh region.

Avoid applying NIZOCLIN B CREAM on the skin surface that is cut, scraped, sunburned, or eczema affected. NIZOCLIN B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients suffering from skin-related viral infections, tuberculosis, acne rosacea, and perioral dermatitis.

NIZOCLIN B CREAM should be used with caution in pregnancy and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. NIZOCLIN B CREAM is not recommended for use in children 9 years of age and below. NIZOCLIN B CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIZOCLIN B CREAM

Manages fungal infections such as:

Ringworm (Tinea corporis)
Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp)
mechanismOfAction:
How NIZOCLIN B CREAM Works

NIZOCLIN B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole. Beclomethasone is a corticosteroid that works by reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms like itching, redness, irritation, and swelling by blocking the enzymes responsible for causing it (prostaglandins and leukotrienes). Ketoconazole is an imidazole that blocks the synthesis of ergosterol, a key component of the fungal cell membrane, thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use NIZOCLIN B CREAM

Apply NIZOCLIN B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean the skin and dry the skin area to be managed. Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, or inside the vagina. Do not cover or wrap or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Triben Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About TRIBEN LOTION

Triben Lotion is an Anti-fungal Lotion used for various fungal infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot (fungal foot infection), fungal nappy rash, and fungal sweat rash. It provides relief from inflammation and itching caused by fungal infections. It contains Clotrimazole as an active ingredient which is effective in inhibiting infection-causing fungus.

Clotrimazole acts as an anti-fungal agent by stopping the synthesis of ergosterol which is a key component of the fungal cell membrane and further inhibits growth of fungal cells.

Triben Lotion is for external use only. Apply this Lotion as directed by your doctor or 2-3 times a day. Apply a thin and uniform layer of this lotion to the affected area gently. Before applying it to your feet wash and dry your feet thoroughly, especially between your toes. Use Triben Lotion for 2 weeks in case of candida (thrush) infection and 1 month for other fungal infections or as directed by your doctor. Avoid applying Triben Lotion near the eyes or mouth and in case of accidental contact with the eyes or mouth rinse with water thoroughly. Before applying Triben Lotion, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

LILITUF CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

introduction:
Introduction About OXICOJEN LOTION

OXICOJEN LOTION contains Oxiconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used in the topical management of fungal skin infections (such as athlete’s foot, Jock itch, ringworm infection, pityriasis versicolor (small, discoloured patches on the skin)).

OXICOJEN LOTION is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply to the affected skin areas. Do not cover the affected areas after applying this medicine.

Use OXICOJEN LOTION for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2-4 weeks of therapy.

Before using OXICOJEN LOTION inform your doctor if you are allergic to oxiconazole. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side-effects of using OXICOJEN LOTION are irritation, burning sensation and/or redness at the site of application. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin
usesDetails:
Uses Of OXICOJEN LOTION
Manage fungal infections of the skin
mechanismOfAction:
How OXICOJEN LOTION Works

OXICOJEN LOTION is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections of the skin. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

OXICOJEN LOTION is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply to the affected skin areas.

Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes. Do not cover the affected area after applying this medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection. Do not stop using OXICOJEN LOTION without consulting your doctor.

name: LULICAN 1% Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About LULICAN 1% LOTION

LULICAN 1% LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULICAN 1% LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULICAN 1% LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULICAN 1% LOTION

LULICAN 1% LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)

mechanismOfAction:
How LULICAN 1% LOTION Works

LULICAN 1% LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULICAN 1% LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

introduction:
Introduction About KANSEL DS LOTION

KANSEL DS LOTION contains Clotrimazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals.  It is used in the management of skin infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, fungal intertrigo and fungal infections of the outer and middle ear. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin and causing redness and itching.

An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes. Fungal intertrigo is inflammation caused by skin-to-skin friction in warm, moist areas of the body (groin, between folds of skin on the abdomen, under the breasts, arms or between toes).Clotrimazole works by managing fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of the fungal cell.

KANSEL DS LOTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to this medicine. KANSEL DS LOTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The common side effects of KANSEL DS LOTION are itching, rash, blisters, burning, discomfort, swelling, irritation, redness and peeling of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms get worse or persist.

How KANSEL DS LOTION Works

KANSEL DS LOTION acts by specifically inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol and other sterols (enzymes) required for cell membrane production, therefore inhibiting the division and growth of fungi eventually leading to cell death.

How to use KANSEL DS LOTION

Always apply KANSEL DS LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. After washing and drying the infected area thoroughly apply a thin and even layer on it. In case of ear infection use 2-3 drops in the ears. Do not scratch the infected area even though it is itchy, keep the area clean and always wash your hands before and after the use of the medicine. Do not share towels, bathmats, etc. with other people, wash your socks, stockings and tights thoroughly in hot water to remove any shed skin or fungal spores. Change your footwear daily if possible. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration for you depending on your age and disease condition.

name: Luliclinz Xl Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULICLINZ XL CREAM

LULICLINZ XL CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULICLINZ XL CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULICLINZ XL CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULICLINZ XL CREAM

LULICLINZ XL CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULICLINZ XL CREAM Works

LULICLINZ XL CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULICLINZ XL CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About EBERCLIN M CREAM

EBERCLIN M CREAM is a combination of Eberconazole and Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used to manage fungal infections of the skin folds and skin in those individuals who have compromised immunity and in general.

EBERCLIN M CREAM is not recommended for use in conditions like rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne, dermatitis around the mouth, thinning of the skin, genital itching, nappy rash, cold sores, warts, ulcerated skin, shingles, chickenpox, wounds and other skin infections. Before using EBERCLIN M CREAM inform your doctor if you are taking or using any other medicines including prescription or non-prescription medicines to manage the risk of any unusual effects.  

EBERCLIN M CREAM should not be used in pregnant and breast-feeding women and in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine. The most common side effects of using EBERCLIN M CREAM are itching and skin redness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

How EBERCLIN M CREAM Works

Due to the lack of the hormone ergosterol, the fungi are not able to survive. Mometasone inhibits the substances that cause inflammation such as prostaglandins and leukotrienes and helps relieving the inflammation.

Wash hands before and after the application of EBERCLIN M CREAM. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency and duration of EBERCLIN M CREAM for you depending upon your age and severity of the condition.

TERFIN 1% DUSTING POWDER is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERFIN 1% DUSTING POWDER is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERFIN 1% DUSTING POWDER if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERFIN 1% DUSTING POWDER are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
