It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

name: Amrosys Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMROSYS CREAM

AMROSYS CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROSYS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROSYS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROSYS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROSYS CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMROSYS CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How AMROSYS CREAM Works

AMROSYS CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AMROSYS CREAM

Apply AMROSYS CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AMROSYS CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

name: LULIMAC XL Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About LULIMAC XL LOTION

LULIMAC XL LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIMAC XL LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIMAC XL LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIMAC XL LOTION

LULIMAC XL LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIMAC XL LOTION Works

LULIMAC XL LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIMAC XL LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

Allergic reaction (symptoms like skin rash, itching or hives, swelling of the face, lips, or tongue)

Redness and pain

introduction:
Introduction About LULICAN 1% CREAM

Lulican Cream is a topical antifungal agent used to manage fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm of the feet between the toes (tinea pedis), ringworm of the genitals, inner thighs and buttocks (tinea cruris), or ringworm of any part of the body (tinea corporis). It contains Luliconazole as an active ingredient which kills the disease-causing fungi.

Luliconazole manages the growth of various types of fungi by managing the ergosterol synthesis which disrupts the production of the fungal cell membranes. As a result, it fights against the fungal infection of the skin and stops its growth, thereby relieving the symptoms of fungal infection.

Apply Lulican Cream as advised by your doctor. It is for external use on the surface of the skin only. Along with management, follow proper hygiene methods. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions after applying the creams.
sideEffectsDetails:

Lulican Cream may cause skin irritation, redness, itchy rashes, and swelling on the applied area. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while using this Cream.

name: Af C Dusting Powder 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About AF C DUSTING POWDER

Af C Dusting Powder is an antifungal powder with super absorbent formula which helps to absorbs moisture. It is used as adjunct to manage fungal infection and manage its recurrence particularly in skin folds and where perspiration is a problem. As a maintenance therapy for tinea pedis, tinea cruris, diaper rash and other fungal infections of skin. It contains Clotrimazole as an active ingredient.

Clotrimazole acts primarily by damaging the permeability barrier in the cell membrane of the fungi by disrupting the production of the membranes that surrounds the fungal cells. It works by altering the fungal cell membrane by inhibiting certain enzymes, thereby clearing the infection and relieving the symptoms.

Always use Af C Dusting Powder as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. It should be used in the morning or night as directed by the physician. Do not use if you are allergic to Clotrimazole.

name: NIXICLIN XL Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About NIXICLIN XL CREAM

NIXICLIN XL CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

NIXICLIN XL CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

NIXICLIN XL CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

NIXICLIN XL CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying NIXICLIN XL CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum

NIXICLIN XL CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.

name: Ketoscalp Plus Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM

KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole, which belong to the groups of medicines called Anti-inflammatory and Antifungal respectively. It is used to manage different kinds of fungal infections like Tinea corporis (Ringworm), Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp).

These fungal infections can spread easily from one person to another and cause redness and itching in the affected area. They are usually seen in moist and sweaty areas of the body as tinea pedis is usually seen in between the toes due to fitting shoes whereas tinea cruris and groin are seen in the inner thigh region.

Avoid applying KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM on the skin surface that is cut, scraped, sunburned, or eczema affected. KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use in patients suffering from skin-related viral infections, tuberculosis, acne rosacea, and perioral dermatitis.

KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM should be used with caution in pregnancy and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use in children 9 years of age and below. KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM

Manages fungal infections such as:

Ringworm (Tinea corporis)
Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp)
mechanismOfAction:
How KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM Works

KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole. Beclomethasone is a corticosteroid that works by reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms like itching, redness, irritation, and swelling by blocking the enzymes responsible for causing it (prostaglandins and leukotrienes). Ketoconazole is an imidazole that blocks the synthesis of ergosterol, a key component of the fungal cell membrane, thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM

Apply KETOSCALP PLUS CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean the skin and dry the skin area to be managed. Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, or inside the vagina. Do not cover or wrap or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM

KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM Works

KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM

Apply KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KENOZOLE 0.02 CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About GAMASCAB LOTION

GAMASCAB LOTION contains Gamma benzene hexachloride which belongs to a group of medicines called Ectoparasiticides. GAMASCAB LOTION is used to manage scabies (itchy skin rash caused by burrowing mite) in patients who are intolerant/had a failed management with other approved therapies to manage the condition.

GAMASCAB LOTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Gamma benzene hexachloride. It is also not recommended for use in patient suffering from crusted scabies, second scabies attack, skin conditions (such as atopic dermatitis, psoriasis), and/or uncontrolled seizure disorders.

Before applying GAMASCAB LOTION, inform your doctor if you have/had head injury, brain/spinal cord tumour, HIV/AIDS, and/or liver problems (such as severe hepatic cirrhosis).

GAMASCAB LOTION should be used with caution in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended of use in breastfeeding women unless it is clearly necessary.

GAMASCAB LOTION is advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) who weigh less than 50kgs (110 pounds) and is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of applying GAMASCAB LOTION are itching skin, burning skin, dry skin, and/or skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Manage scabies in patients who are intolerant/had a failed management with other approved therapies
mechanismOfAction:
How GAMASCAB LOTION Works

GAMASCAB LOTION works by blocking the action of GABA-gated chloride channel (neurotransmitter) in parasites which leads to low neuronal inhibition and paralysis in parasites thus resulting in its destruction and providing relief from skin disease caused by parasites (scabies) in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use GAMASCAB LOTION

Always apply GAMASCAB LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Shake well before use. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas should not be covered with a plaster/ bandage. Following application, wash the applied area after 8 to 12 hours. The medicine should be washed off completely. Avoid using the medicine again after first application and throw away the bottle after use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIZOL CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIZOL CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

As a result, LULIZOL CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

introduction:
Introduction About CANDIDAC 1% DUSTING POWDER

CANDIDAC 1% DUSTING POWDER contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It also relives symptoms such as burning, itching, skin cracking, and discomfort caused by the skin infections. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin, causing redness and itching. An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes.

Clotrimazole works by blocking the fungal growth and managing the further occurrence of fungal infections. CANDIDAC 1% DUSTING POWDER is intended to manage fungal skin infections; hence, it should not be used for other infections of internal organs. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with CANDIDAC 1% DUSTING POWDER.

CANDIDAC 1% DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for patients allergic to clotrimazole. CANDIDAC 1% DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in deep wounds and severe burns. CANDIDAC 1% DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Before taking CANDIDAC 1% DUSTING POWDER, inform your doctor if you’re under any medications.

It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About ESAVA SOAP

Esava Soap is an anti-fungal medicated soap that is used to manage tinea versicolor (common fungal infection that causes small, discoloured patches of skin). Also, it is used as an adjuvant therapy with various oral and topical anti-fungal agents to manage recurrence of tinea and candida skin infection. It contains ketoconazole as an active ingredient that effectively manages fungal infection of the skin.

Ketoconazole works by killing the fungi by disrupting the production of ergosterol, which is an essential component of fungal cell membrane, as a result the cell membrane of the fungi gets disrupted leading to the death of the fungi.

Always use Esava Soap as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Rub Esava Soap to the wet body gently to make a rich lather and leave for few minutes before washing off completely. Generally, it can be used once daily till the management. Do not use Esava Soap if you are allergic to any of its components. Inform your doctor if you are using or have recently used any other medicines including prescription, over the counter medications, as well as herbal products.

introduction:
Introduction About CIVADERM XL CREAM

CIVADERM XL CREAM contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing an itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas and the inner thigh and characterized by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes), and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms, and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (a fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut, and vagina), tinea (pityriasis), and versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms, or legs).

CIVADERM XL CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

CIVADERM XL CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using CIVADERM XL CREAM are itchiness, a mild burning sensation, or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

Introduction About GRIS ODT CREAM

GRIS ODT CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

GRIS ODT CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use GRIS ODT CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using GRIS ODT CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.

How GRIS ODT CREAM Works

GRIS ODT CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

MYCOCLIN SHAMPOO contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage fungal infections of the scalp causing dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis. Dandruff due to fungal infection of the scalp may present with a stubborn itching sensation and skin flakes etc.

Seborrheic dermatitis is an infectious condition of the sweat glands on the skin surface and may present as patches of white or yellow or crusts of the skin. Your doctor may recommend you take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.Your doctor may also advise you to modify and maintain personal hygiene habits.

name: Gentalene Plus Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About GENTALENE PLUS CREAM

GENTALENE PLUS CREAM is used to provide relief from skin infection, inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling. It contains a combination of Beclomethasone, Clotrimazole and Neomycin.

Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine. It works by making your body not release certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling. Clotrimazole and neomycin stops the activity of microbes (fungi and bacteria) which when applied at the infected site.

GENTALENE PLUS CREAM is strictly for external use only. Apply a thin layer of GENTALENE PLUS CREAM on the affected skin areas. Avoid its contact with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, or any open wounds. Do not use GENTALENE PLUS CREAM for more than 4 weeks without consulting your doctor.

Before using GENTALENE PLUS CREAM inform your doctor if you have any viral skin infections, skin ulcers, spotty red rash around the mouth, acne, rosacea (redness of skin) or itching of your anus (back passage) or genital areas as a precaution. Consult your doctor before using GENTALENE PLUS CREAM if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of applying GENTALENE PLUS CREAM are skin thinning and application site irritation and burning sensation. Consult your doctor if this side effect trouble you.
uses: Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
usesDetails:
Uses Of GENTALENE PLUS CREAM
Skin infections (Fungal and Bacterial origin)
Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
mechanismOfAction:
How GENTALENE PLUS CREAM Works

GENTALENE PLUS CREAM contains three medicines, namely beclomethasone, clotrimazole and neomycin. Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine which stops your body from producing certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling, while parallelly making your body release chemicals that heals inflammation.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medication which works by inhibiting the synthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Without ergosterol, the cell membranes become weakened and leaky, leading to fungal cell damage.

Neomycin is an antibiotic which stops protein synthesis in bacteria which is necessary for it to survive. As a result, it disrupts bacterial growth and replication and controls the spread of bacterial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use GENTALENE PLUS CREAM

Apply a small amount of GENTALENE PLUS CREAM into the affected skin areas or directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop using or overuse GENTALENE PLUS CREAM without consulting your doctor.

Avoid contact of GENTALENE PLUS CREAM with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. In case of accidental contact, rinse with plenty of water.

warnings.details: There is inadequate information regarding the safety of GENTALENE PLUS CREAM during pregnancy. Hence, GENTALENE PLUS CREAM should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the doctor. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
GENTALENE PLUS CREAM can be used in breastfeeding women if required. However, consult your doctor before using it.
GENTALENE PLUS CREAM is unlikely to affect your ability to drive or use machines.
Do not use GENTALENE PLUS CREAM if you are allergic to beclomethasone, clotrimazole or neomycin.

GENTALENE PLUS CREAM should be used in children and adolescents (aged 12 year or older) only if prescribed by the physician. There is no proper study information regarding the use of GENTALENE PLUS CREAM in children aged below 12 years. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
GENTALENE PLUS CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Others

GENTALENE PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use if you:

Have acne
Have severe redness and warmth of skin (rosacea)
Have perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around the mouth)
Have itching of your anus (back passage) or genital areas
Have viral infections (such as cold sores, chicken pox or herpes)
Have skin blisters or sores caused due to any infections
Have varicose ulcers (inflammation of veins)
Have stasis ulcers (ulcers caused due to reduced blood flow)

name: Ludura Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About LUDURA CREAM

LUDURA CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LUDURA CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LUDURA CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUDURA CREAM

LUDURA CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LUDURA CREAM Works

LUDURA CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LUDURA CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About LONGON KZ SHAMPOO

LONGON KZ SHAMPOO contains Ketoconazole and Zinc pyrithione which belong to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used to manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection causing dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body).

Before using LONGON KZ SHAMPOO, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, or if you are using any steroids. LONGON KZ SHAMPOO can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice.

LONGON KZ SHAMPOO is not recommended for use in infants and children. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, wash eyes thoroughly with water. Call your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.
uses: To manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
usesDetails:

To manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
mechanismOfAction:
How LONGON KZ SHAMPOO Works

LONGON KZ SHAMPOO reduces infection where ketoconazole kills the fungus and zinc pyrithione stops the growth of the infecting organism.
usageDetails:
How to use LONGON KZ SHAMPOO

Use LONGON KZ SHAMPOO as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wet your hair and scalp and apply sufficient LONGON KZ SHAMPOO to produce enough lather. Massage for one minute to produce enough lather and keep it for 5 minutes.

If LONGON KZ SHAMPOO accidentally gets in your eye, wash your eyes with water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Monoguard Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About MONOGUARD CREAM

MONOGUARD CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use MONOGUARD CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. MONOGUARD CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MONOGUARD CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of MONOGUARD CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MONOGUARD CREAM
Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:
How MONOGUARD CREAM Works

MONOGUARD CREAM works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use MONOGUARD CREAM

Always use MONOGUARD CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using MONOGUARD CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.
sideEffects: Dryness and burning sensation of the skin
sideEffectsDetails:

Common
Contact dermatitis
Dryness and burning sensation of the skin
Tenderness of the skin
Redness
Itching
Hyperpigmentation
Skin blisters
Peeling of the skin
Rare

Stop using MONOGUARD CREAM and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reaction

Do not use MONOGUARD CREAM if you are allergic to Sertaconazole.
MONOGUARD CREAM is recommended for use in children at and above 12 years of age only. Consult your doctor for advice.

MONOGUARD CREAM should be taken with caution in the elderly above 65 years of age, only if recommended by your doctor. Your doctor will decide the dose, duration of the management, and frequency for you depending on the severity of your existing condition and other comorbid diseases.

name: UNIDRUFF Shampoo 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About UNIDRUFF SHAMPOO

Unidruff Shampoo is a total dandruff solution used to manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis of scalp. It contains zinc pyrithione and ketoconazole as active ingredients to control dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis of scalp.

Zinc Pyrithione has antimicrobial and antifungal properties that kills the microorganisms and fungus that can contribute to an itchy, flaky scalp and manages dandruff. Ketoconazole works by managing the growth of fungus and relieves flaking, itching and scaling associated with dandruff.

Always use Unidruff Shampoo exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only and shake well before use. Wet your hair and scalp, then apply sufficient shampoo to produce enough lather. Massage for one minute and rinse with warm water. Repeat the procedure again, rinse with water and then dry the hair. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, flush eyes with plenty of water. Discontinue the use if signs of irritation or inflammation develop.

name: Hhderm Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About HHDERM CREAM

HHDERM CREAM is a combination of Mometasone furoate, Fusidic acid and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids, Oral antistaphylococcal antibiotics and Imidazoles respectively. HHDERM CREAM is used in the topical management of various bacterial & fungal skin infections in affected individuals. It is also used to manage certain skin problems such as psoriasis and atopic eczema (itchy inflammation of the skin).

A bacterial infection occurs when a bacterium enters the body, multiplies and causes a reaction in the body, resulting in infection and symptoms such as unexplained redness and/or swelling of the skin. A fungal infection is a skin disease caused by a fungus that causes infection and symptoms such as irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching and/or swelling in the affected area.

HHDERM CREAM is not recommended for use if you have lung disease (such as tuberculosis), skin infections such as rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne, skin atrophy (thinning of the skin), dermatitis (skin inflammation) around the mouth, genital itching, viral infections such as shingles, ulcerated skin or wounds. Before applying HHDERM CREAM, inform your doctor if you smoke and/or have any kidney problems.

HHDERM CREAM should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women who are breastfeeding. It is not recommended for use in children under the age of two. The most common side effects of applying HHDERM CREAM are mild to moderate pruritus (itchy skin), burning and stinging sensations of the skin, folliculitis (inflamed hair follicles), dry skin, mild skin atrophy and telangiectasia (dilated small blood vessels on the skin). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About LILITUF CREAM

LILITUF CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LILITUF CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LILITUF CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LILITUF CREAM

LILITUF CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LILITUF CREAM Works

LILITUF CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LILITUF CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: LIVAFIN Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About LIVAFIN LOTION

LIVAFIN LOTION contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

LIVAFIN LOTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

LIVAFIN LOTION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

LIVAFIN LOTION is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying LIVAFIN LOTION are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIVAFIN LOTION

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How LIVAFIN LOTION Works

LIVAFIN LOTION works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use LIVAFIN LOTION

Apply LIVAFIN LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using LIVAFIN LOTION.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About AMORSKIN CREAM

AMORSKIN CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMORSKIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMORSKIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMORSKIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMORSKIN CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum

mechanismOfAction:
How AMORSKIN CREAM Works

AMORSKIN CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.

name: LUDERM 1% Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About LUDERM 1% CREAM

LUDERM 1% CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LUDERM 1% CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LUDERM 1% CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUDERM 1% CREAM

LUDERM 1% CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LUDERM 1% CREAM Works

LUDERM 1% CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LUDERM 1% CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: AMROBRUT Cream 25gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMROBRUT CREAM

Amrobrut Cream is an antifungal medicine used to manage fungal infections of the nails and skin. It contains Amorolfine hydrochloride as active the ingredient that helps to manage fungal infections.

Amorolfine hydrochloride is an antifungal agent works by eradicating the fungus that causes infection. It interferes with the fungal cell wall and inhibits the formation of ergosterol which is important for the fungus to survive.

Always use Amrobrut Cream exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Avoid Amrobrut Cream in direct contact with your eyes, ears, and mucous membrane. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.

name: Kenozole B Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About KENOZOLE B CREAM

KENOZOLE B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole, which belong to the groups of medicines called Anti-inflammatory and Antifungal respectively. It is used to manage different kinds of fungal infections like Tinea corporis (Ringworm), Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp).

These fungal infections can spread easily from one person to another and cause redness and itching in the affected area. They are usually seen in moist and sweaty areas of the body as tinea pedis is usually seen in between the toes due to fitting shoes whereas tinea cruris and groin are seen in the inner thigh region.

Avoid applying KENOZOLE B CREAM on the skin surface that is cut, scraped, sunburned, or eczema affected. KENOZOLE B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients suffering from skin-related viral infections, tuberculosis, acne rosacea, and perioral dermatitis.

KENOZOLE B CREAM should be used with caution in pregnancy and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. KENOZOLE B CREAM is not recommended for use in children 9 years of age and below. KENOZOLE B CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KENOZOLE B CREAM

Manages fungal infections such as:

Ringworm (Tinea corporis)
Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp)
mechanismOfAction:
How KENOZOLE B CREAM Works

KENOZOLE B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole. Beclomethasone is a corticosteroid that works by reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms like itching, redness, irritation, and swelling by blocking the enzymes responsible for causing it (prostaglandins and leukotrienes). Ketoconazole is an imidazole that blocks the synthesis of ergosterol, a key component of the fungal cell membrane, thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use KENOZOLE B CREAM

Apply KENOZOLE B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean the skin and dry the skin area to be managed. Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, or inside the vagina. Do not cover or wrap or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: CICO 1% Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About CICO 1% CREAM

CICO 1% CREAM contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing an itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas and the inner thigh and characterized by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes), and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms, and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (a fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut, and vagina), tinea (pityriasis), and versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms, or legs).

CICO 1% CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

CICO 1% CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using CICO 1% CREAM are itchiness, a mild burning sensation, or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea corporis, and tinea cruris
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:

CICO 1% CREAM is a broad-spectrum antifungal medication that works by inhibiting or killing a wide range of fungi that cause infections. Thus, it helps to manage fungal infections effectively.

Always use CICO 1% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply CICO 1% CREAM into the affected and surrounding skin areas with clean hands and let it dry in air, do not apply a covering on it.

name: LULY XL Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULY XL CREAM

LULY XL CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULY XL CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULY XL CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULY XL CREAM

LULY XL CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULY XL CREAM Works

LULY XL CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULY XL CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: DERMIFLEX Cream 15g
introduction:
Introduction About DERMIFLEX CREAM

Dermiflex Cream is used in the management of itching, redness, and swelling of the skin. It is also used to manage bacterial, protozoal, and fungal infections. It contains a combination of Clobetasol, Iodochlorhydroxyquinoline, Ketoconazole, Neomycin, and Tolnaftate, which are Corticosteroids, Antibiotics, Antiprotozoals, and Antifungals that effectively reduce microbial growth on the skin and manages further spread of infection.

Apply Dermiflex Cream as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected areas of the skin and rub in gently as directed by the doctor. Wash your hands after using the medicine.

Dermiflex Cream should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant before using this medicine.

Dermiflex Cream should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

Dermiflex Cream is not recommended for use by children under 2 years of age. Consult the child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using Dermiflex Cream are skin irritation, itching, pain, burning or stinging sensations, dry skin, skin eruptions, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: To manage skin infections and inflammation
usesDetails:
Uses Of DERMIFLEX CREAM
To manage skin infections and inflammation
mechanismOfAction:
How DERMIFLEX CREAM Works

Clobetasol is a corticosteroid that helps relieve itching, redness, and swelling. Iodochlorhydroxyquinoline and neomycin are antibiotic and antiprotozoal agents that relieve bacterial and protozoal infections. Tolnaftate and ketoconazole are antifungal agents that help manage fungal skin infections. Collectively, Dermiflex Cream helps manage skin infections and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use DERMIFLEX CREAM

Apply Dermiflex Cream as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected areas of the skin and rub in gently as directed by the doctor. Wash your hands after using the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, condition, and body weight. Avoid contact with the eyes.

name: KETAMIDE AD Shampoo 90ml
introduction:
Introduction About KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO

KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO contains Ketoconazole and Zinc pyrithione which belong to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used to manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection causing dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body).

Before using KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, or if you are using any steroids. KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice.

KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO is not recommended for use in infants and children. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, wash eyes thoroughly with water. Call your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.
uses: To manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO
To manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
mechanismOfAction:
How KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO Works

KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO reduces infection where ketoconazole kills the fungus and zinc pyrithione stops the growth of the infecting organism.
usageDetails:
How to use KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO

Use KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wet your hair and scalp and apply sufficient KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO to produce enough lather. Massage for one minute to produce enough lather and keep it for 5 minutes.

If KETAMIDE AD SHAMPOO accidentally gets in your eye, wash your eyes with water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Allergic reaction (swollen face, lips, mouth, tongue, or throat which may cause trouble in swallowing or breathing)

introduction:
Introduction About LUHON 1% CREAM

LUHON 1% CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LUHON 1% CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LUHON 1% CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUHON 1% CREAM

LUHON 1% CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LUHON 1% CREAM Works

LUHON 1% CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LUHON 1% CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: SALISIA TV 2% Lotion 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About SALISIA TV 2% LOTION

SALISIA TV 2% LOTION contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage fungal and yeast infections which may appear on the skin of the hands, feet, genital area, trunk, groin, scalp, face, chest or back.

SALISIA TV 2% LOTION is not recommended for eye infections. Before applying SALISIA TV 2% LOTION, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

SALISIA TV 2% LOTION can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. SALISIA TV 2% LOTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying SALISIA TV 2% LOTION are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SALISIA TV 2% LOTION

Manages the fungal or yeast infections of skin appearing on:

Trunk, chest, back
Hands, feet
Scalp, face
Groin, genitals
mechanismOfAction:
How SALISIA TV 2% LOTION Works

SALISIA TV 2% LOTION reduces fungal infection by inhibiting the growth of the fungus by weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use SALISIA TV 2% LOTION

Apply SALISIA TV 2% LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using SALISIA TV 2% LOTION in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using SALISIA TV 2% LOTION until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

name: Ebspor Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBSPOR CREAM

EBSPOR CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBSPOR CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBSPOR CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBSPOR CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBSPOR CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBSPOR CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)

Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:

EBSPOR CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.

Always use EBSPOR CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBSPOR CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. name: LOGIFIN CL Lotion 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About LOGIFIN CL LOTION

LOGIFIN CL LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LOGIFIN CL LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LOGIFIN CL LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LOGIFIN CL LOTION

LOGIFIN CL LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LOGIFIN CL LOTION Works

LOGIFIN CL LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LOGIFIN CL LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: NOSKURF Daily Cream 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About NOSKURF CREAM

Noskurf Daily Cream is an anti-dandruff cream which is used for a healthy maintenance of scalp, free from dandruff. It contains mineral oil, sweet almond oil, panthenol, zinc pyrithione and climbazole as active ingredients that help soothe the scalp.

Panthenol helps strengthen the hair and soothe the scalp. It also pulls water from the air and improves moisture retention in the hair shaft. Mineral oil locks water in and protects from the toxins and other damaging environmental factors, delivering good conditioning, shine, softness, and smoothness to the hair.

Climbazole is known to improve the scalp skin barrier, which becomes weaker in dandruff. Zinc pyrithione heals the scalp by normalizing the epithelial keratinization (process to reduce evaporation from underlying tissues) or sebum production or both. Almond oil calms down the itching associated with dandruff and also restricts the growth of the dandruff-causing fungus.

Always use Noskurf Daily Cream as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Avoid getting it in your eyes. Do not use Noskurf Daily Cream if you are allergic to any of its components.

name: EBERFINE XL Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERFINE XL CREAM

EBERFINE XL CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERFINE XL CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERFINE XL CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERFINE XL CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERFINE XL CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERFINE XL CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERFINE XL CREAM

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERFINE XL CREAM Works

EBERFINE XL CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERFINE XL CREAM

Always use EBERFINE XL CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERFINE XL CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERFINE XL CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

introduction:
Introduction About CICO 1% CREAM

CICO 1% CREAM contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing an itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas and the inner thigh and characterized by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes), and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms, and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (a fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut, and vagina), tinea (pityriasis), and versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms, or legs).

CICO 1% CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

CICO 1% CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using CICO 1% CREAM are itchiness, a mild burning sensation, or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

Always use CICO 1% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply CICO 1% CREAM into the affected and surrounding skin areas with clean hands and let it dry in air, do not apply a covering on it.

name: KZ Soap 125gm
introduction:
Introduction About KZ SOAP

KZ SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

KZ SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using KZ SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. KZ SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of KZ SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with KZ SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

If KZ SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TEXIFEN CREAM

TEXIFEN CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TEXIFEN CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TEXIFEN CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TEXIFEN CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEXIFEN CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TEXIFEN CREAM Works

TEXIFEN CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About SERIVA CREAM

SERIVA CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use SERIVA CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. SERIVA CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SERIVA CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of SERIVA CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Triben Plus Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About TRIBEN PLUS CREAM

TRIBEN PLUS CREAM is used to provide relief from skin infection, inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling. It contains a combination of Beclomethasone, Clotrimazole and Neomycin.

Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine. It works by making your body not release certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling. Clotrimazole and neomycin stops the activity of microbes (fungi and bacteria) which when applied at the infected site.

TRIBEN PLUS CREAM is strictly for external use only. Apply a thin layer of TRIBEN PLUS CREAM on the affected skin areas. Avoid its contact with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, or any open wounds. Do not use TRIBEN PLUS CREAM for more than 4 weeks without consulting your doctor.

Before using TRIBEN PLUS CREAM inform your doctor if you have any viral skin infections, skin ulcers, spotty red rash around the mouth, acne, rosacea (redness of skin) or itching of your anus (back passage) or genital areas as a precaution. Consult your doctor before using TRIBEN PLUS CREAM if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of applying TRIBEN PLUS CREAM are skin thinning and application site irritation and burning sensation. Consult your doctor if this side effect trouble you.
uses: Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRIBEN PLUS CREAM
Skin infections (Fungal and Bacterial origin)
Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIBEN PLUS CREAM Works

TRIBEN PLUS CREAM contains three medicines, namely beclomethasone, clotrimazole and neomycin. Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine which stops your body from producing certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling, while parallelly making your body release chemicals that heals inflammation.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medication which works by inhibiting the synthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Without ergosterol, the cell membranes become weakened and leaky, leading to fungal cell damage.

Neomycin is an antibiotic which stops protein synthesis in bacteria which is necessary for it to survive. As a result, it disrupts bacterial growth and replication and controls the spread of bacterial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use TRIBEN PLUS CREAM

Apply a small amount of TRIBEN PLUS CREAM into the affected skin areas or directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop using or overuse TRIBEN PLUS CREAM without consulting your doctor.

Avoid contact of TRIBEN PLUS CREAM with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. In case of accidental contact, rinse with plenty of water.

name: FLUCOZEST 0.5% Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About FLUCOZEST 0.5% GEL

FLUCOZEST 0.5% GEL contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage dermal fungal infections (dermatomycosis) caused by dermatophytes, yeasts, and moulds such as tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea corporis (ring worm), tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash), and tinea versicolor.

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot) is a fungal infection that begins between toes generally in people whose feet remain sweaty. It is characterized by symptoms such as scaly rashes, itching, stinging, and burning between toes. Tinea corporis (ring worm) is a fungal infection causing circular itchy rashes with clearer skin in the middle, resembling a ring.

Tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) or jock itch is a fungal infection characterized by red and itchy rashes in the moist areas of the body such as groin. Tinea versicolor is a fungal infection that is characterized by abnormal skin pigmentation such as light and dark patches at the affected area.

Before using FLUCOZEST 0.5% GEL inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver, heart, and lung problems. FLUCOZEST 0.5% GEL is not recommended to use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. FLUCOZEST 0.5% GEL can be used in children and adolescents. Consult with your child’s doctor before using it for your child.

There is no information on the use of FLUCOZEST 0.5% GEL in elderly patients. Consult with your doctor before using. The most common side effects of using FLUCOZEST 0.5% GEL are skin rash, irritation, dryness or cracking of the surrounding area, itchiness and burning sensation at the site of application. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen or persists.

name: KETZI Soap 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETZI SOAP

KETZI SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

KETZI SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using KETZI SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. KETZI SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of KETZI SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with KETZI SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How KETZI SOAP Works

KETZI SOAP clears the infection by causing holes in the fungal cell membranes, thus killing the fungi.
usageDetails:
How to use KETZI SOAP

Always apply KETZI SOAP as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply KETZI SOAP on the affected area. It can be applied on the body and scalp. Wash and rinse thoroughly with water after applying KETZI SOAP. Avoid contact of KETZI SOAP with the nose, mouth or eyes.

If KETZI SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
