Introduction About SERTASPOR CREAM

SERTASPOR CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use SERTASPOR CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. SERTASPOR CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SERTASPOR CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of SERTASPOR CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About EBERCOS CREAM

EBERCOS CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERCOS CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERCOS CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERCOS CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERCOS CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERCOS CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How EBERCOS CREAM Works

EBERCOS CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.

name: Amrocan Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMROCAN CREAM

AMROCAN CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROCAN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROCAN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROCAN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROCAN CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum

mechanismOfAction:
How AMROCAN CREAM Works

AMROCAN CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AMROCAN CREAM

Apply AMROCAN CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AMROCAN CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About TERBINAFORCE DUSTING POWDER

TERBINAFORCE DUSTING POWDER is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERBINAFORCE DUSTING POWDER is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERBINAFORCE DUSTING POWDER if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERBINAFORCE DUSTING POWDER are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBINAFORCE DUSTING POWDER
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBINAFORCE DUSTING POWDER Works

TERBINAFORCE DUSTING POWDER is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

name: NAILROX Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About NAILROX CREAM

NAILROX CREAM contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing an itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas and the inner thigh and characterized by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes), and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms, and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (a fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut, and vagina), tinea (pityriasis), and versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms, or legs).

NAILROX CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

NAILROX CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using NAILROX CREAM are itchiness, a mild burning sensation, or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

It is used for the topical management of the following fungal skin infections:

Tinea (pityriasis) versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How NAILROX CREAM Works

NAILROX CREAM is a broad-spectrum antifungal medication that works by inhibiting or killing a wide range of fungi that cause infections. Thus, it helps to manage fungal infections effectively.

introduction:
Introduction About EBERJEN M CREAM

EBERJEN M CREAM is a combination of Eberconazole and Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used to manage fungal infections of the skin folds and skin in those individuals who have compromised immunity and in general.

EBERJEN M CREAM is not recommended for use in conditions like rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne, dermatitis around the mouth, thinning of the skin, genital itching, nappy rash, cold sores, warts, ulcerated skin, shingles, chickenpox, wounds and other skin infections. Before using EBERJEN M CREAM inform your doctor if you are taking or using any other medicines including prescription or non-prescription medicines to manage the risk of any unusual effects.  

EBERJEN M CREAM should not be used in pregnant and breast-feeding women and in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine. The most common side effects of using EBERJEN M CREAM are itching and skin redness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Used to manage fungal infection of the skin folds and skin in those individuals who have compromised immunity and in general
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERJEN M CREAM
Used to manage fungal infection of the skin folds and skin in those individuals who have compromised immunity and in general
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERJEN M CREAM Works

EBERJEN M CREAM helps in managing fungal infections of the skin where Eberconazole is an Antifungal medicine which works by stopping the growth of fungi by binding to certain receptors that stop the formation of fungal hormone (ergosterol). Due to the lack of the hormone ergosterol, the fungi are not able to survive. Mometasone inhibits the substances that cause inflammation such as prostaglandins and leukotrienes and helps relieving the inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERJEN M CREAM

Always apply EBERJEN M CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. A thin layer of the medicine has to be applied on the affected area. Use this medicine for time it has been prescribed by your doctor even if your symptoms start getting better. Managed areas need not be covered with plaster or bandage. Wash hands before and after the application of EBERJEN M CREAM. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency and duration of EBERJEN M CREAM for you depending upon your age and severity of the condition.

name: C WIN Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About C WIN LOTION

C WIN LOTION contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing an itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas and the inner thigh and characterized by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes), and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms, and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (a fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut, and vagina), tinea (pityriasis), and versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms, or legs).

C WIN LOTION should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

C WIN LOTION should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using C WIN LOTION are itchiness, a mild burning sensation, or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

name: LULIBOR ADVANCED Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About LULIBOR ADVANCED LOTION

LULIBOR ADVANCED LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIBOR ADVANCED LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIBOR ADVANCED LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIBOR ADVANCED LOTION

LULIBOR ADVANCED LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIBOR ADVANCED LOTION Works

LULIBOR ADVANCED LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIBOR ADVANCED LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: XAMPU KZ Shampoo 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About XAMPU KZ SHAMPOO

XAMPU KZ SHAMPOO contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage fungal infections on scalp and body such as dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis (a dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body) and tinea versicolor.

These conditions can be itchy and are caused by a fungus called Malassezia. Tinea versicolor is characterised by white to brown patches on the body that sometimes appear after exposure to the sun.

Before using XAMPU KZ SHAMPOO, inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or if you are using any steroids. XAMPU KZ SHAMPOO can be used by pregnant and breastfeeding women, but consult your doctor for advice. XAMPU KZ SHAMPOO should not be used in infants or children.

The most common side effects of using XAMPU KZ SHAMPOO are itching, stinging, and dryness at the site of application. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

If XAMPU KZ SHAMPOO accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will determine the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight, and disease condition.

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIYA LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIYA LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

As a result, LULIYA LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: Rexizole B Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About REXIZOLE B LOTION

REXIZOLE B LOTION is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. REXIZOLE B LOTION is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

REXIZOLE B LOTION is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying REXIZOLE B LOTION, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

REXIZOLE B LOTION should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of REXIZOLE B LOTION
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How REXIZOLE B LOTION Works

REXIZOLE B LOTION is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use REXIZOLE B LOTION

Use REXIZOLE B LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying REXIZOLE B LOTION around your eyes, including eyelids.

name: Novale Scalp 2% Lotion 75ml
introduction:
Introduction About NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION

NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage fungal and yeast infections which may appear on the skin of the hands, feet, genital area, trunk, groin, scalp, face, chest or back.

NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION is not recommended for eye infections. Before applying NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION

Manages the fungal or yeast infections of skin appearing on:

Trunk, chest, back
Hands, feet
Scalp, face
Groin, genitals
mechanismOfAction:
How NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION Works

NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION reduces fungal infection by inhibiting the growth of the fungus by weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION

Apply NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using NOVALE SCALP 2% LOTION until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About AF K LOTION

AF K LOTION contains Ketoconazole and Zinc pyrithione which belong to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used to manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection causing dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body).

Before using AF K LOTION, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, or if you are using any steroids. AF K LOTION can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice.

AF K LOTION is not recommended for use in infants and children. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, wash eyes thoroughly with water. Call your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.
uses: To manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
usesDetails:
Uses Of AF K LOTION
To manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
mechanismOfAction:
How AF K LOTION Works

AF K LOTION reduces infection where ketoconazole kills the fungus and zinc pyrithione stops the growth of the infecting organism.
usageDetails:
How to use AF K LOTION

Use AF K LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wet your hair and scalp and apply sufficient AF K LOTION to produce enough lather. Massage for one minute to produce enough lather and keep it for 5 minutes.

If AF K LOTION accidentally gets in your eye, wash your eyes with water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Lupizol 1% Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About LUPIZOL 1% CREAM

LUPIZOL 1% CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LUPIZOL 1% CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LUPIZOL 1% CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPIZOL 1% CREAM

LUPIZOL 1% CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPIZOL 1% CREAM Works

LUPIZOL 1% CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LUPIZOL 1% CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: TRIFAS Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About TRIFAS CREAM

TRIFAS CREAM contains Ciclopirox, which belongs to the group of medicines called antifungals. It is indicated for the topical management of fungal skin infections like tinea pedis (infection of the feet causing an itchy, scaly rash), tinea cruris (fungal infection involving genital areas and the inner thigh and characterized by red, itchy, ring-shaped rashes), and tinea corporis (fungal infection of the trunk, arms, and legs).

It is also used to manage candidiasis or moniliasis (a fungal infection of the skin, mouth, throat, gut, and vagina), tinea (pityriasis), and versicolor (a fungal infection causing lightening or darkening of the skin of the neck, chest, arms, or legs).

TRIFAS CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

TRIFAS CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using TRIFAS CREAM are itchiness, a mild burning sensation, or redness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea corporis, and tinea cruris
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRIFAS CREAM

It is used for the topical management of the following fungal skin infections:

Tinea pedis, tinea corporis, and tinea cruris
Candidiasis or moniliasis
Tinea (pityriasis) versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIFAS CREAM Works

TRIFAS CREAM is a broad-spectrum antifungal medication that works by inhibiting or killing a wide range of fungi that cause infections. Thus, it helps to manage fungal infections effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use TRIFAS CREAM

Always use TRIFAS CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply TRIFAS CREAM into the affected and surrounding skin areas with clean hands and let it dry in air, do not apply a covering on it.
sideEffects: Itchiness, mild burning sensation or redness
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of TRIFAS CREAM
Common
Itchiness, mild burning sensation or redness

Stop using TRIFAS CREAM and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe itching, redness, burning, dryness
Irritation of managed skin
Change in colour of nails
Sensitivity (allergic reaction) or chemical irritation

warnings.details: TRIFAS CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.
TRIFAS CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding woman as it is not known whether this medicine is passed into breast milk. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.
Do not use TRIFAS CREAM if you are allergic to ciclopirox or any other ingredients of this medicine.
The safety and effectiveness of TRIFAS CREAM in children below 10 years of age have not been established. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

name: Lichensa Ointment 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About LICHENSA OINTMENT

Lichensa Ointment is a specially formulated cream used for cracked heels, dhobi’s itch, diaper rash, napkin rash, nail infections, fungal infections between fingers and toes, boils, and bed sores. It contains Clotrimazole, Boric acid, Zinc oxide and Menthol as active ingredients.

Clotrimazole inhibits the growth of disease-causing fungus that helps the body to fight against fungal infections. Boric acid has antifungal, antiseptic properties which helps to reduce skin inflammations. Menthol gives a cooling sensation once applied into the skin that helps to relieve pain. Zinc oxide forms a skin barrier that helps to protect skin from moisture and irritants.

Always use Lichensa Ointment exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected parts. Apply Lichensa Ointment evenly on the affected parts. It is advised to use at night at least twice a day.

Introduction About ZOCON KZ SHAMPOO

ZOCON KZ SHAMPOO contains Ketoconazole and Zinc pyrithione which belong to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used to manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection causing dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body).

Before using ZOCON KZ SHAMPOO, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, or if you are using any steroids. ZOCON KZ SHAMPOO can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice.

ZOCON KZ SHAMPOO is not recommended for use in infants and children. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, wash eyes thoroughly with water. Call your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.

name: CLOCIP L Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLOCIP L CREAM

CLOCIP L CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

CLOCIP L CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying CLOCIP L CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLOCIP L CREAM

CLOCIP L CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How CLOCIP L CREAM Works

CLOCIP L CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, CLOCIP L CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Metasone Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About METASONE CREAM

METASONE CREAM contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. METASONE CREAM is used in the management of inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses such as psoriasis and atopic dermatitis. It is also used to manage scalp psoriasis and seborrheic dermatitis.

Psoriasis is a type of skin disease that causes skin rash with itchy, scaly patches which most commonly occurs on the knees, elbows, trunk and scalp. Atopic dermatitis is a skin condition which makes your skin red and itchy. Scalp psoriasis is a common skin disorder that makes skin raised, reddish, often scaly on the scalp which can either occur as a single patch or several patches on the scalp. Seborrheic dermatitis is a common skin condition that affects your scalp which is characterized by red, and scaly patches of skin and dandruff.

Avoid applying METASONE CREAM, if you have rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne (pimples), skin atrophy (thinning of the skin), dermatitis (skin inflammation) around the mouth, genital itching, viral infections such as shingles, chickenpox (viral infection), ulcerated skin, and wounds.

Before applying METASONE CREAM, inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease. METASONE CREAM should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before applying METASONE CREAM.

The medicine is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor before applying METASONE CREAM.

The most common side effects of using METASONE CREAM are mild to moderate pruritus (itchy skin), burning and stinging sensation of skin, folliculitis (a type of skin infection marked by inflamed hair follicles), dryness of skin, mild skin atrophy (thin-shiny appearing skin). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worse.

METASONE CREAM works by reducing the inflammation of skin by blocking the production of a chemical messenger which is responsible for causing red, swollen and itchy skin that occurs due to an allergic reaction or irritation in the skin thereby providing relief from the symptoms of psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, scalp psoriasis and seborrhoeic dermatitis.

Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Avoid applying the medicine around your eyes, including eyelids.

name: GRIP HAIR AD Shampoo 150ml
introduction:
Introduction About GRIP HAIR AD SHAMPOO

GRIP HAIR AD Shampoo is an antidandruff shampoo used to relieve itching and flaking on scalp associated with dandruff. It contains Salicylic acid, Climbazole, Pentavitin, Tea tree oil, Rosemary extract and Dead sea minerals as active ingredients.

Climbazole is an antifungal agent used in the management of fungal skin infections such as dandruff. Salicylic acid is a keratolytic, or peeling agent, which works by causing the outer layer of skin to shed. Pentavitin has ultra-moisturizing and nourishing effect on your hair and scalp, which makes it beautifully strong and healthy. Tea tree oil helps to manage buildup of chemicals and dead skin. Rosemary extracts help to manage premature graying, dandruff and dryness or itching on scalp. Dead sea minerals hydrate and nourish the scalp and roots by boosting circulation. It also conditions the scalp, helping manage dandruff.

Always use GRIP HAIR AD Shampoo exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Massage GRIP HAIR AD Shampoo into wet hair for 60 seconds. Rinse, then apply again and massage in hair for about 5 mins before rinsing. Avoid GRIP HAIR AD Shampoo in direct contact with your eyes. Do not use this product if you are allergic to any of its ingredients.

name: KETO B Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETO B CREAM

KETO B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole, which belong to the groups of medicines called Anti-inflammatory and Antifungal respectively. It is used to manage different kinds of fungal infections like Tinea corporis (Ringworm), Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp).

These fungal infections can spread easily from one person to another and cause redness and itching in the affected area. They are usually seen in moist and sweaty areas of the body as tinea pedis is usually seen in between the toes due to fitting shoes whereas tinea cruris and groin are seen in the inner thigh region.

Avoid applying KETO B CREAM on the skin surface that is cut, scraped, sunburned, or eczema affected. KETO B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients suffering from skin-related viral infections, tuberculosis, acne rosacea, and perioral dermatitis.

KETO B CREAM should be used with caution in pregnancy and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. KETO B CREAM is not recommended for use in children 9 years of age and below. KETO B CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETO B CREAM

Manages fungal infections such as:

Ringworm (Tinea corporis)
Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp)
mechanismOfAction:
How KETO B CREAM Works

KETO B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole. Beclomethasone is a corticosteroid that works by reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms like itching, redness, irritation, and swelling by blocking the enzymes responsible for causing it (prostaglandins and leukotrienes). Ketoconazole is an imidazole that blocks the synthesis of ergosterol, a key component of the fungal cell membrane, thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use KETO B CREAM

Apply KETO B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean the skin and dry the skin area to be managed. Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, or inside the vagina. Do not cover or wrap or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About LULIBRUT CREAM

LULIBRUT CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIBRUT CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIBRUT CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIBRUT CREAM

LULIBRUT CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIBRUT CREAM Works

LULIBRUT CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIBRUT CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Kansel B Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About KANSEL B LOTION

KANSEL B LOTION is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. KANSEL B LOTION is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

KANSEL B LOTION is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying KANSEL B LOTION, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

KANSEL B LOTION should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KANSEL B LOTION
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KANSEL B LOTION Works

KANSEL B LOTION is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use KANSEL B LOTION

Use KANSEL B LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying KANSEL B LOTION around your eyes, including eyelids.

introduction:
Introduction About ONABET POWDER

ONABET POWDER contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters and scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use ONABET POWDER if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. ONABET POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. ONABET POWDER is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of ONABET POWDER include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness and burning sensation etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:
How ONABET POWDER Works

ONABET POWDER works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival.  As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.

Always use ONABET POWDER as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using ONABET POWDER. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration and frequency for you depending on the existing conditions etc.

name: ABZORB ANTIFUNGAL Soap 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About ABZORB ANTIFUNGAL SOAP

Abzorb Antifungal Soap is an antifungal medicated soap which is used for the management of fungal skin infections such as ring worm, fungal sweat rash, fungal nappy rash, athlete’s foot and fungal infection of genitals. It contains clotrimazole as an active ingredient which works by inhibiting the fungal growth.

Clotrimazole acts as an anti-fungal agent by inhibiting the synthesis of ergosterol which is an important constituent of fungal cell membrane. By doing so, clotrimazole inhibit further growth of fungal cells and manages the spread and effectively manages the fungal infection.

Always use Abzorb Antifungal soap as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the affected area properly with warm water and rub the soap gently and then rinse it well and pat dry the area. Avoid contact with eyes while using Abzorb Antifungal Soap. If your symptoms are not subsided after 4 weeks of use, you must consult your doctor. Inform your doctor if you are suffering from any other skin condition before using Abzorb Antifungal Soap.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ABZORB ANTIFUNGAL SOAP

Abzorb Antifungal soap may cause skin irritability, redness or itching at the application site in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such effects while using Abzorb Antifungal soap.

name: AMROLSTAR Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About AMROLSTAR LOTION

AMROLSTAR LOTION contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROLSTAR LOTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLSTAR LOTION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLSTAR LOTION is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROLSTAR LOTION are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMROLSTAR LOTION

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How AMROLSTAR LOTION Works

AMROLSTAR LOTION works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AMROLSTAR LOTION

Apply AMROLSTAR LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AMROLSTAR LOTION.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About LULY

LULY is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULY is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULY to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULY

LULY is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULY Works

LULY works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULY relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: EBERNET Cream 60gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERNET CREAM

EBERNET CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERNET CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERNET CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERNET CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERNET CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERNET CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERNET CREAM

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERNET CREAM Works

EBERNET CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERNET CREAM

Always use EBERNET CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERNET CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERNET CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

introduction:
Introduction About OCONA Z LOTION

Ocona- Z Lotion is an Antifungal agent used to manage Candidal or Dermatophyte infections of skin, Seborrhoeic dermatitis and Dandruff of the scalp. It contains Zinc Pyrithione and Ketoconazole as active ingredients that helps to remove dandruff from the scalp as well as irritations in the skin.

Ketoconazole manages the growth of fungus and relieves itching, flaking, and scaling associated with dandruff. Zinc Pyrithione possess antimicrobial, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. It kills the microorganisms that can contribute to an itchy, flaky skin, scalp and manages dandruff.

Always use Ocona- Z Lotion exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Wet your hair and scalp. Take adequate quantity of Ocona- Z Lotion and apply on your hair and scalp. Massage for 1 minute to form a thick lather. Wash the hair thoroughly with warm water or as recommended by your physician.

Avoid contact with your eyes. Incase of direct eye contact, rinse thoroughly with clean water. Discontinue using Ocona- Z Lotion and contact a doctor if you experience irritation or rashes.

name: Teraderm Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About TERADERM CREAM

TERADERM CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERADERM CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERADERM CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERADERM CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:

Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERADERM CREAM Works

TERADERM CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

name: F Next Dusting Powder 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About F NEXT DUSTING POWDER

F Next Dusting Powder is an antifungal powder which is ideal for management of various fungal infections such as ring worms, dhobie itch, athlete’s foot, heat and friction rashes and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It contains clotrimazole and allantoin as active ingredients.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal agent. It works by blocking the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential constituent of fungal cell membrane which helps to keep the fungal cell intact and supports their growth and multiplication. Inhibition of ergosterol biosynthesis damages the fungal cell integrity and leads to the inhibition of fungal growth. Allantoin hydrates your skin, soothes skin irritation and makes your skin soft and smooth.

F Next Dusting Powder is for external use only. Wash the infected area thoroughly and pat it dry. Dust a thin layer of F Next Dusting Powder evenly to the affected areas two or three times daily or as directed by your physician. Avoid contact with eyes or mouth, if happens rinse it thoroughly with water. Continue to apply this medicine, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

name: Mycoderm NM Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About MYCODERM NM CREAM

MYCODERM NM CREAM is a combination of Miconazole, Mometasone and Nadifloxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals, Corticosteroids and Antibiotic respectively. It is used to manage bacterial and fungal skin infections like atopic and contact dermatitis, erythema multiforme, infective eczema, psoriasis and skin lesions.

Bacterial infection occurs when bacteria enters the body, increase the number of bacteria and cause a reaction in the body. A fungal infection (mycosis) is a skin disease that is caused by a fungus when it enters the tissue. Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another person. Before using MYCODERM NM CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis. MYCODERM NM CREAM is not recommended for use during pregnancy.

MYCODERM NM CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. MYCODERM NM CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions (such as burning, irritation, itching, flaking and redness). Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MYCODERM NM CREAM

It is used to manage bacterial and fungal skin infections such as:

Atopic and contact dermatitis
Erythema multiforme
Infective eczema
Psoriasis
Skin lesions
mechanismOfAction:
How MYCODERM NM CREAM Works

MYCODERM NM CREAM is a combination of Miconazole, Mometasone and Nadifloxacin. Miconazole works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungi and works against fungi. Mometasone is a corticosteroid that works by blocking the various chemical messengers (like histamine) involved in allergic and non-allergic mediated inflammation. It reduces inflammation, itchiness and redness by managing the traveling of infection-fighting white blood cells (WBCs) to the affected area of the body. Nadifloxacin belongs to antibiotic works by against the bacteria that cause skin infections and also inhibits the repairing of bacterial cells, thereby managing the further spread of the infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MYCODERM NM CREAM

Apply MYCODERM NM CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.
sideEffects: Application site reactions (burning, irritation, itching, flaking and redness)
Severe skin reactions or allergies (swelling of the face, tongue or throat, difficulty swallowing or difficulty breathing, hives, severe irritation, reddening or blistering of the skin)
Blurred vision or other visual disturbances
sideEffectsDetails:

Common
Application site reactions (burning, irritation, itching, flaking and redness)

Stop applying MYCODERM NM CREAM and contact your physician immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe skin reactions or allergies (swelling of the face, tongue or throat, difficulty swallowing or difficulty breathing, hives, severe irritation, reddening or blistering of the skin)
Blurred vision or other visual disturbances

name: EBERMED Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERMED CREAM

EBERMED CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERMED CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERMED CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERMED CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERMED CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERMED CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERMED CREAM

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERMED CREAM Works

EBERMED CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERMED CREAM

Always use EBERMED CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERMED CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERMED CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

name: IZ K Lotion 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About IZ K LOTION

IZ K LOTION contains Ketoconazole and Zinc pyrithione which belong to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used to manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection causing dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body).

Before using IZ K LOTION, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, or if you are using any steroids. IZ K LOTION can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice.

IZ K LOTION is not recommended for use in infants and children. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, wash eyes thoroughly with water. Call your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.
uses: To manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
usesDetails:
Uses Of IZ K LOTION
To manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
mechanismOfAction:
How IZ K LOTION Works

IZ K LOTION reduces infection where ketoconazole kills the fungus and zinc pyrithione stops the growth of the infecting organism.
usageDetails:
How to use IZ K LOTION

Use IZ K LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wet your hair and scalp and apply sufficient IZ K LOTION to produce enough lather. Massage for one minute to produce enough lather and keep it for 5 minutes.

If IZ K LOTION accidentally gets in your eye, wash your eyes with water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Allergic reaction (swollen face, lips, mouth, tongue, or throat which may cause trouble in swallowing or breathing)
Severe skin irritation or reddening on the applied area
Worsening of your condition or no improvement after regular use as directed

name: TERZIDE 1% Dusting Powder 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About TERZIDE 1% DUSTING POWDER

TERZIDE 1% DUSTING POWDER is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERZIDE 1% DUSTING POWDER is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERZIDE 1% DUSTING POWDER if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERZIDE 1% DUSTING POWDER are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERZIDE 1% DUSTING POWDER
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERZIDE 1% DUSTING POWDER Works

TERZIDE 1% DUSTING POWDER is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

Eberfun Cream is a broad-spectrum antifungal used to manage topical fungal infections including Tinea corporis (ring worm), Tinea pedis (athlete’s foot), Tinea crusis (jock itch), Cutaneous candidiasis, and Tinea versicolor (pityriasis versicolor). introduction:
Introduction About CANDIZEST C GEL

CANDIZEST C GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Clotrimazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics and Antifungal agents respectively. It is used to manage vaginal (genital) infections (Ex. vaginal candidiasis, bacterial vaginosis and mixed vaginal infections). It can also reduce vaginal itching and irritation caused due to infections. and

CANDIZEST C GEL is meant for intravaginal use only. Carefully apply the medicine deep into the vagina as far as possible. Wash your hands before and after application. Closely follow the dose-related instructions given by your doctor to achieve better results. Skipping doses in between the therapy or stopping the therapy without consulting your doctor may not result in adequate infection control.

While using CANDIZEST C GEL, do not engage in vaginal intercourse or use any vaginal products (such as tampons or douches). This medicine may weaken condoms and diaphragms. Therefore, choose an alternative method for contraception.

Before using CANDIZEST C GEL inform your doctor if you have diabetes, weak immune system or any stomach problems (such as colitis). You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding or currently having periods before using CANDIZEST C GEL as a precaution.

CANDIZEST C GEL is generally safe and well tolerated with fewer side effects like mild vaginal itching or irritation, vaginal discharge and mild diarrhea. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Reduces vaginal itching and irritation caused due to infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of CANDIZEST C GEL
Manage vaginal (genital) infections
Reduces vaginal itching and irritation caused due to infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CANDIZEST C GEL Works

CANDIZEST C GEL is effective in managing both bacterial and fungal genital infections. It works by killing the susceptible microorganism that causes infection within the body. It contains two medicines namely clindamycin and clotrimazole.

Clindamycin is an antibacterial agent. It blocks the production of certain bacterial proteins which is essential for the bacteria to survival. This action manages the further growth and multiplication of bacteria within the body

Clotrimazole is an antifungal agent. It blocks the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the fungal cell which is essential for its survival. This action kills the susceptible fungi and manages the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:
How to use CANDIZEST C GEL

Apply CANDIZEST C GEL as directed by your physician. It should be used only in and around the vagina or the genital area. CANDIZEST C GEL comes in a tube along with an applicator. Remove the cap from the tube and connect the nozzle end of the applicator with the tube.

Gently squeeze the sufficient medicine from the tube into the applicator. The marking present in the applicator may help you to measure the correct dosage as instructed by your doctor.

Remove the applicator from the tube and lie down on your back with legs wide apart. Gently insert the applicator into the vagina.  Press the plunger present in the applicator downwards to release the medicine in the vagina.

Remove the applicator from the vagina after application. To cleanse the applicator, pull the plunger outside and wash it with mild soap and warm water.

If you want to apply CANDIZEST C GEL to the external parts of vagina, take the required quantity of CANDIZEST C GEL and apply it at the required sites of the genital area (such as vulva, labia minora, clitoris and vaginal orifice).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

name: FUNGICROS Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About FUNGICROS CREAM

FUNGICROS CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

FUNGICROS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

FUNGICROS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

FUNGICROS CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying FUNGICROS CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of FUNGICROS CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How FUNGICROS CREAM Works

FUNGICROS CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use FUNGICROS CREAM

Apply FUNGICROS CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using FUNGICROS CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

Introduction About LICHENSA OINTMENT

Lichensa Ointment is an antimicrobial cream that is used for the management of cracked heels, dhobi’s itch, diaper rash (Adults and kids), napkin rash, bed sores, boils, nail infections, fungal infections between fingers and toes, burns, and skin injuries. It contains zinc oxide, clotrimazole, boric acid, and menthol as active ingredients.

Clotrimazole acts as an anti-fungal agent and helps to kill the fungus that is causing skin infection. Zinc Oxide has antibacterial action that manages skin infections. Apply Lichensa Ointment as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean the affected area and apply a thin and even layer of Lichensa Ointment. Apply Lichensa ointment before sleeping and at least twice a day or as directed by your doctor.

Introduction About LUMIZA CREAM

LUMIZA CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LUMIZA CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LUMIZA CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)

How LUMIZA CREAM Works

LUMIZA CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LUMIZA CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: FORFORA Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About FORFORA CREAM

FORFORA CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use FORFORA CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying FORFORA CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

FORFORA CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. FORFORA CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying FORFORA CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FORFORA CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How FORFORA CREAM Works

FORFORA CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use FORFORA CREAM

Apply FORFORA CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using FORFORA CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using FORFORA CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOBEN G CREAM

CLOBEN G CREAM is used to provide relief from skin infection, inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling. It contains a combination of Beclomethasone, Clotrimazole and Neomycin.

Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine. It works by making your body not release certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling. Clotrimazole and neomycin stops the activity of microbes (fungi and bacteria) which when applied at the infected site.

CLOBEN G CREAM is strictly for external use only. Apply a thin layer of CLOBEN G CREAM on the affected skin areas. Avoid its contact with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, or any open wounds. Do not use CLOBEN G CREAM for more than 4 weeks without consulting your doctor.

Before using CLOBEN G CREAM inform your doctor if you have any viral skin infections, skin ulcers, spotty red rash around the mouth, acne, rosacea (redness of skin) or itching of your anus (back passage) or genital areas as a precaution. Consult your doctor before using CLOBEN G CREAM if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of applying CLOBEN G CREAM are skin thinning and application site irritation and burning sensation. Consult your doctor if this side effect trouble you.
uses: Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLOBEN G CREAM
Skin infections (Fungal and Bacterial origin)
Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
mechanismOfAction:
How CLOBEN G CREAM Works

CLOBEN G CREAM contains three medicines, namely beclomethasone, clotrimazole and neomycin. Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine which stops your body from producing certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling, while parallelly making your body release chemicals that heals inflammation.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medication which works by inhibiting the synthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Without ergosterol, the cell membranes become weakened and leaky, leading to fungal cell damage.

Neomycin is an antibiotic which stops protein synthesis in bacteria which is necessary for it to survive. As a result, it disrupts bacterial growth and replication and controls the spread of bacterial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use CLOBEN G CREAM

Apply a small amount of CLOBEN G CREAM into the affected skin areas or directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop using or overuse CLOBEN G CREAM without consulting your doctor.

Avoid contact of CLOBEN G CREAM with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. In case of accidental contact, rinse with plenty of water.

Introduction About SYLDEM CREAM

SYLDEM CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

SYLDEM CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying SYLDEM CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
