introduction:
Introduction About ESAVA CREAM

ESAVA CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use ESAVA CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying ESAVA CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

ESAVA CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. ESAVA CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying ESAVA CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESAVA CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ESAVA CREAM Works

ESAVA CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use ESAVA CREAM

Apply ESAVA CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using ESAVA CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using ESAVA CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About KONAZ 2% SOAP

KONAZ 2% SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

KONAZ 2% SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using KONAZ 2% SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. KONAZ 2% SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of KONAZ 2% SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with KONAZ 2% SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

If KONAZ 2% SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER

CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It also relives symptoms such as burning, itching, skin cracking, and discomfort caused by the skin infections. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin, causing redness and itching. An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes.

Clotrimazole works by blocking the fungal growth and managing the further occurrence of fungal infections. CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER is intended to manage fungal skin infections; hence, it should not be used for other infections of internal organs. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER.

CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for patients allergic to clotrimazole. CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in deep wounds and severe burns. CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Before taking CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER, inform your doctor if you’re under any medications.

How CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER Works

CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER works by managing the fungal growth. Clotrimazole works by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Always apply CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Do not take CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER orally. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER. Before using the CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER on the affected area, wash it thoroughly and make sure it is dry before using CANDIFUNG DUSTING POWDER.

name: Emluz 1% Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About EMLUZ 1% CREAM

EMLUZ 1% CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

EMLUZ 1% CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying EMLUZ 1% CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: CANDISKIN B Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About CANDISKIN B CREAM

CANDISKIN B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. CANDISKIN B CREAM is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

CANDISKIN B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying CANDISKIN B CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

CANDISKIN B CREAM should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CANDISKIN B CREAM
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CANDISKIN B CREAM Works

CANDISKIN B CREAM is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use CANDISKIN B CREAM

Use CANDISKIN B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying CANDISKIN B CREAM around your eyes, including eyelids.

Rare

Stop applying CANDISKIN B CREAM and contact your doctor if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions

CANDISKIN B CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before applying CANDISKIN B CREAM.
CANDISKIN B CREAM is unlikely to affect your ability to drive or operate machines. Consult your doctor before applying CANDISKIN B CREAM.
CANDISKIN B CREAM should be used with caution if you have liver disease. Consult your doctor before applying CANDISKIN B CREAM.
Do not use CANDISKIN B CREAM if you are allergic to Beclomethasone, Clotrimazole or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Have skin problems
Itching around your back passage or private parts
Viral infections
Skin blisters or sores that are caused by an infection
Varicose ulcers caused by swollen veins
Stasis ulcers caused by reduced blood or body fluid flow

Before applying CANDISKIN B CREAM, inform your doctor if you:

Have psoriasis (itchy skin)

CANDISKIN B CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Consult your doctor before applying  CANDISKIN B CREAM.

name: Crousho Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About CROUSHO GEL

CROUSHO GEL contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults and children (12 years and older) with a normal immune system to manage seborrheic dermatitis (dry, flaky skin on the scalp, face, ears, chest, or upper back).

Ketoconazole works by inhibiting skin yeast colonization, reducing itching and redness, loosening the crusts and scales, and reduction of inflammation.

Before applying CROUSHO GEL inform your doctor if you have any skin problems or allergies. CROUSHO GEL should be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by your doctor. CROUSHO GEL has not been studied in children younger than 12 years of age so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effect is a burning feeling when CROUSHO GEL is applied. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CROUSHO GEL
Manage seborrheic dermatitis
mechanismOfAction:
How CROUSHO GEL Works

CROUSHO GEL works by inhibiting skin yeast colonization, reducing itching and redness, loosening the crusts and scales, and reduction of inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use CROUSHO GEL

Apply CROUSHO GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after using CROUSHO GEL. Spread a thin layer evenly on the affected skin with your fingertips and cover all affected areas. Do not wash the areas where you applied CROUSHO GEL for at least 3 hours after applying it.

Wait at least 20 minutes after you use CROUSHO GEL on your skin before you put makeup or sunscreens on the affected areas. Use it only for the quantity and duration (preferably 2 weeks) specified by your doctor. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Burning feeling on the region of application
Itching, rash, or any skin irritation
Worsening of your skin condition (seborrheic dermatitis)

Common
Burning feeling on the region of application
Rare

Stop using CROUSHO GEL and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Itching, rash, or any skin irritation
Worsening of your skin condition (seborrheic dermatitis)

introduction:
Introduction About IZ S CREAM

IZ S CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use IZ S CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. IZ S CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. IZ S CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of IZ S CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of IZ S CREAM
Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:
How IZ S CREAM Works

IZ S CREAM works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use IZ S CREAM

Always use IZ S CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using IZ S CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

introduction:
Introduction About MYCOCLIN DUSTING POWDER

MYCOCLIN DUSTING POWDER contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters and scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use MYCOCLIN DUSTING POWDER if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. MYCOCLIN DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MYCOCLIN DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of MYCOCLIN DUSTING POWDER include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness and burning sensation etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:

name: Rexizole Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About REXIZOLE CREAM

REXIZOLE CREAM contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in the management of fungal skin infections such as ringworm (fungal infection of the skin or scalp), athlete’s foot (fungal infection between the toes), fungal nappy rash (skin rash affecting the nappy area), and fungal sweat rash. It also relieves irritation of the vulva (external thrush) or at the end of the penis, which may be associated with thrush.

Before applying REXIZOLE CREAM, inform your doctor about your previous existing disease conditions. REXIZOLE CREAM is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to clotrimazole. Avoid smoking or going near flames and wearing fabrics that catch fire easily due to the increased risk of severe burns.

REXIZOLE CREAM can be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Avoid using latex contraceptives (condoms or diaphragms), as this medicine may reduce the effectiveness of such contraceptives. Use alternative precautions for at least five days after using the medicine. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual effects.
uses: Manage fungal skin infections (such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, fungal nappy rash, and sweat rash)

mechanismOfAction:
How REXIZOLE CREAM Works

REXIZOLE CREAM acts by specifically inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol and other sterols (enzymes) required for cell membrane production; therefore, it inhibits the division and growth of fungi, eventually leading to cell death, which further manages fungal growth.
usageDetails:
How to use REXIZOLE CREAM

Always apply REXIZOLE CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected surface before applying the medicine. Apply and rub gently a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Do not use REXIZOLE CREAM on your face, eyes, or large area. Do not use under bandages or for a long time without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the duration and time interval for application depending on the type of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About GBHC SOAP

GBHC SOAP contains Gamma benzene hexachloride which belongs to the group of medicines called Pesticides. GBHC SOAP is used to manage skin disease caused by scabies bugs and head lice which is generally characterized by symptoms such as itching and small raised red spots on the skin in affected individuals.

GBHC SOAP is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Gamma Benzene Hexachloride. It is also not recommended for use in patients allergic to neurological disorders.

GBHC SOAP is not recommended for use during pregnancy and is advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

The medicine is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 3 years). Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

The most common side effects of using GBHC SOAP are skin rash, itching/burning skin, dry skin, and/or numbness/tingling of skin. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

GBHC SOAP works by blocking the action of GABA-gated chloride channel (neurotransmitter) in parasites which leads to low neuronal inhibition and paralysis in parasites thus resulting in its destruction and providing relief from skin disease caused by the parasites (scabies & head lice) in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About OCONA SOAP

OCONA SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

OCONA SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using OCONA SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. OCONA SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of OCONA SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with OCONA SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

If OCONA SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: LULIPORUS XL Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIPORUS XL CREAM

LULIPORUS XL CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIPORUS XL CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIPORUS XL CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIPORUS XL CREAM

LULIPORUS XL CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIPORUS XL CREAM Works

LULIPORUS XL CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIPORUS XL CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.

name: ITROMED Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About ITROMED GEL

ITROMED GEL is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, nails, vagina, etc. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

ITROMED GEL is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to Itraconazole. It is also not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women.

ITROMED GEL should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) since the medicine is known to be associated with a range of potential drug interactions. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of applying ITROMED GEL are common cold, nausea, blurred vision, tiredness, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
uses: Fungal infections of the skin, nails, etc.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITROMED GEL
Fungal infections of the skin, nails, etc.
mechanismOfAction:
How ITROMED GEL Works

ITROMED GEL works by inhibiting ergosterol synthesis (an organic compound responsible for maintaining cell membrane integrity of fungi cells) that leads to fungal cell membrane abnormalities (marked with increased permeability and disruption of fungi cells), thus causing destruction to the fungi cell and managing the occurrence of fungal infections in affected individuals.

name: CANDIDAC B Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About CANDIDAC B CREAM

CANDIDAC B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. CANDIDAC B CREAM is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

CANDIDAC B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying CANDIDAC B CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

CANDIDAC B CREAM should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CANDIDAC B CREAM
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CANDIDAC B CREAM Works

CANDIDAC B CREAM is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use CANDIDAC B CREAM

Use CANDIDAC B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying CANDIDAC B CREAM around your eyes, including eyelids.

introduction:
Introduction About TERFUNG LOTION

TERFUNG LOTION is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERFUNG LOTION is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERFUNG LOTION if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERFUNG LOTION are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERFUNG LOTION
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERFUNG LOTION Works

TERFUNG LOTION is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.
Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.
Wash your hands before and after application.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
Do not stop using TERFUNG LOTION without consulting your doctor.

LUCEE 1% CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LUCEE 1% CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LUCEE 1% CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About SCRABEL LOTION

SCRABEL LOTION contains Permethrin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parasitic agents. It is indicated for the management of scabies, pediculosis (lice) and crab louse infections.

Scabies is a condition that cause itchy skin caused by a tiny burrowing mite called Sarcoptes scabiei. It can cause intense itching in the area where the mite burrows.

SCRABEL LOTION is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chrysanthemums (a flower). SCRABEL LOTION should be used with caution in patients having lung diseases and eczema (skin disease).

It is not recommended for use in infants below 2 months of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

SCRABEL LOTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult with your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using SCRABEL LOTION are itching, redness of skin, tingling, prickling, skin burning sensation and dry skin. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SCRABEL LOTION

Used to manage:

Scabies
Pediculosis
Crab louse infections
mechanismOfAction:
How SCRABEL LOTION Works

SCRABEL LOTION helps in managing scabies and head lice by acting on the nerve cells of the disease-causing organism and alters the movements of certain ions (sodium ions) which leads to loss of their function. This causes respiratory failure of the disease-causing organism and hence, their destruction.
usageDetails:
How to use SCRABEL LOTION

Always apply SCRABEL LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. The medicine should be applied on all the affected areas. Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Wash hands before and after the application of SCRABEL LOTION. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth.
sideEffects: Signs of hypersensitivity reactions (skin rash, fever, difficulty in breathing or swallowing, scaly or flaky skin)

name: TRISILK Shampoo 150ml
introduction:
Introduction About TRISILK SHAMPOO

Trisilk Shampoo is a hair revitalising shampoo used to manage hair loss and encourage hair growth. It contains caffeine, anagain, vitamin B3, and vitamin B6 as active ingredients.

Caffeine and anagain combination target the culprits of hair loss. The powerful synergy of anagain and caffeine helps to diminish the hair loss and provide the renewed vitality to the hair. It manages hair loss by inhibiting the Dihydrotestosterone enzyme responsible for hair loss. It increases the blood flow which in turn increases the supply of nutrients and oxygen to the hair shaft. It helps in upregulating certain gene expression that are responsible for hair growth. The blend of vitamin B3 and vitamin B6 nourish and moisturize the hair to increase the flexibility, elasticity, and texture of physically and chemically damaged hair.

Always use Trisilk Shampoo as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Take an adequate amount of Trisilk Shampoo on your palm. Apply it on your wet hair and massage it on your scalp and hair, wait for two minutes. Rinse thoroughly with water. Discontinue Trisilk Shampoo use if irritation or rash occurs. Avoid contact with eyes, if so happens wash eyes immediately with plenty of water.
author: Dr. N. Sai Swaroop

name: Danclear Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About DANCLEAR CREAM

Danclear Cream is an anti-fungal and antidandruff cream that is used for the management of dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection of the scalp). It controls dandruff and provides relief from scaly, flaky, and itchy skin (face, ears, chest, and upper back). Danclear Cream contains Ketoconazole and Zinc Pyrithione as active ingredients that have antibacterial and antifungal properties.

Ketoconazole manages fungal infections by stopping the formation of ergosterol which is required to maintain the integrity of fungal cell wall. Zinc Pyrithione acts as an antibacterial and antidandruff agent that manages the growth of microbes and manages dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis.

Always use Danclear Cream as directed by your doctor. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and in case of accidental contact, rinse your eyes thoroughly with cold water. Consult with your doctor if you notice any allergic reactions while using it.
author: Dr. Priyanka Goel

name: KEVON Soap 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About KEVON SOAP

Kevon Soap is a medicated soap belongs to antifungal agent. It contains Ketoconazole which is used for superficial fungal and yeast infections. It is rich in glycerin hence minimal drying effect, that reduces itching and irritation of the skin.

Regular use of this soap reduces fungal recurrence. It offers gentle cleansing with appealing fragrance hence better patient compliance. It is made with breakthrough technology in which solubilized Ketoconazole is incorporated in a transparent soap.

It forms a thin film on the skin that gives increased contact time with the skin. It is a broad-spectrum antifungal with anti-inflammatory action. While bathing, rub Kevon Soap gently on the wet skin to produce enough lather. Allow it to stay on skin for 2-3 minutes and then rinse off with water. Use Kevon Soap as advised by your physician.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of KEVON SOAP

Kevon Soap generally won’t cause any side effects. If you experience any application site reactions such as dry skin, skin burning, irritation, itching and redness or any other allergic reaction, consult your doctor immediately.

name: TERBINADOC Dusting Powder 50g
introduction:
Introduction About TERBINADOC DUSTING POWDER

TERBINADOC DUSTING POWDER is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERBINADOC DUSTING POWDER is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERBINADOC DUSTING POWDER if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERBINADOC DUSTING POWDER are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBINADOC DUSTING POWDER
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBINADOC DUSTING POWDER Works

TERBINADOC DUSTING POWDER is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: TERBINADOC DUSTING POWDER is for external use only.
Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.
Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.
Wash your hands before and after application.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
Do not stop using TERBINADOC DUSTING POWDER without consulting your doctor.

name: LUCRUSH Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About LUCRUSH CREAM

LUCRUSH CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LUCRUSH CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LUCRUSH CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUCRUSH CREAM

LUCRUSH CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LUCRUSH CREAM Works

LUCRUSH CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LUCRUSH CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.
usageDetails:

Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.

Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.
sideEffects: Application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging
Allergic reaction (symptoms like skin rash, itching or hives, swelling of the face, lips, or tongue)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of LUCRUSH CREAM
Common Side Effects of LUCRUSH CREAM:
Application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging

Stop taking LUCRUSH CREAM and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Allergic reaction (symptoms like skin rash, itching or hives, swelling of the face, lips, or tongue)
Increased inflammation
Redness and pain

warnings.details: LUCRUSH CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary.
LUCRUSH CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.
Do not take LUCRUSH CREAM if you are allergic to luliconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
LUCRUSH CREAM is generally not recommended to use in children under 12 years of age unless clearly necessary.
LUCRUSH CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).

introduction:
Introduction About ITIN SHAMPOO

ITIN SHAMPOO contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used for the management of head lice and parasitic infections by killing the insects in the scalp and hair that causes infection in the scalp.

Before using ITIN SHAMPOO inform your doctor if you are using any medicines including cosmetic products. This medicine is normally effective in one or two applications and it is safe and effective for itching and irritation caused by lice.  

ITIN SHAMPOO should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before using ITIN SHAMPOO.  

The most common side effect of using ITIN SHAMPOO is application site reactions (such as burning, irritation, itching and redness). Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITIN SHAMPOO

Manage:

Head lice
Parasitic infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ITIN SHAMPOO Works

ITIN SHAMPOO works by binding to the muscle and nerve cells of worms, causing their paralysis and death of insects in the scalp and hair that cause infection in the scalp.
usageDetails:
How to use ITIN SHAMPOO

Use ITIN SHAMPOO as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Use only on the hair and scalp. Apply ITIN SHAMPOO on the dry hair and closest to the scalp first and then outwards to the ends of the hair. Leave it for 10 minutes and then rinse the hair completely with warm water. Later comb hair with a fine-toothed comb to remove the dead lice. Duration will be decided by your physician depending upon the severity of the condition or infection.
sideEffects: Burning, irritation, itching and redness at the site of application
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ITIN SHAMPOO
Common
Burning, irritation, itching and redness at the site of application

ITIN SHAMPOO should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before using it.
Do not use ITIN SHAMPOO if you are allergic to Ivermectin or any other ingredients of this medicine.

name: KETOPRESS Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETOPRESS CREAM

KETOPRESS CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KETOPRESS CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KETOPRESS CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KETOPRESS CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KETOPRESS CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KETOPRESS CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETOPRESS CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KETOPRESS CREAM Works

KETOPRESS CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KETOPRESS CREAM

Apply KETOPRESS CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KETOPRESS CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KETOPRESS CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.
sideEffects: Raised blisters or inflammation of the skin
Problems where the medicine is applied (bleeding, discomfort, dryness, inflammation, tingling)
Severe irritation or reddening of the skin where the medicine has been applied, or other signs of allergy during initial management days
Peeling or blistering of the skin
sideEffectsDetails:

Burning sensation

Uncommon

Problems where the medicine is applied (bleeding, discomfort, dryness, inflammation, tingling)
Skin irritation like rash
Sticky skin

Stop applying KETOPRESS CREAM and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe irritation or reddening of the skin where the medicine has been applied, or other signs of allergy during initial management days
Peeling or blistering of the skin

warnings.details: KETOPRESS CREAM can be used if you are pregnant, however, consult your doctor for advice.
KETOPRESS CREAM can be used if you are breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice.
KETOPRESS CREAM is unlikely to affect your ability to drive or to use machinery.
Do not apply KETOPRESS CREAM if you are allergic to Ketoconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
KETOPRESS CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Others

KETOPRESS CREAM is not recommended for eye infections. Consult your doctor for advice.

name: 2AZOLE Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About 2AZOLE LOTION

2AZOLE LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

2AZOLE LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying 2AZOLE LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of 2AZOLE LOTION

2AZOLE LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How 2AZOLE LOTION Works

2AZOLE LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, 2AZOLE LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.
sideEffects: Application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging
Allergic reaction (symptoms like skin rash, itching or hives, swelling of the face, lips, or tongue)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of 2AZOLE LOTION
Common Side Effects of 2AZOLE LOTION:
Application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging

Stop taking 2AZOLE LOTION and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Allergic reaction (symptoms like skin rash, itching or hives, swelling of the face, lips, or tongue)
Increased inflammation
Redness and pain

warnings.details: 2AZOLE LOTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary.
2AZOLE LOTION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.
Do not take 2AZOLE LOTION if you are allergic to luliconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
2AZOLE LOTION is generally not recommended to use in children under 12 years of age unless clearly necessary.
2AZOLE LOTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).

name: LULIBOR Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIBOR CREAM

LULIBOR CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIBOR CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIBOR CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIBOR CREAM

LULIBOR CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIBOR CREAM Works

LULIBOR CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIBOR CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Sertaspor Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About SERTASPOR CREAM

SERTASPOR CREAM is a combination of Benzyl alcohol and Sertaconazole Nitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in the management of athlete’s foot or interdigital tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes) in adults and children 12 years of age and older with normal immune systems.

Before applying SERTASPOR CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any allergies. It is not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before applying it.

SERTASPOR CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before applying it.

The most common side effects of applying SERTASPOR CREAM are contact dermatitis (skin rash), redness, itching, dry skin, burning, blistering, swelling, drainage and skin tenderness at the managed skin areas. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SERTASPOR CREAM

Manage:

Athlete’s foot
mechanismOfAction:
How SERTASPOR CREAM Works

SERTASPOR CREAM is an antifungal agent works by inhibiting the formation of fungal cell wall, which is essential for the survival of fungus, leading to death.
usageDetails:
How to use SERTASPOR CREAM

Apply SERTASPOR CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area between the toes and the immediately surrounding healthy skin and rub it gently into the skin. Wash your hands with soap and water after using SERTASPOR CREAM.

Avoid applying this medicine to eyes, nose, mouth, lips, vagina and rectal area. Do not cover the managed areas of skin with occlusive dressings or wrappings unless directed by your physician.

name: Kansel B Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About KANSEL B CREAM

KANSEL B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. KANSEL B CREAM is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

KANSEL B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying KANSEL B CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

KANSEL B CREAM should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KANSEL B CREAM
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KANSEL B CREAM Works

KANSEL B CREAM is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use KANSEL B CREAM

Use KANSEL B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying KANSEL B CREAM around your eyes, including eyelids.

name: SERTASPOR Lotion 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About SERTASPOR LOTION

SERTASPOR LOTION contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use SERTASPOR LOTION if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. SERTASPOR LOTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SERTASPOR LOTION is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of SERTASPOR LOTION include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

Uses Of SERTASPOR LOTION
Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:
How SERTASPOR LOTION Works

SERTASPOR LOTION works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use SERTASPOR LOTION

Always use SERTASPOR LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using SERTASPOR LOTION. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

introduction:
Introduction About LT MAC XL LOTION

LT MAC XL LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LT MAC XL LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LT MAC XL LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LT MAC XL LOTION

LT MAC XL LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LT MAC XL LOTION Works

LT MAC XL LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LT MAC XL LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: KETOFF Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETOFF CREAM

KETOFF CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KETOFF CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KETOFF CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KETOFF CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KETOFF CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KETOFF CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETOFF CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KETOFF CREAM Works

KETOFF CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KETOFF CREAM

Apply KETOFF CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KETOFF CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KETOFF CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About PERMED SOAP

PERMED SOAP contains Permethrin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parasitic agents. It is used for the management of scabies and head lice.

Scabies is a condition that is caused by tiny insects called mites that infest and irritate the skin. Symptoms include severe itching, especially at nighttime along with raised rash or spots.

Before applying PERMED SOAP inform your doctor if you are diagnosed with conditions such as asthma, skin diseases, allergies to certain food, medicines or other substances.

This medicine is safe for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. However, it is recommended to consult your doctor before applying it.

It is not recommended for use in children under 2 months of age. Contact your doctor before using.

Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs wash thoroughly with water. It is for external use only. Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

The most common side effects of using this medicine are mild sensation of burning, stinging or tingling, along with skin burns. It is recommended to consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage scabies and head lice

Uses Of PERMED SOAP
Used to manage scabies and head lice
mechanismOfAction:
How PERMED SOAP Works

PERMED SOAP works by paralyzing the mites that results in the killing of the mites along with their eggs that causes scabies. It also kills the head lice which attach to the scalp and irritate it. Hence, PERMED SOAP is effective in the management of scabies and lice infestation.
usageDetails:
How to use PERMED SOAP

Always apply PERMED SOAP as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Gently rub to produce lather leave it for 5 minutes and then wash thoroughly with water or use as directed by your doctor. Check the label for directions before use.

name: Keto B Lotion 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About KETO B LOTION

KETO B LOTION is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole, which belong to the groups of medicines called Anti-inflammatory and Antifungal respectively. It is used to manage different kinds of fungal infections like Tinea corporis (Ringworm), Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp).

These fungal infections can spread easily from one person to another and cause redness and itching in the affected area. They are usually seen in moist and sweaty areas of the body as tinea pedis is usually seen in between the toes due to fitting shoes whereas tinea cruris and groin are seen in the inner thigh region.

Avoid applying KETO B LOTION on the skin surface that is cut, scraped, sunburned, or eczema affected. KETO B LOTION is not recommended for use in patients suffering from skin-related viral infections, tuberculosis, acne rosacea, and perioral dermatitis.

KETO B LOTION should be used with caution in pregnancy and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. KETO B LOTION is not recommended for use in children 9 years of age and below. KETO B LOTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETO B LOTION

Manages fungal infections such as:

Ringworm (Tinea corporis)
Tinea pedis (Athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea capitis (Ringworm of the scalp)
mechanismOfAction:
How KETO B LOTION Works

KETO B LOTION is a combination of Beclomethasone and Ketoconazole. Beclomethasone is a corticosteroid that works by reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms like itching, redness, irritation, and swelling by blocking the enzymes responsible for causing it (prostaglandins and leukotrienes). Ketoconazole is an imidazole that blocks the synthesis of ergosterol, a key component of the fungal cell membrane, thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use KETO B LOTION

Apply KETO B LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean the skin and dry the skin area to be managed. Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, or inside the vagina. Do not cover or wrap or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TETMOSOL ADVANCED SOAP

TETMOSOL ADVANCED SOAP contains Permethrin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parasitic agents. It is used for the management of scabies and head lice.

Scabies is a condition that is caused by tiny insects called mites that infest and irritate the skin. Symptoms include severe itching, especially at nighttime along with raised rash or spots.

Before applying TETMOSOL ADVANCED SOAP inform your doctor if you are diagnosed with conditions such as asthma, skin diseases, allergies to certain food, medicines or other substances.

This medicine is safe for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. However, it is recommended to consult your doctor before applying it.

It is not recommended for use in children under 2 months of age. Contact your doctor before using.

Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs wash thoroughly with water. It is for external use only. Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

The most common side effects of using this medicine are mild sensation of burning, stinging or tingling, along with skin burns. It is recommended to consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage scabies and head lice
usesDetails:
Uses Of TETMOSOL ADVANCED SOAP
Used to manage scabies and head lice
mechanismOfAction:
How TETMOSOL ADVANCED SOAP Works

TETMOSOL ADVANCED SOAP works by paralyzing the mites that results in the killing of the mites along with their eggs that causes scabies. It also kills the head lice which attach to the scalp and irritate it. Hence, TETMOSOL ADVANCED SOAP is effective in the management of scabies and lice infestation.
usageDetails:
How to use TETMOSOL ADVANCED SOAP

Always apply TETMOSOL ADVANCED SOAP as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Gently rub to produce lather leave it for 5 minutes and then wash thoroughly with water or use as directed by your doctor. Check the label for directions before use.

introduction:
Introduction About PHYTORAL OINTMENT

PHYTORAL OINTMENT contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage fungal and yeast infections which may appear on the skin of the hands, feet, genital area, trunk, groin, scalp, face, chest or back.

PHYTORAL OINTMENT is not recommended for eye infections. Before applying PHYTORAL OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

PHYTORAL OINTMENT can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. PHYTORAL OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying PHYTORAL OINTMENT are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PHYTORAL OINTMENT

Manages the fungal or yeast infections of skin appearing on:

Trunk, chest, back
Hands, feet
Scalp, face
Groin, genitals
mechanismOfAction:
How PHYTORAL OINTMENT Works

PHYTORAL OINTMENT reduces fungal infection by inhibiting the growth of the fungus by weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use PHYTORAL OINTMENT

Apply PHYTORAL OINTMENT as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using PHYTORAL OINTMENT in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using PHYTORAL OINTMENT until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About LULY MAX SOAP

LULY MAX SOAP is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (occurs as a red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection). Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another.

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal Agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULY MAX SOAP is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant, and it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. This medicine is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age unless necessary. LULY MAX SOAP should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

Avoid applying LULY MAX SOAP to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULY MAX SOAP

LULY MAX SOAP is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Thrush
Dry, flaky skin
mechanismOfAction:
How LULY MAX SOAP Works

LULY MAX SOAP works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and killing fungi. As a result, LULY MAX SOAP relieves discomfort, itching, and irritation on the skin.

name: KETO SZ Hairwash 120ml
introduction:
Introduction About KETO SZ HAIRWASH

Keto SZ Hair wash is a sulfate and paraben free shampoo used to control flaking, scaling, and itching of scalp associated with dandruff. It contains Zinc Pyrithione and Ketoconazole as active ingredients that acts against P.ovale, which is the root cause of dandruff.

Zinc Pyrithione has antibacterial, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties that kills bacteria, microorganisms and fungus that can contribute to an itchy, flaky scalp and manages dandruff. Ketoconazole works by managing the growth of fungus and relieves flaking, itching, and scaling associated with dandruff.

Always use Keto SZ Hair wash exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Wet your hair and scalp. Take required amount of Keto SZ Hair wash and apply on your scalp and hair and massage to form a thick lather. Wash off with lukewarm water and dry. Use twice in a week for 4 weeks followed by once a week as maintenance therapy or as directed by your physician.

name: Selsun Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About SELSUN SUSPENSION

Selsun Suspension is an antifungal preparation used to manage and control dandruff and tinea versicolor (a common fungal infection causing small, discoloured patches of skin). It contains selenium as an active ingredient which acts by slowing down the cell growth of the scalp layer that causes dandruff.

Selenium Disulfide exerts a cytostatic (inhibits the cell growth) effect on the follicular epithelium and epidermis cells, which decreases the production of corneocytes (cells which produce outer layer of the skin). As a result, it relieves itching and flaking of the scalp and removes the dry, scaly particles.

Always use Selsun Suspension as directed by the physician. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. It should not be used when acute inflammation or exudation (oozing out) is present.

Selsun Suspension should not be used to manage tinea versicolor during pregnancy. Safety and effectiveness in infants have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of SELSUN SUSPENSION

Selsun Suspension may cause skin irritation, increase in amount of normal hair loss, or discoloration of hair. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while using it.

name: Ebernet Lotion 40gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERNET LOTION

EBERNET LOTION contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERNET LOTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERNET LOTION if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERNET LOTION should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERNET LOTION in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERNET LOTION are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERNET LOTION

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERNET LOTION Works

EBERNET LOTION works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERNET LOTION

Always use EBERNET LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERNET LOTION. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERNET LOTION for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.
sideEffectsDetails:

Burning
Irritation
Stinging
Uncommon
Eczema
Scaling
Folliculitis (inflammation of the hair follicles)
Pustules (pus filled bumps)
Rare

Stop using EBERNET LOTION and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Sensitization or irritation

EBERNET LOTION does not affect the ability to drive and use machines.

name: IZ LULI Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About IZ LULI CREAM

IZ LULI CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

IZ LULI CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying IZ LULI CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of IZ LULI CREAM

IZ LULI CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How IZ LULI CREAM Works

IZ LULI CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, IZ LULI CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.
