name: CLIMBEX ANTIDANDRUFF Shampoo 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About CLIMBEX ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO

Climbex Antidandruff Shampoo is formulated with concentrated agents and botanical actives which soothes scalp and reduces flaking. It removes dandruff and excessive oil while controls itching and scaling. It contains Climbazole, Piroctone Olamine, Zinc Pyrithone and Tea tree oil as an active ingredient which reduces itching, flaking, and scaling of the scalp.

Climbazole is a topical antifungal agent, used for fungal skin infections such as dandruff and eczema. Thus, helps to manages dandruff as well as other scalp infections. Piroctone Olamine helps to control the spread of Malassezia globose, thus, helps to manage dandruff, a mild form of seborrheic dermatitis, dry scalp and reduces hair fall. Zinc pyrithione, has antibacterial, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, soothes scalp irritation, regulates oil production, and manages itching. Tea tree oil soothes the scalp, manages dandruff, and removes agents that cause skin to flake.

Always use Climbex Antidandruff Shampoo as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply Climbex Antidandruff Shampoo to wet hair and massage gently with fingertips. For better result, leave the foam for a few minutes. Rinse off well. Avoid contact with eyes and mouth.

name: Lulizol 1% Lotion 20ml
introduction:
Introduction About LULIZOL 1% LOTION

LULIZOL 1% LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIZOL 1% LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIZOL 1% LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIZOL 1% LOTION

LULIZOL 1% LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIZOL 1% LOTION Works

LULIZOL 1% LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIZOL 1% LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Crurix Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About CRURIX CREAM

CRURIX CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using CRURIX CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use CRURIX CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

CRURIX CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of CRURIX CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using CRURIX CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea cruris (Jock itch)

Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How CRURIX CREAM Works

CRURIX CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.

name: KETOMAC Cream 15g
introduction:
Introduction About KETOMAC CREAM

KETOMAC CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KETOMAC CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KETOMAC CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KETOMAC CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KETOMAC CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KETOMAC CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETOMAC CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KETOMAC CREAM Works

KETOMAC CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KETOMAC CREAM

Apply KETOMAC CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KETOMAC CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KETOMAC CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

name: KETZI Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETZI CREAM

KETZI CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use KETZI CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying KETZI CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

KETZI CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. KETZI CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying KETZI CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETZI CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How KETZI CREAM Works

KETZI CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use KETZI CREAM

Apply KETZI CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using KETZI CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using KETZI CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB

EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage fungal infections on scalp and body such as dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis (a dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body) and tinea versicolor.

These conditions can by itchy, caused by a fungus called ‘Malassezia’. Tinea versicolor is characterized by white to brown patches on the body that sometimes appear after exposure to the sun.

Before using EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB, inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or if you are using any steroids. EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice. EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB is not recommended for use in infants and children.

The most common side effects of using EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB are itching, stinging and dryness on the site of application. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

Dandruff

mechanismOfAction:
How EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB Works

EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB works by arresting growth in fungal cells thus, managing growth and spread of the fungus throughout your body.
usageDetails:
How to use EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB

Use EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB as advised by your physician. It is for use on hair and skin only. Wet your hair and scalp thoroughly with water and apply sufficient amount of EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB to produce enough lather. Smoothly massage the lather over the entire scalp. Leave for 3-5 minutes, before washing off thoroughly.

If EXIZOL ANTIDANDRUFF SHAMPOO SCRUB accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: AMOREAL Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMOREAL CREAM

AMOREAL CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMOREAL CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMOREAL CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMOREAL CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMOREAL CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How AMOREAL CREAM Works

AMOREAL CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.

Apply AMOREAL CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AMOREAL CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About LULIGARD CREAM

LULIGARD CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIGARD CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIGARD CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIGARD CREAM

LULIGARD CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIGARD CREAM Works

LULIGARD CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIGARD CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

introduction:
Introduction About ITROMED OINTMENT

ITROMED OINTMENT is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, nails, vagina, etc. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

ITROMED OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to Itraconazole. It is also not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women.

ITROMED OINTMENT should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) since the medicine is known to be associated with a range of potential drug interactions. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of applying ITROMED OINTMENT are common cold, nausea, blurred vision, tiredness, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

name: Czson Dusting Powder 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About CZSON DUSTING POWDER

Czson Dusting Powder is an antibacterial and antifungal powder that is used as a follow-up management of dermatomycoses (fungal infections of skin) like tinea pedum (athlete’s foot), tinea corporis (ring worm), and tinea inguinalis (dhobi itch).

Czson Dusting Powder is also used in pityriasis versicolor (small, discoloured patches of skin) and erythrasma (bacterial infection occurring in skin folds that causes itching, scaling, and redness). It contains clotrimazole as an active ingredient that soothes irritated skin and protects against chafing and rash.

Clotrimazole works by inhibiting the synthesis of ergosterol (an important component of fungal cell membrane, also responsible for cell growth). The fungal cell can now no longer construct an intact and functional cell membrane, and its growth also gets inhibited.

Dust the affected area with Czson Dusting Powder 2-3 times a day or as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with eyes.

introduction:
Introduction About METNIZID OINTMENT

METNIZID OINTMENT contains Metronidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoal drugs. It helps to control infection and inflammation in certain skin problems, such as rosacea (skin redness and flushing with or without small red pus-filled pustules on the skin) and acne. It is also helpful in the management of wound infections, diabetic foot ulcers and vaginal infections.

METNIZID OINTMENT is for external use only. Cleanse and dry the affected areas before applying the medicine. Do not expose the managed areas in direct sunlight. Wear protective clothing and consult your doctor for a suitable sunscreen while going outdoors.

Before using METNIZID OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are suffering from any kind of blood disorders (Ex. blood dyscrasias) or neurological disorders (such as nerve damage). You must also inform your doctor if you suffer from any allergic skin conditions (such as contact dermatitis) as a precaution.

Do not use METNIZID OINTMENT without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using METNIZID OINTMENT are skin dryness, redness, itching and/or irritation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How METNIZID OINTMENT Works

METNIZID OINTMENT is an antiprotozoal agent with antibacterial properties. It works by killing the susceptible germs that cause infections in the body. When applied on the skin, it destroys the infection causing germs and manages their further growth and multiplication which therefore reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use METNIZID OINTMENT

Always apply METNIZID OINTMENT as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected area before application. Apply a thin layer of METNIZID OINTMENT on the affected areas. Wash your hands before and after application.

Avoid contact of METNIZID OINTMENT with eyes, ears, mouth, or nose. In case of accidental contact, rinse it with plenty of warm water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your skin condition.

name: ESAVA Ointment 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About ESAVA OINTMENT

ESAVA OINTMENT contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage fungal and yeast infections which may appear on the skin of the hands, feet, genital area, trunk, groin, scalp, face, chest or back.

ESAVA OINTMENT is not recommended for eye infections. Before applying ESAVA OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

ESAVA OINTMENT can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. ESAVA OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying ESAVA OINTMENT are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESAVA OINTMENT

Manages the fungal or yeast infections of skin appearing on:

Trunk, chest, back
Hands, feet
Scalp, face
Groin, genitals
mechanismOfAction:
How ESAVA OINTMENT Works

ESAVA OINTMENT reduces fungal infection by inhibiting the growth of the fungus by weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use ESAVA OINTMENT

Apply ESAVA OINTMENT as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using ESAVA OINTMENT in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using ESAVA OINTMENT until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About NIZRAL CREAM

NIZRAL CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use NIZRAL CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying NIZRAL CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

NIZRAL CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. NIZRAL CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying NIZRAL CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIZRAL CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How NIZRAL CREAM Works

NIZRAL CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use NIZRAL CREAM

Apply NIZRAL CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using NIZRAL CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using NIZRAL CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About SERTACIDE CREAM

SERTACIDE CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters and scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use SERTACIDE CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. SERTACIDE CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SERTACIDE CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of SERTACIDE CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness and burning sensation etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SERTACIDE CREAM
Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:
How SERTACIDE CREAM Works

SERTACIDE CREAM works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival.  As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use SERTACIDE CREAM

Always use SERTACIDE CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using SERTACIDE CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration and frequency for you depending on the existing conditions etc.

introduction:
Introduction About ZIMIG CREAM

ZIMIG CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

ZIMIG CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use ZIMIG CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using ZIMIG CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZIMIG CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ZIMIG CREAM Works

ZIMIG CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

name: DIPROBAY Ointment 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About DIPROBAY OINTMENT

DIPROBAY OINTMENT is used to provide relief from skin infection, inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling. It contains a combination of Beclomethasone, Clotrimazole and Neomycin.

Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine. It works by making your body not release certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling. Clotrimazole and neomycin stops the activity of microbes (fungi and bacteria) which when applied at the infected site.

DIPROBAY OINTMENT is strictly for external use only. Apply a thin layer of DIPROBAY OINTMENT on the affected skin areas. Avoid its contact with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, or any open wounds. Do not use DIPROBAY OINTMENT for more than 4 weeks without consulting your doctor.

Before using DIPROBAY OINTMENT inform your doctor if you have any viral skin infections, skin ulcers, spotty red rash around the mouth, acne, rosacea (redness of skin) or itching of your anus (back passage) or genital areas as a precaution. Consult your doctor before using DIPROBAY OINTMENT if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of applying DIPROBAY OINTMENT are skin thinning and application site irritation and burning sensation. Consult your doctor if this side effect trouble you.
uses: Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
usesDetails:
Uses Of DIPROBAY OINTMENT
Skin infections (Fungal and Bacterial origin)
Skin inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling associated with autoimmune skin conditions
mechanismOfAction:
How DIPROBAY OINTMENT Works

DIPROBAY OINTMENT contains three medicines, namely beclomethasone, clotrimazole and neomycin. Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine which stops your body from producing certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling, while parallelly making your body release chemicals that heals inflammation.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medication which works by inhibiting the synthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Without ergosterol, the cell membranes become weakened and leaky, leading to fungal cell damage.

Neomycin is an antibiotic which stops protein synthesis in bacteria which is necessary for it to survive. As a result, it disrupts bacterial growth and replication and controls the spread of bacterial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use DIPROBAY OINTMENT

Apply a small amount of DIPROBAY OINTMENT into the affected skin areas or directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop using or overuse DIPROBAY OINTMENT without consulting your doctor.

Avoid contact of DIPROBAY OINTMENT with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. In case of accidental contact, rinse with plenty of water.

name: DEFUNGIN Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About DEFUNGIN CREAM

DEFUNGIN CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

DEFUNGIN CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying DEFUNGIN CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DEFUNGIN CREAM

DEFUNGIN CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How DEFUNGIN CREAM Works

DEFUNGIN CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, DEFUNGIN CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

Application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging

name: CZSON Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About CZSON CREAM

CZSON CREAM contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in the management of fungal skin infections such as ringworm (fungal infection of the skin or scalp), athlete’s foot (fungal infection between the toes), fungal nappy rash (skin rash affecting the nappy area), and fungal sweat rash. It also relieves irritation of the vulva (external thrush) or at the end of the penis, which may be associated with thrush.

Before applying CZSON CREAM, inform your doctor about your previous existing disease conditions. CZSON CREAM is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to clotrimazole. Avoid smoking or going near flames and wearing fabrics that catch fire easily due to the increased risk of severe burns.

CZSON CREAM can be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Avoid using latex contraceptives (condoms or diaphragms), as this medicine may reduce the effectiveness of such contraceptives. Use alternative precautions for at least five days after using the medicine. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual effects.
uses: Manage fungal skin infections (such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, fungal nappy rash, and sweat rash)
Relieves irritation of the vulva or at the end of the penis (which may be associated with thrush)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CZSON CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections (such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, fungal nappy rash, and sweat rash)
Relieves irritation of the vulva or at the end of the penis (which may be associated with thrush)
mechanismOfAction:
How CZSON CREAM Works

CZSON CREAM acts by specifically inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol and other sterols (enzymes) required for cell membrane production; therefore, it inhibits the division and growth of fungi, eventually leading to cell death, which further manages fungal growth.
usageDetails:
How to use CZSON CREAM

Always apply CZSON CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected surface before applying the medicine. Apply and rub gently a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Do not use CZSON CREAM on your face, eyes, or large area. Do not use under bandages or for a long time without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the duration and time interval for application depending on the type of infection.
sideEffects: Signs of an allergic reaction (include rash, swelling of the lips, throat, tongue, or face, feeling faint or dizzy, weakness, nausea, and swallowing or breathing problems)

Signs of an allergic reaction (include rash, swelling of the lips, throat, tongue, or face, feeling faint or dizzy, weakness, nausea, and swallowing or breathing problems)

name: Amrolmac Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMROLMAC CREAM

AMROLMAC CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROLMAC CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLMAC CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLMAC CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROLMAC CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMROLMAC CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How AMROLMAC CREAM Works

AMROLMAC CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AMROLMAC CREAM

Apply AMROLMAC CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AMROLMAC CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

name: LURISTA Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About LURISTA LOTION

LURISTA LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LURISTA LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LURISTA LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LURISTA LOTION

LURISTA LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LURISTA LOTION Works

LURISTA LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LURISTA LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: NIZOSKIN Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About NIZOSKIN CREAM

NIZOSKIN CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use NIZOSKIN CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying NIZOSKIN CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

NIZOSKIN CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. NIZOSKIN CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying NIZOSKIN CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIZOSKIN CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How NIZOSKIN CREAM Works

NIZOSKIN CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use NIZOSKIN CREAM

Apply NIZOSKIN CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using NIZOSKIN CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using NIZOSKIN CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

It contains clotrimazole as an active ingredient to manage various fungal skin infections. Introduction About K FUNG CREAM

K FUNG CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use K FUNG CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying K FUNG CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

K FUNG CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. K FUNG CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying K FUNG CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of K FUNG CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How K FUNG CREAM Works

K FUNG CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use K FUNG CREAM

Apply K FUNG CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using K FUNG CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using K FUNG CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

Introduction About AMROLMAC CREAM

AMROLMAC CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROLMAC CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLMAC CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLMAC CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROLMAC CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.

name: EBERFINE LOT Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERFINE LOT CREAM

EBERFINE LOT CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERFINE LOT CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERFINE LOT CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERFINE LOT CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERFINE LOT CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERFINE LOT CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERFINE LOT CREAM

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERFINE LOT CREAM Works

EBERFINE LOT CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERFINE LOT CREAM

Always use EBERFINE LOT CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERFINE LOT CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERFINE LOT CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

brand: KAIZEN RESEARCH LABS INDIA PVT LTD
introduction:
Introduction About L FUNG CREAM

L FUNG CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

L FUNG CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying L FUNG CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of L FUNG CREAM

L FUNG CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How L FUNG CREAM Works

L FUNG CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, L FUNG CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: TERBOVAG Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About TERBOVAG CREAM

TERBOVAG CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERBOVAG CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERBOVAG CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERBOVAG CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBOVAG CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBOVAG CREAM Works

TERBOVAG CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: TERBOVAG CREAM is for external use only.
Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.
Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.
Wash your hands before and after application.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
Do not stop using TERBOVAG CREAM without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About T BESTE TABLET

T BESTE TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take T BESTE TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking T BESTE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take T BESTE TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of T BESTE TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How T BESTE TABLET Works

T BESTE TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take T BESTE TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse T BESTE TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LURAY CREAM

LURAY CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LURAY CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LURAY CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LURAY CREAM

LURAY CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LURAY CREAM Works

LURAY CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LURAY CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About NIXICLIN CREAM

NIXICLIN CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

NIXICLIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

NIXICLIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

NIXICLIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying NIXICLIN CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.

name: CLODACIL Dusting Powder 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER

CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It also relives symptoms such as burning, itching, skin cracking, and discomfort caused by the skin infections. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin, causing redness and itching. An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes.

Clotrimazole works by blocking the fungal growth and managing the further occurrence of fungal infections. CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER is intended to manage fungal skin infections; hence, it should not be used for other infections of internal organs. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER.

CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for patients allergic to clotrimazole. CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in deep wounds and severe burns. CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Before taking CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER, inform your doctor if you’re under any medications.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER Works

CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER works by managing the fungal growth. Clotrimazole works by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Always apply CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Do not take CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER orally. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER. Before using the CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER on the affected area, wash it thoroughly and make sure it is dry before using CLODACIL DUSTING POWDER.

name: Ebermac 1% Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERMAC 1% CREAM

EBERMAC 1% CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERMAC 1% CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERMAC 1% CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERMAC 1% CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERMAC 1% CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERMAC 1% CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERMAC 1% CREAM

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERMAC 1% CREAM Works

EBERMAC 1% CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERMAC 1% CREAM

Always use EBERMAC 1% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERMAC 1% CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERMAC 1% CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

name: TERCAN Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About TERCAN CREAM

TERCAN CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERCAN CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERCAN CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERCAN CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERCAN CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERCAN CREAM Works

TERCAN CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About VICLOB M CREAM

VICLOB M CREAM is a combination of Clobetasol and Miconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antifungals. It is used to manage resistant dermatoses (skin infections) with secondary fungal infections like psoriasis (except widespread plaque psoriasis) and recalcitrant dermatoses.

VICLOB M CREAM is not recommended for use in patients with rosacea, acne vulgaris, perioral dermatitis, pruritus without inflammation, perianal and genital pruritus. VICLOB M CREAM should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney disease and psoriasis. Contact your doctor before applying.

Use of VICLOB M CREAM during pregnancy should only be considered if the expected benefit to the mother outweighs the risk to the foetus. Contact your doctor before applying. Use of VICLOB M CREAM during lactation should only be considered if the expected benefit to the mother outweighs the risk to the infant. Contact your doctor before applying.

VICLOB M CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 1 year of age and should be used with caution in children above 1 year of age. Contact your doctor before applying. VICLOB M CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients. Contact your doctor before applying. The most common side effects of this medicine are pruritus, skin burning or skin pain. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About LULILOK LOTION

LULILOK LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULILOK LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULILOK LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULILOK LOTION

LULILOK LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULILOK LOTION Works

LULILOK LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULILOK LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: TOPIDUST Dusting Powder 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER

TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It also relives symptoms such as burning, itching, skin cracking, and discomfort caused by the skin infections. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin, causing redness and itching. An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes.

Clotrimazole works by blocking the fungal growth and managing the further occurrence of fungal infections. TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER is intended to manage fungal skin infections; hence, it should not be used for other infections of internal organs. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER.

TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for patients allergic to clotrimazole. TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in deep wounds and severe burns. TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Before taking TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER, inform your doctor if you’re under any medications.
uses: It is used to manage skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating.

mechanismOfAction:
How TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER Works

TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER works by managing the fungal growth. Clotrimazole works by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageDetails:
How to use TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER

Always apply TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Do not take TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER orally. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER. Before using the TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER on the affected area, wash it thoroughly and make sure it is dry before using TOPIDUST DUSTING POWDER.

introduction:
Introduction About LLCOL CREAM

LLCOL CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LLCOL CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LLCOL CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)

mechanismOfAction:

name: ESCRAB Lotion 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About ESCRAB LOTION

ESCRAB LOTION contains Permethrin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parasitic agents. It is indicated for the management of scabies, pediculosis (lice) and crab louse infections.

Scabies is a condition that cause itchy skin caused by a tiny burrowing mite called Sarcoptes scabiei. It can cause intense itching in the area where the mite burrows.

ESCRAB LOTION is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chrysanthemums (a flower). ESCRAB LOTION should be used with caution in patients having lung diseases and eczema (skin disease).

It is not recommended for use in infants below 2 months of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

ESCRAB LOTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult with your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of using ESCRAB LOTION are itching, redness of skin, tingling, prickling, skin burning sensation and dry skin. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESCRAB LOTION

Used to manage:

Scabies
Pediculosis
Crab louse infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ESCRAB LOTION Works

ESCRAB LOTION helps in managing scabies and head lice by acting on the nerve cells of the disease-causing organism and alters the movements of certain ions (sodium ions) which leads to loss of their function. This causes respiratory failure of the disease-causing organism and hence, their destruction.
usageDetails:
How to use ESCRAB LOTION

Always apply ESCRAB LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. The medicine should be applied on all the affected areas. Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Wash hands before and after the application of ESCRAB LOTION. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth.
sideEffects: Signs of hypersensitivity reactions (skin rash, fever, difficulty in breathing or swallowing, scaly or flaky skin)
sideEffectsDetails:

Common
Itching
Redness of skin
Tingling, prickling, skin burning sensation
Dry skin
Rare

Stop using ESCRAB LOTION and inform your doctor immediately if you notice any of the following side effects:

Skin irritation
Signs of hypersensitivity reactions (skin rash, fever, difficulty in breathing or swallowing, scaly or flaky skin)

Do not use ESCRAB LOTION if you are allergic to Permethrin or any other pyrethroid such as resmethrin, sumithrin or any of its ingredients

introduction:
Introduction About TRUCONA T DUSTING POWDER

TRUCONA T DUSTING POWDER is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TRUCONA T DUSTING POWDER is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TRUCONA T DUSTING POWDER if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TRUCONA T DUSTING POWDER are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.

name: Quadriline Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About QUADRILINE CREAM

QUADRILINE CREAM is a combination of Betamethasone, Clotrimazole and Neomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-inflammatory, Antifungal and Antibiotic. It is used for the symptomatic management of inflammatory and allergic diseases such as chronic dermatitis of extremities (skin inflammation of hands and feet), balanoposthitis (inflammation of foreskin and head of the penis), eczematoid dermatitis (dry, itchy, inflamed skin), contact dermatitis (itchy rash), follicular dermatitis (inflammation of hair follicles), nonspecific pruritis (itching), parakeratosis, anal itching, intertrigo (skin inflammation of groin or between skin folds).

QUADRILINE CREAM is also used for the management of  impetigo (red sores on the face), neurodermatitis (skin condition characterized by chronic itching and scaling), angular stomatitis (red swollen patches in the corners of the mouth), photosensitivity dermatitis (abnormal reaction to sunlight), dermatitis (skin inflammation), lichenified inguinal dermatophytosis (fungal infection of groins), tinea corporis (ringworm or fungal infection of the body), tinea cruris (fungal  infection of the groins, inner thighs), tinea pedis (fungal infection of the feet) and candidiasis (fungal skin infection).

QUADRILINE CREAM is not recommended for use if you have viral infections (herpes or chickenpox), acne or rosacea (skin condition affecting the face) and inflammation of skin around the mouth, nappy rash. Contact your doctor before applying it.

QUADRILINE CREAM should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before applying it.

QUADRILINE CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age. The most common side effects of using QUADRILINE CREAM are burning, irritation, tingling or stinging sensation, dry skin, pimple-like bumps, tenderness & flaking of the managed skin. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

QUADRILINE CREAM helps to manage infection, where Betamethasone is an anti-inflammatory which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi while Neomycin is an antibiotic which stops the growth of bacteria in the skin. Together, manages skin infection effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use QUADRILINE CREAM

Apply QUADRILINE CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the skin area to be managed. Apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Wash your hands after using unless you are using this medication to manage the hands.

Do not cover or wrap, bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor. Wear loose-fitting clothes after applying the medication to the groin area. Avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth or inside the vagina. If you do get the medication in those areas, wash with plenty of water.

name: GALFIN Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About GALFIN CREAM

GALFIN CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

GALFIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

GALFIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

GALFIN CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying GALFIN CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of GALFIN CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum

mechanismOfAction:
How GALFIN CREAM Works

GALFIN CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:

Apply GALFIN CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using GALFIN CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

name: Canzorb Powder 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About CANZORB POWDER

Canzorb Powder is an antifungal powder with super absorbent formula which helps to absorbs moisture. It is used as adjunct to manage fungal infection and manage its recurrence particularly in skin folds and where perspiration is a problem. As a maintenance therapy for tinea pedis, tinea cruris, diaper rash and other fungal infections of skin. It contains Clotrimazole as an active ingredient.

Clotrimazole acts primarily by damaging the permeability barrier in the cell membrane of the fungi by disrupting the production of the membranes that surrounds the fungal cells. It works by altering the fungal cell membrane by inhibiting certain enzymes, thereby clearing the infection and relieving the symptoms.

Always use Canzorb Powder as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. It should be used in the morning or night as directed by the physician. Do not use if you are allergic to Clotrimazole.
