Introduction About LULIFORD LOTION

LULIFORD LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIFORD LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIFORD LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About LULIFAL CREAM

LULIFAL CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIFAL CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIFAL CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIFAL CREAM

LULIFAL CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIFAL CREAM Works

LULIFAL CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIFAL CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.

Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: Monoguard 2% Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About MONOGUARD 2% CREAM

MONOGUARD 2% CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use MONOGUARD 2% CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. MONOGUARD 2% CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MONOGUARD 2% CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of MONOGUARD 2% CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:

Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:
How MONOGUARD 2% CREAM Works

MONOGUARD 2% CREAM works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:

Always use MONOGUARD 2% CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using MONOGUARD 2% CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

name: LEEZOLE Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About LEEZOLE LOTION

LEEZOLE LOTION contains Clotrimazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals.  It is used in the management of skin infections such as ringworm, athlete’s foot, fungal intertrigo and fungal infections of the outer and middle ear. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin and causing redness and itching.

An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes. Fungal intertrigo is inflammation caused by skin-to-skin friction in warm, moist areas of the body (groin, between folds of skin on the abdomen, under the breasts, arms or between toes).Clotrimazole works by managing fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of the fungal cell.

LEEZOLE LOTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to this medicine. LEEZOLE LOTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The common side effects of LEEZOLE LOTION are itching, rash, blisters, burning, discomfort, swelling, irritation, redness and peeling of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the outer and middle ear
usesDetails:
Uses Of LEEZOLE LOTION
Manage ringworm
Manage athlete’s foot
Manage fungal intertrigo
Manage fungal infections of the outer and middle ear
mechanismOfAction:
How LEEZOLE LOTION Works

LEEZOLE LOTION acts by specifically inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol and other sterols (enzymes) required for cell membrane production, therefore inhibiting the division and growth of fungi eventually leading to cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use LEEZOLE LOTION

Always apply LEEZOLE LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. After washing and drying the infected area thoroughly apply a thin and even layer on it. In case of ear infection use 2-3 drops in the ears. Do not scratch the infected area even though it is itchy, keep the area clean and always wash your hands before and after the use of the medicine. Do not share towels, bathmats, etc. with other people, wash your socks, stockings and tights thoroughly in hot water to remove any shed skin or fungal spores. Change your footwear daily if possible. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration for you depending on your age and disease condition.

LEEZOLE LOTION has no or negligible influence on the ability to drive or use machines.
Do not apply LEEZOLE LOTION if you are allergic to clotrimazole, other anti-fungal medicines or any other ingredients of this medicine.

name: Erbimesh 1% Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About ERBIMESH 1% CREAM

ERBIMESH 1% CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

ERBIMESH 1% CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use ERBIMESH 1% CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using ERBIMESH 1% CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ERBIMESH 1% CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ERBIMESH 1% CREAM Works

ERBIMESH 1% CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.
Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.
Wash your hands before and after application.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
Do not stop using ERBIMESH 1% CREAM without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About SELSHINE SUSPENSION

SELSHINE Suspension is used to manage dandruff. It is also used to manage tinea versicolor (fungal infection of skin). SELSHINE Suspension contains Selenium sulfide as an active ingredient that helps to reduce itching, flaking, irritation and redness in the scalp associated with dandruff.

In the epidermis and follicular epithelium, selenium sulfide appears to have a growth inhibitory effect that lessens corneocyte formation (cells that form outer layer of skin) and subsequent flaking. Its effectiveness is enhanced by local irritating, antibacterial, ant seborrheic, and modest antifungal activities.

Always use SELSHINE Suspension exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Shake well before use. Read the label within the packet carefully before using this product. Avoid SELSHINE Suspension in direct contact with your eyes.

introduction:
Introduction About AFDERM MN + CREAM

AFDERM MN + CREAM is a combination of Miconazole, Mometasone and Nadifloxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals, Corticosteroids and Antibiotic respectively. It is used to manage bacterial and fungal skin infections like atopic and contact dermatitis, erythema multiforme, infective eczema, psoriasis and skin lesions.

Bacterial infection occurs when bacteria enters the body, increase the number of bacteria and cause a reaction in the body. A fungal infection (mycosis) is a skin disease that is caused by a fungus when it enters the tissue. Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another person. Before using AFDERM MN + CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis. AFDERM MN + CREAM is not recommended for use during pregnancy.

AFDERM MN + CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. AFDERM MN + CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions (such as burning, irritation, itching, flaking and redness). Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AFDERM MN + CREAM

It is used to manage bacterial and fungal skin infections such as:

Atopic and contact dermatitis
Erythema multiforme
Infective eczema
Psoriasis
Skin lesions
mechanismOfAction:
How AFDERM MN + CREAM Works

AFDERM MN + CREAM is a combination of Miconazole, Mometasone and Nadifloxacin. Miconazole works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungi and works against fungi. Mometasone is a corticosteroid that works by blocking the various chemical messengers (like histamine) involved in allergic and non-allergic mediated inflammation. It reduces inflammation, itchiness and redness by managing the traveling of infection-fighting white blood cells (WBCs) to the affected area of the body. Nadifloxacin belongs to antibiotic works by against the bacteria that cause skin infections and also inhibits the repairing of bacterial cells, thereby managing the further spread of the infections.

Apply AFDERM MN + CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About LULIRX SPRAY

LULIRX SPRAY is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection). Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another.

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal Agents. It works by inhibiting the growth of the fungus that causes these infections.

LULIRX SPRAY is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. LULIRX SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

Avoid applying LULIRX SPRAY on the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIRX SPRAY

LULIRX SPRAY is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIRX SPRAY Works

LULIRX SPRAY works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and killing fungi. In this way, Luliconazole relieves discomfort, itching, and irritation on the skin.

name: AMYROL Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMYROL CREAM

AMYROL CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMYROL CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMYROL CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMYROL CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMYROL CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMYROL CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How AMYROL CREAM Works

AMYROL CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:

Apply AMYROL CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using AMYROL CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About YUZKT SOAP

YUZKT Soap is an antifungal medicated soap with a combination of ketoconazole, aloe vera and zinc pyrithione. It provides relief from itching skin folds or inner thighs, waist and arm pits due to sweat retention, warmth, humidity, friction and simultaneous growth of resident organisms.

Ketoconazole is an azole antifungal which works by managing the growth of fungus. Aloe vera is gentle, soothing, and can help to reduce inflammation. Zinc pyrithione helps to relieve itching, redness, irritation, scaling and other fungal infections.

Wet the affected part thoroughly, massage YUZKT Soap liberally to make a rich lather, leave lather several minutes then rinse with water. Avoid contact with eyes. It is for external use only. Discontinue YUZKT Soap if you develop any irritation or inflammation and consult your doctor for advice.

Introduction About NADIFA M2 CREAM

NADIFA M2 CREAM is a combination of Miconazole, Mometasone and Nadifloxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals, Corticosteroids and Antibiotic respectively. It is used to manage bacterial and fungal skin infections like atopic and contact dermatitis, erythema multiforme, infective eczema, psoriasis and skin lesions.

Bacterial infection occurs when bacteria enters the body, increase the number of bacteria and cause a reaction in the body. A fungal infection (mycosis) is a skin disease that is caused by a fungus when it enters the tissue. Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another person. Before using NADIFA M2 CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis. NADIFA M2 CREAM is not recommended for use during pregnancy.

NADIFA M2 CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. NADIFA M2 CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions (such as burning, irritation, itching, flaking and redness). Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NADIFA M2 CREAM

Atopic and contact dermatitis
Erythema multiforme
Infective eczema
Psoriasis

mechanismOfAction:
How NADIFA M2 CREAM Works

NADIFA M2 CREAM is a combination of Miconazole, Mometasone and Nadifloxacin. Miconazole works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungi and works against fungi. Mometasone is a corticosteroid that works by blocking the various chemical messengers (like histamine) involved in allergic and non-allergic mediated inflammation. It reduces inflammation, itchiness and redness by managing the traveling of infection-fighting white blood cells (WBCs) to the affected area of the body. Nadifloxacin belongs to antibiotic works by against the bacteria that cause skin infections and also inhibits the repairing of bacterial cells, thereby managing the further spread of the infections.

name: WINLU Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About WINLU CREAM

WINLU CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

WINLU CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying WINLU CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of WINLU CREAM

WINLU CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How WINLU CREAM Works

WINLU CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, WINLU CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: TERBIKEM Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About TERBIKEM CREAM

TERBIKEM CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERBIKEM CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERBIKEM CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERBIKEM CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBIKEM CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBIKEM CREAM Works

TERBIKEM CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

name: AMROLMAC Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMROLMAC GEL

AMROLMAC GEL contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMROLMAC GEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLMAC GEL is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMROLMAC GEL is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMROLMAC GEL are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum

mechanismOfAction:
How AMROLMAC GEL Works

AMROLMAC GEL works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

Introduction About ERADIF S CREAM

ERADIF S CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use ERADIF S CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. ERADIF S CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. ERADIF S CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of ERADIF S CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: DELZIKET Soap 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About DELZIKET SOAP

DELZIKET SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

DELZIKET SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using DELZIKET SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. DELZIKET SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of DELZIKET SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with DELZIKET SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About SCABIMIDE P LOTION

SCABIMIDE P LOTION contains Gamma benzene hexachloride, which belongs to a group of medicines called Ectoparasiticides. SCABIMIDE P LOTION is used to manage scabies (itchy skin rash caused by burrowing mite) in patients who are intolerant/had failed management with other approved therapies to manage the condition.

SCABIMIDE P LOTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Gamma benzene hexachloride. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from crusted scabies, second scabies attack, skin conditions (such as atopic dermatitis, psoriasis), and/or uncontrolled seizure disorders.

Before applying SCABIMIDE P LOTION, inform your doctor if you have/had head injury, brain/spinal cord tumour, HIV/AIDS, and/or liver problems (such as severe hepatic cirrhosis).

SCABIMIDE P LOTION should be used with caution in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless it is clearly necessary.

SCABIMIDE P LOTION is advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) who weigh less than 50 kg (110 pounds) and is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of applying SCABIMIDE P LOTION are itching skin, burning skin, dry skin, and/or skin rash. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage scabies in patients who are intolerant/had failed management with other approved therapies.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SCABIMIDE P LOTION
Manage scabies in patients who are intolerant/had failed management with other approved therapies.
mechanismOfAction:
How SCABIMIDE P LOTION Works

SCABIMIDE P LOTION works by blocking the action of the GABA-gated chloride channel (neurotransmitter) in parasites, which leads to low neuronal inhibition and paralysis in parasites, thus resulting in its destruction and providing relief from skin disease caused by parasites (scabies) in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use SCABIMIDE P LOTION

Always apply SCABIMIDE P LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Shake well before use. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area. Managed areas should not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Following application, wash the applied area after 8 to 12 hours. The medicine should be washed off completely. Avoid using the medicine again after the first application and throw away the bottle after use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: LULIHALT Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIHALT CREAM

LULIHALT CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIHALT CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIHALT CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIHALT CREAM

LULIHALT CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIHALT CREAM Works

LULIHALT CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIHALT CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION

KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage fungal infections on scalp and body such as dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis (a dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body) and tinea versicolor.

These conditions can by itchy, caused by a fungus called ‘Malassezia’. Tinea versicolor is characterized by white to brown patches on the body that sometimes appear after exposure to the sun.

Before using KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or if you are using any steroids. KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice. KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use in infants and children.

The most common side effects of using KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION are itching, stinging and dryness on the site of application. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

Dandruff
Seborrheic dermatitis
Tinea versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION Works

KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION works by arresting growth in fungal cells thus, managing growth and spread of the fungus throughout your body.
usageDetails:
How to use KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION

Use KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for use on hair and skin only. Wet your hair and scalp thoroughly with water and apply sufficient amount of KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION to produce enough lather. Smoothly massage the lather over the entire scalp. Leave for 3-5 minutes, before washing off thoroughly.

If KETONOL SCALP SOLUTION accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: LULIPLUS Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIPLUS CREAM

LULIPLUS CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIPLUS CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIPLUS CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIPLUS CREAM

LULIPLUS CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIPLUS CREAM Works

LULIPLUS CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIPLUS CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

name: GALVATE C Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About GALVATE C LOTION

GALVATE C LOTION is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. GALVATE C LOTION is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

GALVATE C LOTION is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying GALVATE C LOTION, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

GALVATE C LOTION should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GALVATE C LOTION
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How GALVATE C LOTION Works

GALVATE C LOTION is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use GALVATE C LOTION

Use GALVATE C LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying GALVATE C LOTION around your eyes, including eyelids.

name: BELMOZ Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About BELMOZ CREAM

BELMOZ CREAM contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. BELMOZ CREAM is used in the management of inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses such as psoriasis and atopic dermatitis. It is also used to manage scalp psoriasis and seborrheic dermatitis.

Psoriasis is a type of skin disease that causes skin rash with itchy, scaly patches which most commonly occurs on the knees, elbows, trunk and scalp. Atopic dermatitis is a skin condition which makes your skin red and itchy. Scalp psoriasis is a common skin disorder that makes skin raised, reddish, often scaly on the scalp which can either occur as a single patch or several patches on the scalp. Seborrheic dermatitis is a common skin condition that affects your scalp which is characterized by red, and scaly patches of skin and dandruff.

Avoid applying BELMOZ CREAM, if you have rosacea (a skin condition affecting the face), acne (pimples), skin atrophy (thinning of the skin), dermatitis (skin inflammation) around the mouth, genital itching, viral infections such as shingles, chickenpox (viral infection), ulcerated skin, and wounds.

Before applying BELMOZ CREAM, inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease. BELMOZ CREAM should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before applying BELMOZ CREAM.

The medicine is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor before applying BELMOZ CREAM.

The most common side effects of using BELMOZ CREAM are mild to moderate pruritus (itchy skin), burning and stinging sensation of skin, folliculitis (a type of skin infection marked by inflamed hair follicles), dryness of skin, mild skin atrophy (thin-shiny appearing skin). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worse.

name: EBERBEST Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERBEST CREAM

EBERBEST CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERBEST CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERBEST CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERBEST CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERBEST CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERBEST CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERBEST CREAM

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERBEST CREAM Works

EBERBEST CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERBEST CREAM

Always use EBERBEST CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERBEST CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERBEST CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

introduction:
Introduction About LULISKIN SOAP

LULISKIN SOAP is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (occurs as a red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection). Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another.

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal Agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULISKIN SOAP is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant, and it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary. This medicine is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age unless necessary. LULISKIN SOAP should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

Avoid applying LULISKIN SOAP to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULISKIN SOAP

LULISKIN SOAP is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)

mechanismOfAction:
How LULISKIN SOAP Works

LULISKIN SOAP works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and killing fungi. As a result, LULISKIN SOAP relieves discomfort, itching, and irritation on the skin.

introduction:
Introduction About AMORON CREAM

AMORON CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMORON CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMORON CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMORON CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMORON CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum

How AMORON CREAM Works

AMORON CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.

introduction:
Introduction About UNIMAZOLE DUSTING POWDER

UNIMAZOLE DUSTING POWDER contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It also relives symptoms such as burning, itching, skin cracking, and discomfort caused by the skin infections. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin, causing redness and itching. An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes.

Clotrimazole works by blocking the fungal growth and managing the further occurrence of fungal infections. UNIMAZOLE DUSTING POWDER is intended to manage fungal skin infections; hence, it should not be used for other infections of internal organs. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with UNIMAZOLE DUSTING POWDER.

UNIMAZOLE DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for patients allergic to clotrimazole. UNIMAZOLE DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in deep wounds and severe burns. UNIMAZOLE DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Before taking UNIMAZOLE DUSTING POWDER, inform your doctor if you’re under any medications.

UNIMAZOLE DUSTING POWDER works by managing the fungal growth. Clotrimazole works by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

LULIPEX GEL(TOPICAL) works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIPEX GEL(TOPICAL) relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: AMORTOP Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMORTOP CREAM

AMORTOP CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

AMORTOP CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMORTOP CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

AMORTOP CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying AMORTOP CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How AMORTOP CREAM Works

AMORTOP CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.

introduction:
Introduction About BECZOL CREAM

BECZOL CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. BECZOL CREAM is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

BECZOL CREAM is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections. Before applying BECZOL CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance. BECZOL CREAM should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary. It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine. The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BECZOL CREAM
Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How BECZOL CREAM Works

BECZOL CREAM is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.
usageDetails:
How to use BECZOL CREAM

Use BECZOL CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Avoid applying BECZOL CREAM around your eyes, including eyelids.

Introduction About DANDROP LOTION

DANDROP LOTION contains Ketoconazole and Zinc pyrithione which belong to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used to manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection causing dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body).

Before using DANDROP LOTION, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, or if you are using any steroids. DANDROP LOTION can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice.

DANDROP LOTION is not recommended for use in infants and children. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, wash eyes thoroughly with water. Call your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.

name: CLODACIL Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLODACIL CREAM

CLODACIL CREAM contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in the management of fungal skin infections such as ringworm (fungal infection of the skin or scalp), athlete’s foot (fungal infection between the toes), fungal nappy rash (skin rash affecting the nappy area), and fungal sweat rash. It also relieves irritation of the vulva (external thrush) or at the end of the penis, which may be associated with thrush.

Before applying CLODACIL CREAM, inform your doctor about your previous existing disease conditions. CLODACIL CREAM is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to clotrimazole. Avoid smoking or going near flames and wearing fabrics that catch fire easily due to the increased risk of severe burns.

CLODACIL CREAM can be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Avoid using latex contraceptives (condoms or diaphragms), as this medicine may reduce the effectiveness of such contraceptives. Use alternative precautions for at least five days after using the medicine. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLODACIL CREAM Works

CLODACIL CREAM acts by specifically inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol and other sterols (enzymes) required for cell membrane production; therefore, it inhibits the division and growth of fungi, eventually leading to cell death, which further manages fungal growth.
usageDetails:
How to use CLODACIL CREAM

Always apply CLODACIL CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected surface before applying the medicine. Apply and rub gently a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Do not use CLODACIL CREAM on your face, eyes, or large area. Do not use under bandages or for a long time without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the duration and time interval for application depending on the type of infection.

name: LULINOL XL Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULINOL XL CREAM

LULINOL XL CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULINOL XL CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULINOL XL CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULINOL XL CREAM

LULINOL XL CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULINOL XL CREAM Works

LULINOL XL CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULINOL XL CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: TWINSORB Shampoo 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About TWINSORB SHAMPOO

TWINSORB SHAMPOO contains Fluocinolone which belongs to the group of medicines called as Corticosteroids. It is used to manage seborrheic dermatitis of the scalp. Seborrheic dermatitis is a condition which majorly affects the scalp and cause red skin, scaly patches and stubborn dandruff.

Before using TWINSORB SHAMPOO, inform your doctor if you have any skin infections or if you are using any other medicines. TWINSORB SHAMPOO should be used in pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby and should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Safety and effectiveness of TWINSORB SHAMPOO in children and infants have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice. Patients may experience local reactions like burning, itching, irritation, dryness, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.
uses: Manage seborrheic dermatitis of the scalp
usesDetails:
Uses Of TWINSORB SHAMPOO
Manage seborrheic dermatitis of the scalp
mechanismOfAction:
How TWINSORB SHAMPOO Works

TWINSORB SHAMPOO reduces the swelling and constriction of the blood vessels by inhibiting the factors that cause swelling and inflammation. It also blocks the pathway of certain substances that cause inflammation (prostaglandins).
usageDetails:
How to use TWINSORB SHAMPOO

Always apply TWINSORB SHAMPOO as directed by your doctor. It is for external use only. Shake well before use. TWINSORB SHAMPOO should be applied on thoroughly wet hair and scalp and should be massaged onto the scalp. Leave it for 5 minutes and then rinse thoroughly with water. Avoid any contact with eyes. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: HPA axis suppression (detected by certain tests)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of TWINSORB SHAMPOO
Rare

Stop using TWINSORB SHAMPOO and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

HPA axis suppression (detected by certain tests)
Irritation

TWINSORB SHAMPOO should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.
Do not use TWINSORB SHAMPOO if you are allergic to Fluocinolone or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

name: PERMEZEST Soap 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About PERMEZEST SOAP

PERMEZEST SOAP contains Permethrin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-parasitic agents. It is used for the management of scabies and head lice.

Scabies is a condition that is caused by tiny insects called mites that infest and irritate the skin. Symptoms include severe itching, especially at nighttime along with raised rash or spots.

Before applying PERMEZEST SOAP inform your doctor if you are diagnosed with conditions such as asthma, skin diseases, allergies to certain food, medicines or other substances.

This medicine is safe for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. However, it is recommended to consult your doctor before applying it.

It is not recommended for use in children under 2 months of age. Contact your doctor before using.

Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs wash thoroughly with water. It is for external use only. Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

The most common side effects of using this medicine are mild sensation of burning, stinging or tingling, along with skin burns. It is recommended to consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage scabies and head lice
usesDetails:
Uses Of PERMEZEST SOAP
Used to manage scabies and head lice
mechanismOfAction:
How PERMEZEST SOAP Works

PERMEZEST SOAP works by paralyzing the mites that results in the killing of the mites along with their eggs that causes scabies. It also kills the head lice which attach to the scalp and irritate it. Hence, PERMEZEST SOAP is effective in the management of scabies and lice infestation.
usageDetails:
How to use PERMEZEST SOAP

Always apply PERMEZEST SOAP as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Gently rub to produce lather leave it for 5 minutes and then wash thoroughly with water or use as directed by your doctor. Check the label for directions before use.
sideEffects: Mild sensation of burning, stinging, tingling

introduction:
Introduction About CARYZOLE SCALP LOTION

CARYZOLE SCALP LOTION contains Ketoconazole and Zinc pyrithione which belong to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used to manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis (a fungal infection causing dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body).

Before using CARYZOLE SCALP LOTION, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, or if you are using any steroids. CARYZOLE SCALP LOTION can be usually used by pregnant and breastfeeding women but consult your doctor for advice.

CARYZOLE SCALP LOTION is not recommended for use in infants and children. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, wash eyes thoroughly with water. Call your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.
uses: To manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
usesDetails:

To manage dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis
mechanismOfAction:
How CARYZOLE SCALP LOTION Works

CARYZOLE SCALP LOTION reduces infection where ketoconazole kills the fungus and zinc pyrithione stops the growth of the infecting organism.
usageDetails:

Use CARYZOLE SCALP LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wet your hair and scalp and apply sufficient CARYZOLE SCALP LOTION to produce enough lather. Massage for one minute to produce enough lather and keep it for 5 minutes.

If CARYZOLE SCALP LOTION accidentally gets in your eye, wash your eyes with water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: LULIFAST Lotion 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About LULIFAST LOTION

LULIFAST LOTION is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIFAST LOTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIFAST LOTION to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIFAST LOTION

LULIFAST LOTION is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIFAST LOTION Works

LULIFAST LOTION works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULIFAST LOTION relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: FUSERT Cream 30g
introduction:
Introduction About FUSERT CREAM

FUSERT CREAM contains Sertaconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage an athlete's foot (tinea pedis). An athlete’s foot is a condition with a fungal infection of the skin involving the feet and in-between the toes. The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use FUSERT CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. FUSERT CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. FUSERT CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of FUSERT CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FUSERT CREAM
Manage athlete’s foot (tinea pedis)
mechanismOfAction:
How FUSERT CREAM Works

FUSERT CREAM works by managing fungi from developing their necessary protective coating, which is necessary for their survival. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use FUSERT CREAM

Always use FUSERT CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using FUSERT CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.
sideEffects: Dryness and burning sensation of the skin

Common

Dryness and burning sensation of the skin
Tenderness of the skin
Redness

Skin blisters

Rare

Stop using FUSERT CREAM and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reaction

warnings.details: FUSERT CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant women if recommended by your doctor. Inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant or think you may be pregnant while using FUSERT CREAM.
FUSERT CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding mothers only if recommended by your doctor. Consult your doctor before using FUSERT CREAM.
Do not use FUSERT CREAM if you are allergic to Sertaconazole.
FUSERT CREAM is recommended for use in children at and above 12 years of age only. Consult your doctor for advice.

FUSERT CREAM should be taken with caution in the elderly above 65 years of age, only if recommended by your doctor. Your doctor will decide the dose, duration of the management, and frequency for you depending on the severity of your existing condition and other comorbid diseases.

The symptoms of fungal infection of the skin include redness, itching, irritation, swelling, blisters, a scaly appearance of the skin, etc.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to other areas in the body or another person.

Do not use SERTASPOR CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to sertaconazole. SERTASPOR CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SERTASPOR CREAM is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age.

The most common side effects of SERTASPOR CREAM include contact dermatitis, skin dryness, tenderness, burning sensation, etc. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MAX KETO LOTION

MAX KETO LOTION contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage fungal and yeast infections which may appear on the skin of the hands, feet, genital area, trunk, groin, scalp, face, chest or back.

MAX KETO LOTION is not recommended for eye infections. Before applying MAX KETO LOTION, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment, or lotion that contains a steroid.

MAX KETO LOTION can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding; however, consult your doctor for advice. MAX KETO LOTION should not be used by children or adolescents (those under the age of 18).

The most common side effects of applying MAX KETO LOTION are burning sensations, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MAX KETO LOTION

Trunk, chest, back
Hands, feet
Scalp, face
Groin, genitals
mechanismOfAction:
How MAX KETO LOTION Works

MAX KETO LOTION reduces fungal infection by inhibiting the growth of the fungus by weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use MAX KETO LOTION

Apply MAX KETO LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well. Apply it to the affected area and the immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using MAX KETO LOTION in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks, but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

name: FLUTY LC Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About FLUTY LC CREAM

FLUTY LC CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

FLUTY LC CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying FLUTY LC CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLUTY LC CREAM

FLUTY LC CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How FLUTY LC CREAM Works

FLUTY LC CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, FLUTY LC CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

name: MAX KETO Cream 25gm
introduction:
Introduction About MAX KETO CREAM

MAX KETO CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use MAX KETO CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying MAX KETO CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

MAX KETO CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. MAX KETO CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying MAX KETO CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MAX KETO CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MAX KETO CREAM Works

MAX KETO CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use MAX KETO CREAM

Apply MAX KETO CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using MAX KETO CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using MAX KETO CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.
